maps.title: Rupa Siksa · Day 18 · Species in the Universe

nodeData.topic: Day 18 · Species in the Universe
nodeData.note: CC Madhya 19.136–138 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Mahaprabhu tells Rupa Gosvami he can give only a drop of the ocean of devotional service, and begins with the living entities: unlimited in number, in 8,400,000 species, spread through every element and every planet. Maharaj takes on the scientists who deny life elsewhere, explains subtle bodies, walks through the count of species, and shows that the human species, though the smallest, suffers most — and that following the acaryas' principles is what makes us human. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Mahaprabhu tells Rupa that devotional service cannot be described in full, so he will give only a synopsis of its symptoms — a single drop from an ocean whose length and breadth no one can measure. The verses are read in Hindi and English.

The verse states that unlimited living entities in 8,400,000 species wander throughout the universe. Maharaj reads the translation and purport, pausing on the point that this directly challenges scientists and philosophers who presume life exists only on this planet.
Maharaj points to Bhagavad-gita 2.24: the living entity is sarva-gata, all-pervading, which he explains to mean it can go anywhere — so there is no reason to restrict life to one planet.

Maharaj frames the whole verse as a challenge to the scientists and philosophers. Those who went to the moon and reported no life there simply contradict what the Vedic literature says.

🎙 Maharaj at 11:40 (auto-transcript): “this is a challenge to the scientists and the philosophers Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes.”

Maharaj teaches that living entities are sprayed across the whole brahmanda — some species here, some there, some outside — plants, trees, insects, and beings in fire and water alike.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:42 (auto-transcript): “They are sprayed everywhere, everywhere in the whole Brahmand. Some species here, some species there, some species outside. The same with plants and trees. Insects. They are spread all over the places. Vishnu Purana has the calculation. Everywhere you go,”

Maharaj says the Vishnu Purana gives the calculation of species, and quotes the line counting 900,000 aquatics. Wherever you go, even into fire, living entities are there.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:18 (auto-transcript): “Vishnu Purana has the calculation. Everywhere you go, in the fire, living entities are there. In the water, Varit is a living entity. Jalajjar Nagar Lakshani, 900,000 aquatics. They go to the ocean. So scientists went to the ocean, they didn't find Varuna.”

Scientists went down into the ocean and did not find Varuna, the presiding deity of the waters. Maharaj's answer is simple: Varuna is there; not finding him says nothing about his existence.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:55 (auto-transcript): “They go to the ocean. So scientists went to the ocean, they didn't find Varuna. Varuna is there. Even within our own experience There are no varieties of fish there in the water No In the water no varieties of fish Water entities are not only fish Snakes also live in the…”

Even from our own experience there are endless varieties in the water — not only fish but snakes and four-legged animals. Maharaj says people from the village know these things, while the scientists know nothing, and yet the world worships them. — “but scientists doesn't know anything”

🎙 Maharaj at 14:32 (auto-transcript): “Snakes also live in the water there are four-legged animals who live in the water varieties we from village we know these things but scientists doesn't know anything foolish people But the world is worshipping them. There are varieties of fishes in the water.”

Maharaj's analogy: if a scientist tells a fisherman there are no fish in the water, who will take him seriously? The fisherman catches fish every day. Saying there is no life on the moon means only that they did not actually go there.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:47 (auto-transcript): “If a scientist tells a fisherman No, but it's a fish in the water. Who will they look at him? Because they are catching fish every day, they are catching fish every day, so how can you say that they are not? They are everywhere, entities everywhere.”

children.topic: Qualification to be in a place
children.note:
To be in a particular place one needs the qualities for it. Maharaj says those claiming to have gone to the moon lacked the qualification, and so either did not go or could not perceive what is there. — “One has to have the qualities to be in a particular place.”

🎙 Maharaj at 17:36 (auto-transcript): “One has to have the qualities to be in a particular place. So they don't have the qualifications to go there. They thought they did not go there. And there is a document, this is a document to prove that they didn't go there. They are just law of us. i say he killed him right…”

children.topic: Bodies of mind, intelligence, false ego
children.note:
Beings on other planets have forms made of different elements. Maharaj asks whether a gross person can see an entity whose body is made of mind, intelligence and false ego — no.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:31 (auto-transcript): “forms composed of different elements. The entities who have their body made of mind intelligence and force, will a gross person see? No. We say, disembodied beings, disembodied beings. Disembodied beings means they have a subtle body.”

What people call disembodied beings are not bodiless; they have a subtle body of mind, intelligence and false ego, only without the gross covering. — “Disembodied beings means they have a subtle body.”

🎙 Maharaj at 19:57 (auto-transcript): “We say, disembodied beings, disembodied beings. Disembodied beings means they have a subtle body. Made of mind, intelligence and false ego. Not the gross one. They don't have the gross one. Remember? When Chaitanya Mahaprabhu appeared. And Demigod all came.”

Maharaj recalls that when Caitanya Mahaprabhu appeared, the demigods came to take darsan of the Lord. People sensed someone passing and called a priest to chant mantras to drive them off, while the demigods looked on and laughed.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:35 (auto-transcript): “When Chaitanya Mahaprabhu appeared. And Demigod all came. Oh. Take darsan of the Supreme Presity of Godhead. and sometimes people were noticing someone is passing here someone is passing so they call for a priest to come and chant mantra they sing a mantra was chanting the…”

In the same way, Maharaj says, the Vedic student laughs at the scientists and philosophers, because they are talking nonsense when they deny the varieties of beings living in the air without gross bodies. — “They will laugh at the scientists and the philosophers.”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:12 (auto-transcript): “the student, the Vedic student, the Vedic student, They will laugh at the scientists and the philosophers. Because they are talking nonsense. There are varieties who live in the air. They don't have the gross element. when his soul leaves the gross body he sighs”

children.topic: The subtle body takes the punishment
children.note:
When the soul leaves the gross body it carries the subtle body of mind, intelligence and false ego, and that is the body taken to hell to undergo punishment. The gross body could not bear it; the subtle body does. So the Vedas are correct.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:49 (auto-transcript): “when his soul leaves the gross body he sighs the body made of my intelligence and falsely go that body we take to hell and we will be able to undergo the punishment The gross body would not take it. The subtle body would take it. So the Vedas are correct.”

Maharaj goes through the classical division of species, explaining each category and adding the figures up to eight million four hundred thousand.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:55 (auto-transcript): “There are 900,000 aquatics living in the water. There are also two million non-moving living entities. Stavara, Laksh, Bhimzati.”

Two million non-moving entities, the sthavara: those who stand in one place, that is, plants and trees.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:37 (auto-transcript): “Stavara, Laksh, Bhimzati. Stavara. Stavara. Yes. The entities who stand in one place. Plant and trees. There are also 1,100,000 species of insects and reptiles. And there are 1,000,000 species of birds. As far as quadruples and quadrupeds are concerned, there are 3,000,000…”

900,000 aquatics, 2,000,000 plants and trees, 1,100,000 insects and reptiles, 1,000,000 birds, 3,000,000 four-legged animals, and 400,000 human species — eight million four hundred thousand in all.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:03 (auto-transcript): “There are also 1,100,000 species of insects and reptiles. And there are 1,000,000 species of birds. As far as quadruples and quadrupeds are concerned, there are 3,000,000 varieties, that is animals. 1 million is birds 1 million 100 is insects Reptiles That is 8 million”

Maharaj draws attention to the fact that the human species, at 400,000, is the smallest of all the categories. — “So human species is the smallest”

🎙 Maharaj at 26:52 (auto-transcript): “There are 400,000 human species So human species is the smallest and they are the ones who have trouble the most animals don't have starvation starvation is only with the human species nor the moon he said he has troubled the whole He was associated with all species of life.”

children.topic: The smallest species, the most trouble
children.note:
Though fewest in kind, human beings are the ones in the most trouble. Maharaj contrasts us with the animals, who do not suffer the problems we create for ourselves.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:01 (auto-transcript): “and they are the ones who have trouble the most animals don't have starvation starvation is only with the human species nor the moon he said he has troubled the whole He was associated with all species of life. And his experience is that the most miserable of all are human…”

Animals do not have starvation; starvation belongs to the human species alone. Maharaj cites the experience of one who associated with all species of life and found human beings the most miserable. — “starvation is only with the human species”

🎙 Maharaj at 27:06 (auto-transcript): “animals don't have starvation starvation is only with the human species nor the moon he said he has troubled the whole He was associated with all species of life. And his experience is that the most miserable of all are human beings.”

We, the 400,000 species, are the ones talking about overpopulation; no one speaks of overpopulation or poverty among the three million animal species. Maharaj asks what explains this, and answers: karma.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:55 (auto-transcript): “We are the ones who talk about overpopulation. I can give you overpopulation for 100,000 and not 3 million. No, overpopulation for 3 million. Overpopulation for 400,000. Stabation for 400,000. Poverty. 400,000. There is no property for animals. What is that?”

children.topic: Purana — the soul is always old
children.note:
From the Gita's word purana, Maharaj explains that the soul is very old, never new. When we look at a baby and call it new, we are seeing only the body.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:38 (auto-transcript): “means very old, not new, not new, what is new, when they say baby, what are you looking at, baby, not the body, not the soul, the soul is purana, but the body is new baby new baby is old this old man not new nothing is new the body is”

The body is new or old, but the soul is always old. The baby is an old soul in a new body; nothing about the self is new. — “but the soul is always old”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:00 (auto-transcript): “but the body is new baby new baby is old this old man not new nothing is new the body is new and old but the soul is always old for the soul there is neither birth nor death”

Bhagavad-gita 2.20: the soul has no birth and no death, it never came into being and never will, and it is not slain when the body is slain. Maharaj adds the Hindi: the jivatma is both ananta and anadi.

Among the 400,000 human species, Maharaj says, many have sankucita — constricted — consciousness, not open, like trees and plants. Even within humans the consciousness is not yet fully human.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:28 (auto-transcript): “So within the 400,000. wouldn't this 100,000 we have sankuchita constricted constricted consciousness consciousness is not open Like trees and plants. Even within humans. So means 200,000 is of human.”

Sankucita means constricted: consciousness that is not open. Maharaj applies the word not only to plants but to a large part of the human species.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:40 (auto-transcript): “sankuchita constricted constricted consciousness consciousness is not open Like trees and plants. Even within humans. So means 200,000 is of human. Within the 400,000 human.”

children.topic: The acaryas' principles make us human
children.note:
Because we lack the qualities of a human being, our acaryas gave us principles to keep in order to make us human. They are not a punishment; they are meant for freedom. — “They are meant for freedom.”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:42 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, our achara gave us principles to keep, to make us human beings. So, intelligent persons should keep to these principles. They are not punishment. They are meant for freedom. So, should keep these principles. Joyfully. So be free.”

Intelligent persons keep these principles, and keep them joyfully — and so become free.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:13 (auto-transcript): “So, should keep these principles. Joyfully. So be free. A man's, even within a species, we find that a father's consciousness is different from his son's”

Closing the purport, Maharaj restates the law of transmigration: we move from one body to another according to our consciousness, as a father's consciousness differs from his son's and a child's from a youth's. He ends early to attend a meeting.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:08 (auto-transcript): “We change from one body to another in terms of our consciousness. Salafabhupadiki. Yeah. All right. I have to go for my meeting. I will see you tomorrow. Hare Krishna. Hare Krishna.”

nodeData.topic: Day 19 · Can We Measure the Size of the Soul?
nodeData.note: CC Madhya 19.139–142 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. The soul is one ten-thousandth of the tip of a hair, yet that spark runs an ant and runs Brahma, and builds aircraft. Maharaj draws out the lesson: our body and situation come from our own desires, so use this life to earn a spiritual body, and surrender. The Q&A covers why comfort makes practice hard, whether suffering is Krishna's plan or our karma, rigid sadhana without holidays, preaching to oneself, and whether a liberated soul remembers its past. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: Today: how small is the soul?
children.note: Maharaj continues Madhya-lila chapter 19 from text 139, where Mahaprabhu tells Sanatana Gosvami the dimension of the living entity. The verses are read with Hindi translation.

children.topic: 19.139 — One ten-thousandth of a hair tip
children.note: The verse gives the measure of the soul: divide a hair tip into a hundred, and one of those into a hundred again. Srila Prabhupada's purport ties it to Bhagavad-gita 15.7, where Krishna calls the living entities his eternal fragments.

children.topic: Can anyone split a hair tip?
children.note:
Maharaj asks the room: take a piece of hair, not your long hair, and cut it into a hundred. Can anyone do it? Someone says scientists can. Then how will you take one piece out and divide that again? We do not have that power, but Krishna does.

🎙 Maharaj at 10:19 (auto-transcript): “If we divide the tip of a hair into a hundred parts, can anyone do that? Scientists can do it. Not your long hair Not your long hair Just a piece of the hair You cut it into one hundred And can you do that? Anyone can do that? Then how will you take one piece out of it?”

children.topic: Krishna tells us our own size
children.note:
Krishna gives this measure so that we understand what we are: so insignificant that we cannot even be calculated materially. Only Krishna could measure us, and he did.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:25 (auto-transcript): “So for us, Krishna is trying to let us understand how important we are, Hare Krishna. But so important, So great that we are very insignificant, very insignificant, but we are bewildered by illusion. To think that we are six feet tall, five point eight.”

children.topic: Six feet tall is an illusion
children.note:
To think I am five foot eight or six feet is illusion. We are tiny, and bewildered by identification with the body.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:08 (auto-transcript): “To think that we are six feet tall, five point eight. that is an illusion we are not 5 feet, 6 feet or 50 point something very insignificant very insignificant yet because we are spiritual spark of Krishna this is the priests We can create a mighty Boeing aircraft.”

Because we are sparks of Krishna, that tiny particle can design a mighty aircraft and fly it far above the sea. That capacity is spirit, not matter. — “We can create a mighty Boeing aircraft.”

🎙 Maharaj at 13:45 (auto-transcript): “because we are spiritual spark of Krishna this is the priests We can create a mighty Boeing aircraft. They will fly it is 37,000 kilometers above the sea level. That is spirit.”

Maharaj dwells on the purport's point that one atomic portion of spirit can be the biggest brain in the material world. The same spark is in an ant and in Brahma, and Brahma's brain, big as an elephant, is made of the same twenty-four elements as the ant's. Yet Brahma's soul is still one ten-thousandth of a hair tip.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:44 (auto-transcript): “Spiritual strength is so powerful that the main atomic portion of spirit can be the biggest brain in the material world. the size of an insignificant”

Everyone's tongue is made of the same elements, yet our tastes differ, because the quantity and quality of the mixture differ. That is how Brahma's intelligence differs from ours while the soul stays the same size.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:37 (auto-transcript): “See, looking at the Brahman's intelligence, All of us have different tastes. But our tongue contains the same elements. The elements are the same. But the quantity of this and the quality differs. That's the Brahma's position. And it's a tiny entity.”

If the tiny soul has such strength, how can we hope to grasp the mighty Supreme Person by our own effort? Maharaj answers: we can understand him only by his mercy. — “We can understand him only by his mercy.”

🎙 Maharaj at 16:56 (auto-transcript): “so if we can do this what about a mighty, supreme presence of God. How do we hope to understand such person? We can understand him only by his mercy. See, looking at the Brahman's intelligence,”

children.topic: We are limited, he is unlimited
children.note:
Brahma is a tiny entity with enormous capacity; the Lord is unlimited, ananta. That contrast between limited and unlimited is what spirit means.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:18 (auto-transcript): “And it's a tiny entity. What about the muscle of Brahma? Unlimited. Anand. We are limited but he is unlimited. That is spirit. The spiritual strength is so powerful that a main atomic portion of spirit can be the biggest brain in the material world. The same spiritual spark…”

children.topic: Body and birth come from desire
children.note:
The different bodies, species and places we are born into all rest on our own desires. Our next situation is set by our present activities. If someone is high and someone low, it is not Krishna who did it; it is we who wanted positions. — “all are based on our desires”

🎙 Maharaj at 20:23 (auto-transcript): “the different bodies which we have different species which we are placed in geographical considerations all are based on our desires our desires has given us where we are now. Our next situation is also determined by our present activities.”

Understanding this, we can plan a next life better than this one. Not understanding it, we grow envious of others, complicate our situation, and the next life is worse.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:22 (auto-transcript): “this will be clearly understood because if we know this we will plan the next life to be better than the present one if we don't understand this we will implicate ourselves more by becoming envious of others will complicate the situation and the next life will be worse than…”

children.topic: Rsabhadeva: a big mistake already made
children.note:
Maharaj cites the advice of Lord Rsabhadeva: accepting the body we now have was already a great mistake, so an intelligent person does not use this body to earn another material body.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:09 (auto-transcript): “so Lord Buddha Savadev has given us advice we have already made a very big mistake accepting the body we have now a big mistake an intelligent person should not use this body to get another material body advancement means we are using the present body to get a better body”

Advancement is using the present body to get the special body that takes us back to Godhead. If you see someone intelligent, it means he is working for a spiritual body next life. That is why we study scripture: it lets us modify our activities so that spiritual life succeeds.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:41 (auto-transcript): “advancement means we are using the present body to get a better body that is called success get a special body that will take us back home back to Godhead if you see someone is intelligent means the person is working for a spiritual body in next life that's the importance of…”

A second scriptural statement of the same dimension, dividing the hair tip twice. Maharaj notes that the first lines come through the Pancadasi from Svetasvatara Upanisad 5.9, one of the chief Vedic mantras.

children.topic: 19.141 — Among the subtle, I am the jiva
children.note: Krishna's own words from Srimad Bhagavatam 11.16.11: he identifies himself with the living entity, who is one in quality with him and yet the smallest of the small while he is the biggest of the big.

We are all Krishna's parts, amsa, and eternal as he is. But here we are in a different situation: conditioned, controlled by another energy, without freedom. Our freedom exists only with Krishna. — “Our freedom is only with Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 27:12 (auto-transcript): “Krishna identifies himself with us, the living entities. Krishna is saying that all these things are the same in life. Krishna is saying that all of us are his part, Amsa are his part. we are all eternal”

children.topic: The point of it all: surrender
children.note:
These instructions are given so we can see our situation clearly. The conclusion is to surrender completely to Krishna and be delivered from the grip of material nature. — “we are meant to surrender ourselves completely to Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:56 (auto-transcript): “So, we are getting the instructions so we can understand our situation. At the end, we are meant to surrender ourselves completely to Krishna. There is the idea of this instruction. If we surrender to Krishna, and become delivered from the clutches of material nature. Hare…”

Five questions from the audience, several asked in both English and Hindi.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:38 (auto-transcript): “Comments, questions? Yeah, question. Thank you, Shri. I have a question from Deshares. I see that when there's difficulty At that time, it's easier to pray and take care of the scriptures. But when these difficulties are not there, at that time, it's more tough to focus and…”

children.topic: Q1 · Prayer is easy in trouble, hard in comfort
children.note:
In difficulty it is easy to pray and turn to scripture; when life is peaceful it is hard to practise intensely. How to practise with intensity when there are no difficulties?

🎙 Maharaj at 29:55 (auto-transcript): “Thank you, Shri. I have a question from Deshares. I see that when there's difficulty At that time, it's easier to pray and take care of the scriptures. But when these difficulties are not there, at that time, it's more tough to focus and pray intensely. So, in that situation,…”

Maharaj's blunt answer: a devotee with no challenges is not advancing. He is sleeping soundly on the lap of Maya. — “A devotee who has no challenges is not making an advancement.”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:52 (auto-transcript): “A devotee who has no challenges is not making an advancement. He is sleeping sound on the lap of Maya. Kunti Devi is not a fool she's not pretending”

Queen Kunti was no fool and was not pretending. She asked Krishna for more problems, because problems made her call on him constantly, and when she called he was with her. So if we have no challenges, Maharaj says, ask for them.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:28 (auto-transcript): “Kunti Devi is not a fool she's not pretending she was sure what she's doing she said but Krishna give me more problems because problems help me to call on you and to constantly calling on you I am always with you”

Maharaj recalls a disciple reporting many temple problems and the guru replying, very good; had everything been fine, he would have created a problem himself. Maharaj adds that the first time in his life he went to the police and to court was after he became a devotee.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:39 (auto-transcript): “Prabhu, how is your temple? So Gurudev saw most problem Gurudev said that's very good If he had told me that everything is fine Paul, I've created one problem for you. Want to be his disciple? Do you want to take an instruction from him? When he's dancing, I smell it. This is…”

children.topic: Looking for a cool room in a burning house
children.note:
His guru told him: you are a fool, living in a burning house and looking for a room to sleep peacefully. Whatever room you pick, the fire reaches it. The intelligent thing is to get out. Where is peace in this world? Anyone looking for it here is a fool. — “So anyone who is looking for peace is a fool.”

🎙 Maharaj at 34:25 (auto-transcript): “he told me, you are a fool. You are living in a burning house and you want to find a war room and sleep peacefully there. Will you sleep peacefully there? How long will you sleep there? The house is on fire. Any room you take to sleep in, the fire will get there. Is that…”

To the follow-up about stopping practice and returning: you restart from where you left off. Our past piety was small, so our interest in Krishna was small; we take Maya's punches, make offences, leave, come back, many times. What was practised is not erased. Keep going and you grow stronger and eventually succeed.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:22 (auto-transcript): “If you stop practicing, that was the question, you stop practicing for the time being, then you come back. Yes, you make advancement from where you start. For us to come to Christian consciousness. We have had a lot of ups and downs. Because our previous poverty is very small.”

children.topic: Q2 · Krishna's plan or my karma?
children.note:
When a devotee faces difficulty, how to tell whether it is the Lord testing and teaching, or simply the fruit of one's own desires and karma?

🎙 Maharaj at 40:14 (auto-transcript): “is asking the difficulties. So in the devotee lives, if you face difficulty, how to differentiate that it's God's plan, or it's our karma, desire, that life we are suffering. In the devotee life also. How to differentiate God is testing and God is looking at this depression…”

children.topic: A sincere sadhaka is in Krishna's hands
children.note:
For a devotee chanting sixteen rounds daily, avoiding offences, keeping discipline and a fixed service, whatever happens is arranged by Krishna directly, not by Durga. Such a fortunate devotee says: Krishna, thank you.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:43 (auto-transcript): “The devotee who is chanting Siksniyran daily. Trying to avoid offenses Keeping the effort and good discipline”

From the purports to Bhagavad-gita 12.13–14: a devotee in distress takes it as the Lord's mercy. He never asks, Krishna, why me, are you really God? He thinks: for my past misdeeds I should suffer far more; by his mercy I get only a little. So he stays calm, quiet and patient.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:27 (auto-transcript): “Whenever a devotee is in distress or has fallen into difficulty Is Bhagavad Gita chapter 12, text 13 and 14 purports He thinks that it is the Lord's mercy upon him. A devotee does say, Krishna, why am I suffering like this? Why? I'm so pure.”

A neophyte's position is said to be dangerous because he does not know how to deal with others. How does one rise from kanistha to madhyama?

🎙 Maharaj at 46:29 (auto-transcript): “So if you could just elaborate more on how does one of the neophytes place to the level of Madhyama. So, now my question is that Shavadir says that if a non-seekhya bhakt or a new bhakt, tanish bhakt is very dangerous and dangerous because we don't know how to deal with it.…”

Maharaj's answer is two words repeated: rigid practice. No compromise. That is the way to advance.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:20 (auto-transcript): “Rigid practice. Rigid practice. No compromise. That is the way for advancement. Today I'm not going to work. So I can wake up by 6 o'clock.”

He mimics the mind: today I am not working, so I will wake at six instead of three, I can chant later. No. Mangala-arati is at the same hour every day. Prabhupada's phrase is not falling down in all circumstances: no break, no recreation, no holiday, fixed. By constant practice we transcend the modes. — “Brahma Muhurta doesn't have holiday.”

🎙 Maharaj at 47:44 (auto-transcript): “Today I'm not going to work. So I can wake up by 6 o'clock. Instead of 3 o'clock. No, 6 o'clock. I'm not going to work today. So I have time. You can't chant it later. Every day is the same.”

We are practising what we will do eternally with Krishna, and Krishna takes no day off from the cows. Even when Mother Yasoda told him not to go to the forest, he went. That is the strength of following one's dharma.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:01 (auto-transcript): “Actually, we are practicing what we are going to do eternally with Krishna. Krishna has a holiday. One day no cowherding. No cowherding. One day. Even when a mother is water, told Krishna, don't go to the forest today. Krishna said, I will disobey you.”

Waking every day, you say you are tired. It is not you; the body and the mind are tired. The spirit soul is cetana, conscious, and nitya, eternal. — “It's a question of tiredness, the body, the mind, not the soul.”

🎙 Maharaj at 53:17 (auto-transcript): “Every day I wake up you are tired you get what it is not you who is tired your body is tired your mind is tired but not you the soul the spirit soul is cheta cheta means conscious nitya eternally It's a question of tiredness, the body, the mind, not the soul.”

children.topic: Q4 · Strict sadhana, yet still offences
children.note:
Some seem to follow all the rules but keep committing offences in their dealings and do not progress. Alongside rigid sadhana, how does one work on consciousness to become offenceless?

🎙 Maharaj at 54:28 (auto-transcript): “be looking like they are following all the instructions, but then they are committing offences and then thereby they don't have progress. So while in having the rigid sadhana, how does one work on the consciousness so that the dealings are known, the proper way of dealing, so…”

When we preach, the first person we address is the self. Maharaj's example: if someone announces that all devotees should come tomorrow, the first person we look for in the morning is the one who made the announcement. So when we read, we should think, I must apply this in my life. — “So we are talking, we are preaching to ourselves.”

🎙 Maharaj at 55:41 (auto-transcript): “I was telling him, you know, when we preach, whom are we talking to the first the first person we are talking to when we preach the self the self I am talking to me myself I have said this for example all devotees will be here tomorrow So when you come here tomorrow morning,…”

children.topic: From vaidhi to raga, gross to subtle
children.note:
We stay on the gross level because we do not apply to ourselves what we hear, read and speak. Practise it internally and it becomes real. What we speak must exist in us; that is why pure devotees change their hearers, while otherwise we only entertain people's intellect.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:09 (auto-transcript): “This is how we would transmigrate from Vaidhi to Viraka Bhakti. from gross to subtle gross to subtle the problem is that we are remaining on the gross level we are not progressing to the next level because we are not applying it to ourselves when we hear something we read…”

children.topic: You are with whoever you think of
children.note:
As we practise, devotees at that level become attractive to us and we appreciate their bhakti. Whoever you think about, you are with that person, and what is in them transfers to you according to the depth of the connection.

🎙 Maharaj at 58:43 (auto-transcript): “naturally the devotees who on that level become attractive to us we will be appreciating their level of bhakti so we are establishing the connection whoever you think about you are with that person Whatever is going on, would that be seen also be transferred to you? According…”

children.topic: Q5 · Does a liberated soul remember this life?
children.note:
The last question: once a soul reaches Goloka and gets a spiritual body, does it forget everything about its past life?

🎙 Maharaj at 59:36 (auto-transcript): “Daksha Bhatt, last question. Daksha Bhatt, where is our question? Kari Bhatt, much for the wonderful class. that once a soul attain a special world like Gokro, so they get a special body. So my question in this regard is that after saving that body, do that person forget…”

children.topic: The beggar who became a billionaire
children.note:
A poor man who becomes a billionaire does not sit remembering that he slept on a bridge. You move from a two-bedroom flat to a palace and the flat is out of your head. For a pure devotee there is nothing here worth remembering; who likes to recall a bad dream? — “who likes to remember a bad dream”

🎙 Maharaj at 60:11 (auto-transcript): “If a poor person becomes a billionaire, do you remember yesterday do you remember I was sleeping on a bridge do you remember”

children.topic: Don't dig up a pure devotee's past
children.note:
To tell someone, I know you slept on that bridge, is offensive; likewise saying a pure devotee was once poor or came to Krishna out of distress. Dhruva wanted a kingdom, Gajendra was in distress, but the Lord sent his own carrier for Gajendra rather than a separate one. Now he is a pure soul, and one second of that joy wipes out years of poverty. — “Therefore, we don't look at the life of a pure devotee.”

🎙 Maharaj at 62:11 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, we don't look at the life of a pure devotee. Oh, pure devotee was very very poor before. It's an offense. Right? Dhruva Mahara wanted the kingdom He was looking for position Gajendra was in distress But now he is sitting on a vaikuntha No, not just vaikuntha airplane”

nodeData.topic: Day 20 · Our So-Called Advancement in Science
nodeData.note: CC Madhya 19.143–144 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Living entities exist everywhere — in earth, water, air and even fire — each with a body suited to its element, and they are unlimited in number, divided into the moving and the non-moving. Maharaj uses the frog in the well to show why scientists, philosophers and politicians cannot measure the unlimited, and insists that real knowledge comes from the Vedas and the acaryas. A question on why devotees should study the universal form leads to the Vrajavasis who wanted only the two-handed son of Nanda. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: 19.143 — Living entities everywhere, even in fire
children.note: The recording opens inside the purport, where Gita 2.24 is being read: the soul cannot be cut, burned or dried, so living beings can exist in any element. Mahaprabhu's verse says the living entities are found all over the universe, in every kind of body.

children.topic: A body fit for its element
children.note:
Maharaj asks the room what the bodies of those living in fire are made of — not earth, not water, but fire, ether and air — so they live there as peacefully as fish live in water. Our body is predominantly earth, so earth is where we are comfortable. The sun-god lives in fire quite comfortably.

🎙 Maharaj at 02:29 (auto-transcript): “living entities are there their body does not have an element does it have water element the body is made of fire ether and air so they can live peacefully in the fire like the sun god”

Go to the watery region and tell all the fish and aquatics that there is no place but water: they will believe you, because water is all they have ever seen. This sets up the frog story.

🎙 Maharaj at 04:09 (auto-transcript): “if you go to the watery region apart from Varunadev and he tells all the fish and all the varieties of aquatics there is no other place except water there is no other place except water they will believe they will believe you they will believe that there is no other place…”

Maharaj tells the classic story: a frog from the ocean visits a frog in a small well and invites him to come and see a bigger body of water. The well-frog can only ask — two of this size? three? — because 'unlimited' does not exist in his dictionary.

🎙 Maharaj at 05:05 (auto-transcript): “a frog in a small well so another frog from the ocean prayed the visit and they were discussing so the friend from the ocean said I would like you to come and visit me You see a bigger body of water than this one. What? What? You get on this? How big is that?”

Maharaj asks what the ocean frog thinks of his friend: not that he is lying, but that he is ignorant — a foolish friend trying to calculate the ocean with his own limited ability. What is his qualification to measure the ocean's water?

🎙 Maharaj at 06:02 (auto-transcript): “What the frog from the ocean would be thinking about the frog in the world? Who is he thinking? Not lie. Ignorance. This is my foolish friend. He doesn't know anything. want to calculate the ocean by its own limited ability what is the qualification to calculate the water in…”

Speak to Varuna about the ocean and he knows exactly what it is; he has the bigger facility and intelligence. When we say 'ocean' we mean unlimited, but for the frog only the limited exists.

🎙 Maharaj at 06:46 (auto-transcript): “but if you tell Baruna about ocean it's fine what it is He has a bigger facility intelligence to understand when we say ocean what are we looking at? When we say ocean what are we looking at? Unlimited It's unlimited It's unlimited Unlimited ocean”

For Mahaprabhu and the Gita it is not difficult to say that living entities are everywhere, moving and non-moving. Our job is to hear from them rather than measure from inside our well. — “So we should not be like a frog in the well.”

🎙 Maharaj at 08:35 (auto-transcript): “So it's not difficult for them to understand. So we should not be like a frog in the well. Our scientists are frog in the well. Because they don't have the brain to understand how unlimited is Krishna. So they should consult the Vedas. and the acharyas, then they can…”

children.topic: Scientists are frogs in the well
children.note:
Maharaj applies the story directly: our scientists are frogs in the well, lacking the brain to grasp how unlimited Krishna is. They should consult the Vedas and the acaryas; otherwise there is no question of understanding.

🎙 Maharaj at 08:47 (auto-transcript): “Our scientists are frog in the well. Because they don't have the brain to understand how unlimited is Krishna. So they should consult the Vedas. and the acharyas, then they can understand, otherwise there is no question of understanding. In the material world, our advancement…”

What does advancement mean in the material world? Maharaj answers that what we call progress is only an expansion of ignorance — still ignorance, however big it grows. — “It is not advancement, it is still expansion of ignorance.”

🎙 Maharaj at 09:24 (auto-transcript): “In the material world, our advancement means what? Advancement is what we are preparing for, how do we make this expansion of ignorance? It is still ignorance. It is not advancement, it is still expansion of ignorance. We are considering this advancement. What is advancement?”

He died — burst trying to imagine the ocean. In the same way, Maharaj says, the froggy scientist who tries to understand Krishna with a limited brain is dead; he repeats the word 'dead' for effect.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:39 (auto-transcript): “What happened to the frog in the world? He died. The same way, a froggy scientist you are dead dead froggy scientists dead thinking to understand Krishna dead how many of you have read”

Asked what advancement is, the room offers 'skyscrapers'. Maharaj replies that a skyscraper here is only the reflection of what is in Vaikuntha, and the reflection looks identical to the original — you cannot see the difference, because the original is real.

🎙 Maharaj at 10:10 (auto-transcript): “Skyscrapers. What is it? Skyscrapers and Vekuntha. What is it? Skyscrapers and Vekuntha and the reflection of the skyscraper in Vaikuntha. The reflection, the reflection, the reflection of a skyscraper in Vaikuntha is the same.”

children.topic: Old devotees laugh at new ones
children.note:
Maharaj cites an acarya: when new devotees reach Vaikuntha the older residents laugh, because the newcomers cannot tell the real building from its shadow, while the old devotees know which is the true beauty. The ocean frog laughs at the well frog in the same way.

🎙 Maharaj at 11:14 (auto-transcript): “When new devotees visit Vaikuntha, the old devotees will be laughing at them. See them. Why are they laughing? they can't see the difference between the shadow and the real building they can't see the difference the old devotees know this is the main beauty and this is the…”

Maharaj asks how many have read Brahma-samhita and what they understood. Most know only one line. He presses: what is the quadrangle, the triangle described there? Silence.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:23 (auto-transcript): “how many of you have read Brahma Samhita how many what did you understand what did you understand yes that is the only one line that you understand that's the only one line that is the best thing”

children.topic: Open the book, close it back
children.note:
That is what we do, he says: open the book, put something inside, close it again. Those who understand a little are those who at least attended a seminar on Brahma-samhita.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:12 (auto-transcript): “that is what you put inside open the book you close it back therefore those who who have little understanding and those who have attended a seminar on Brahma Samhita those who are little just little they have attended seminar on Brahma Samhita”

children.topic: We can't even follow the English
children.note:
Our brain cannot follow Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati's English commentary; it cracks the head. If we cannot grasp that, what to speak of scientists who know nothing of the conclusion — so listen to Mahaprabhu, who explains these details.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:58 (auto-transcript): “Our brain cannot understand bhakti-siddhanta Saraswati's English. So, trying to understand it, to crack your head, that is our scientists they know nothing of the conviction therefore you should listen to sri chetan maha-prabhu”
Mahaprabhu continues: the living entities are unlimited and fall into two divisions, the moving and the non-moving.

Maharaj asks: are we unlimited? Someone answers 'a number', which is what he wanted. Each of us is a limited living entity; it is the count across the universes that is unlimited. — “The unlimited here is not our size, it's the number.”

🎙 Maharaj at 17:21 (auto-transcript): “here. Are we unlimited? We are only unlimited? It's written here, the unlimited living entities. So we are unlimited? A number, thank you, that's what I was going to say. The unlimited here is not our size, it's the number. We are all limited living entities all over the…”

The Padma Purana gives the number of species of plants and trees as two million, and they are not all on this planet — they are spread across the universe, some here, some there.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:18 (auto-transcript): “according to Padma Purana plant and trees how many species plant and trees plant and trees plant and trees 2 million 2 million they are all on this planet this planet is spread all over the universe some you get here some you get there some you get to other places”

Mahaprabhu gives the training: the moving beings are birds, beasts and aquatics; the non-moving are plants, trees and mountains. Maharaj remarks that mountains once moved but are now stationary. This is what the Padma Purana says, and we are simply repeating it.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:17 (auto-transcript): “and she Chaitanya Mahaprabhu is giving these training so in two divisions those that can move and those that cannot move among living entities that can move they are birds cortex and anus and the entities that cannot move they plant the trees these days”

The conclusion of the class: our knowledge should come from the Vedas, not from scientists, philosophers or politicians. With scripture we are complete. — “So we should take our knowledge from the Vedas.”

🎙 Maharaj at 20:42 (auto-transcript): “So we should take our knowledge from the Vedas. not from the scientists please not from the philosophers please not from the philosophers not from scientists not from politicians these three people are dangerous take our knowledge from the scriptures then we are complete with…”

Maharaj names scientists, philosophers and politicians as three classes of people who are dangerous as sources of knowledge, repeating 'please' as he rules each out.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:55 (auto-transcript): “not from the philosophers not from scientists not from politicians these three people are dangerous take our knowledge from the scriptures then we are complete with that so Chaitanya Mahaprabhu is teaching so we can understand exactly where we are is the beauty of studying…”

The beauty of studying scripture is that it tells us exactly where we are in the universe, what the supreme position of God is, and what our relationship with him is.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:15 (auto-transcript): “then we are complete with that so Chaitanya Mahaprabhu is teaching so we can understand exactly where we are is the beauty of studying the scriptures the scriptures clearly teach us where we are in the universe what is the position of the supreme position of God what is our…”

children.topic: Q1 · Why study the universal form at all?
children.note:
In the Second Canto Prabhupada calls Narada's mind a frog in the well when he thinks Brahma is all-powerful. If so, why do we need to know the universal form, the Vaikuntha and Goloka charts, Ksirodakasayi Visnu and the rest?

🎙 Maharaj at 23:00 (auto-transcript): “if this frog in the wealth analogy is described in the second canto where in the naraji saying where naraji's doubt like in his mind he's thinking that brahmaji is all powerful and so to describe that Narajji as thinking as like the considering Narajji as frog in the well so…”

children.topic: Not for pure devotees — for us
children.note:
Maharaj answers that these descriptions are not necessary for pure devotees. They are there to convince people like us that Krishna is Supreme.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:00 (auto-transcript): “It is not necessary for pure devotees for their own devotee. It is necessary to convince us that Swamodhi is Supreme. A pure deity is not necessary.”

children.topic: Vaikuntha was a nightmare for Vraja
children.note:
When Krishna took the Vrajavasis to see Vaikuntha, their pain only increased — what is this? It was a nightmare for them, and they were relieved when Krishna took it away and stood before them again with two hands.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:52 (auto-transcript): “Should the universe have formed the Vrajwasis? They were in pain. What is this? Krishna took them to Vaikuntha. Your pain increased. He showed them 400... Oh, what is this? It's a nightmare. you see the anxiety and Krishna removed all that and back to her for two hands.”

The cowherd boys told Krishna that when he merely ran behind a tree during play they felt unbearable pain — so how would they tolerate his going to Mathura? Some of us, Maharaj notes, feel no separation at all; that is why we need the convincing.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:07 (auto-transcript): “who don't feel pain or separation from krishna so we need these things to convince us to look for kristana the covered boys they told krishna when we are playing with you in the course of our play when you just run behind a tree you will feel so much pain for this short…”

When Krishna showed the searching gopis a four-armed form they bowed to Narayana and asked for a blessing — to get the son of Nanda Maharaja. You are God, fine, but we have nothing to do with that; show us our Krishna. So the universal displays are for the rest of us. — “They don't need four hands.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:28 (auto-transcript): “They don't need four hands. When Gopis were looking for Krishna, and Krishna showed him four hands, Oh Narayana. nodeData.topic: Day 20 (second upload) · continued
nodeData.note: CC Madhya 19.143–144 (continued) · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Picking up mid-class with the frog-in-the-well analogy, Maharaj argues that limited brains cannot measure the unlimited: scientists, philosophers and politicians are frogs, and real knowledge comes from the Vedas, the acaryas and Mahaprabhu. He then reads 19.144 — unlimited living entities in moving and non-moving divisions — and answers a question on why devotees need to study the universal form at all. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Maharaj continues the analogy: the frog in the well asks how big the ocean is — two of this, three of this? To the frog from the ocean he is simply a foolish friend trying to calculate the ocean with a limited ability. Maharaj asks the room what qualification he has to measure it.

🎙 Maharaj at 00:21 (auto-transcript): “What the frog from the ocean will be thinking about the frog in the world? Who is he thinking? not lie ignorance this is my foolish friend doesn't know anything he wants to calculate the ocean by his own limited ability what is the qualification to calculate the water in the…”

children.topic: Unlimited is not in his dictionary
children.note:
When we say ocean we mean something unlimited, but for the frog only the limited exists. Varuna, on the other hand, has the facility and intelligence to understand the ocean.

🎙 Maharaj at 01:46 (auto-transcript): “if frog is thinking Unlimited does not exist in his dictionary. What exists there is limited. Similarly, a devotee, the prophet says, Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu and the Bhagavad Gita.”

A devotee, Sri Caitanya Mahaprabhu and the Bhagavad-gita tell us there are living entities everywhere, some moving and some standing in one place. For them this is not difficult to understand; so we should not be frogs in the well.

🎙 Maharaj at 02:10 (auto-transcript): “Similarly, a devotee, the prophet says, Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu and the Bhagavad Gita. They are telling us that they are living entities everywhere. Some are moving and some are standing in one place. So it's not difficult for them to understand.”

children.topic: Scientists are frogs in the well
children.note:
Maharaj says the scientists lack the brain to grasp how unlimited Krishna is. If they consulted the Vedas and the acaryas they could understand; otherwise there is no question of it. — “Our scientists are a frog in the well.”

🎙 Maharaj at 02:56 (auto-transcript): “So we should not be like a frog in the well. Our scientists are a frog in the well. Because they don't have the brain to understand how unlimited is Krishna. So, this will consult the Vedas. If they consult the Vedas and the Acharyas, then they can understand. Otherwise,…”

What does advancement mean in the material world? Maharaj answers his own question: it is only ignorance expanding, though we call it progress. — “It's not advancement, it's still expansion of ignorance.”

🎙 Maharaj at 03:39 (auto-transcript): “In the material world, our advancement means what? Advancement means what? Expansion of ignorance. It is still ignorance. It's not advancement, it's still expansion of ignorance. We are considering this, oh, it's advancement.”

Is a skyscraper advancement? Maharaj says it is a reflection of the buildings of Vaikuntha, and you cannot tell the reflection from the original. He cites an acarya: when new devotees reach Vaikuntha the old devotees laugh, because the newcomers cannot tell the shadow from the real building.

🎙 Maharaj at 04:24 (auto-transcript): “What is advancement? The skyscraper. Is it advancement? What is skyscraper and Baikunda? What is it? The sky scrappers in Vaikuntha and the reflection of the sky scrappers in Vaikuntha. The reflection of a sky scrapper in Vaikuntha is the same. You cannot see the difference.”

What happened to the frog in the well who tried to understand the unlimited with a limited brain? He died. In the same way the froggy scientist, thinking and thinking to understand Krishna, is dead.

🎙 Maharaj at 06:55 (auto-transcript): “What happened to the frog in the well? He died. In the same way, a froggy scientist he is dead. He is dead. Furgi scientists. Died us. Thinking, thinking to understand Krishna. Died us.”

Maharaj asks how many have read Brahma-samhita and what they understood. He quotes some of its geometric descriptions of Goloka and asks the audience to explain the words — nobody can.

🎙 Maharaj at 07:45 (auto-transcript): “How many of you have read Brahma Samhita? Brahma Samhita. How many? What did you understand? Yes, that is the only one line that you have heard, that is the only one line, that is the best thing to understand in science.”

children.topic: Open the book, close it back
children.note:
We open Brahma-samhita, cannot follow Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati's English, and close it again; even those who attended a seminar on it understand only a little. If our own brains struggle with that, Maharaj says, imagine the scientist who knows nothing of such things. Therefore we should hear from Sri Caitanya Mahaprabhu and the Bhagavad-gita.

🎙 Maharaj at 09:37 (auto-transcript): “Open the book. You close it back. Therefore, those who have little understanding and those who have attended a seminar on Brahma Samhita, those who are little, just little, they have attended a seminar on Brahma Samhita. Our brain cannot understand”
The verse divides the unlimited living entities into those that move and those that do not. Mahaprabhu is giving Rupa Gosvami this training so that we know exactly where we stand.

Maharaj teases the audience: it says the living entities are unlimited — so are you unlimited? Someone answers 'in number', which is the point: unlimited living entities spread across all the universes. — “The unlimited here is not our size, it is the number.”

🎙 Maharaj at 11:36 (auto-transcript): “Are we unlimited? We are unlimited? It's written here, the unlimited living entities So we are unlimited? You are unlimited? A number, thank you, that's what I'm saying The unlimited here is not our size, it is the number. We are unlimited living entities all over the universes.”

Citing the Padma Purana, Maharaj gives the number of plant and tree species as two million — not all on this planet but spread throughout the universe. We are only repeating what the Purana says.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:35 (auto-transcript): “According to Padma Purana, Plant and trees, how many species, plant and trees? Plant and trees. Two million. Two million. All on this planet? This planet? No, it is spread all over the universe. From you get here, some will get there, some will go to other places.”

Those that move are birds, aquatics and animals; those that cannot move are plants, trees, rocks and mountains. Maharaj adds in passing that mountains once moved but are now stationary too.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:41 (auto-transcript): “So there are two divisions. Those that can move and those that cannot move. Among living entities that can move they are birds, aquatics and animals. and the entities that can now move the plants the trees the rock and mountains these days before the mountains were moving but…”

Maharaj pleads: take our knowledge from the Vedas and the sadhus, not from scientists, philosophers or politicians. Then we are complete and perfect.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:54 (auto-transcript): “so would you take our knowledge from the Vedas not from the scientists Please, not from the scientists. Not from the philosophers. Please, not from the philosophers. Not from scientists. Not from politicians. These three people are dangerous. Take our knowledge from the…”

Scientists, philosophers and politicians — Maharaj names the three sources we should not learn from. — “These three people are dangerous.”

🎙 Maharaj at 15:04 (auto-transcript): “Please, not from the scientists. Not from the philosophers. Please, not from the philosophers. Not from scientists. Not from politicians. These three people are dangerous. Take our knowledge from the scriptures. Sadhus. then we are complete, we are perfect. So Shri Chandra…”

children.topic: Where we are in the universe
children.note:
The beauty of studying scripture is that it tells us plainly our position in the universe, the position of the Supreme Lord and our relationship with him. Maharaj closes with the Isopanisad's definition of what an Upanisad is: knowledge that removes ignorance, reveals our identity and keeps us close to the Lord. — “The scriptures clearly teach us where we are in the universe.”

🎙 Maharaj at 15:38 (auto-transcript): “So Shri Chandra Mahabhubo is teaching so we can understand exactly where we are. It's the beauty of studying the scriptures. The scriptures clearly teach us where we are in the universe. What is the position of the Supreme Positive Godhead? What is our relationship? That is…”

One question from the floor about the point of studying the universal form and the cosmic charts.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:02 (auto-transcript): “Comments? Questions? Yes. My question is that, when there is a problem with Nārājī, if it is described in the second category, then the Nārājī is saying, when Nārājī is down, like, during my time, thinking about Nārājī, and so this is the fact that in our energy as thinking…”

children.topic: Q1 · Why study the universal form?
children.note:
If even the mind of Narayana is called a frog in the well before Krishna's unlimited nature, why do we need the universal form, the Goloka charts and the rest of this cosmology? Does learning them not make us frogs too?

🎙 Maharaj at 17:06 (auto-transcript): “My question is that, when there is a problem with Nārājī, if it is described in the second category, then the Nārājī is saying, when Nārājī is down, like, during my time, thinking about Nārājī, and so this is the fact that in our energy as thinking as like considering the…”

children.topic: For us, not for pure devotees
children.note:
Maharaj answers that pure devotees do not need any of it; it is there to convince people like us that there is somebody supreme. — “It is necessary to convince us that there is somebody supreme there.”

🎙 Maharaj at 19:15 (auto-transcript): “It is not necessary for pure devotees. It is necessary to convince us that there is somebody supreme there. Pure devotee is not necessary.”

When Krishna showed the Vrajavasis Vaikuntha and his four-armed form, their pain only increased — they called it a nightmare. He removed it and returned to two hands, and they thanked him: even a short while without their Krishna was painful. — “we don't want that nightmare again”

Krishna took them to Vaikuntha. your pain increased he showed them 400 oh what is he doing it's a nightmare it's a nightmare seeing the anxiety and Krishna removed all that”

The boys told Krishna that when he hides behind a tree during their games they feel unbearable pain for that moment — so what will they do when he goes to Mathura for days? Such devotees have no need of four hands. Maharaj notes that some of us sitting here feel no pain of separation at all, which is why we need these teachings to make us look for Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:40 (auto-transcript): “The cowhead boys they told Krishna Krishna when we are playing with you in the course of our play when you just run behind a tree you will feel so much pain for this short moment. Now, when you go to Mathura what will you do? Think of it. Pain. The Christians were there, they…”

When the gopis searching for Krishna met him in his Narayana form, they offered respect and asked only for the blessing of finding the son of Nanda Maharaja. They had no business with Narayana. So, Maharaj concludes, this knowledge is for non-devotees, not for devotees.

maps.title: Rupa Siksa · Day 21 · Uncultured People are Everywhere

nodeData.topic: Day 21 · Uncultured People are Everywhere
nodeData.note: CC Madhya 19.145–146 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Civilisation is a matter of consciousness, not of country or birth: cultured and uncultured people are found everywhere. Maharaj shows that the most powerful demons are those who speak religion but use it for themselves, that Mahaprabhu deliberately raised devotees from so-called low families, and that a preacher who discriminates geographically disqualifies himself. Q&A on why people avoid devotees, on Vrtrasura and Indra, and on the human species across the universe. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Continuing the count of species, this verse says that even the small human division is further subdivided, because it contains many uncultured people such as mlecchas, pulindas, bauddhas and sabaras. Read with Hindi translation.
The verse distinguishes those who follow Vedic principles from those who only claim to, while acting against them. Maharaj reads the purport twice over and keeps returning to it through the class.

Maharaj stresses that 'civilised' here is not a country or a species. It is a state of consciousness, and both civilised and uncivilised people are spread across the whole universe. — “Civilized and uncivilized people are spread all over.”

🎙 Maharaj at 12:46 (auto-transcript): “This is based on the country. This country, species, it is not because this is spread all over the universe. Civilized and uncivilized people are spread all over.”

Vedic civilisation begins from the sudra. Those below — mleccha, pulinda, bauddha, sabara, abhira, khasa — are not confined to one land; Maharaj says you find them everywhere you look.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:35 (auto-transcript): “Vedic Civilizations start from Sudra. Below the Sudra, like Mlechha, Pulinda, Bodha, Shabara, Abheera, Casas are spread all over.”

What separates the cultured from the uncultured is a single principle: our understanding of who God is and what our relationship with him is. Acting on that relationship is what Maharaj calls knowledge, or religion.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:31 (auto-transcript): “With a principal distinction. Our understanding about who is God. What is our relationship with God? That is the distinction. The word Vedah means knowledge.”

children.topic: Who are the most powerful demons?
children.note:
Maharaj asks the room a 'funny question' and makes them promise not to be angry: who are the most powerful demons in the world? The answers come — subtle ones, gross ones — and he leads them to his own: those who speak religion but do not follow it. — “So I ask you one funny question.”

🎙 Maharaj at 17:10 (auto-transcript): “So I ask you one funny question. How will you not be angry with me? Promise me. The point is to open our eyes so we can see. Around the whole universe, the whole world, the most powerful demons, who are the most powerful demons? The most powerful demons, the most powerful…”

Those who use religion as a means of livelihood and maintenance are the most powerful demons. Maharaj names the type: the motivated teacher.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:39 (auto-transcript): “Then, those who use religion as a means for living, for maintenance, okay? Very good. Papaji is saying that the people who use the religion for their own practice is a powerful master. Motivated teachers. He is a motivated teacher. He is a motivated teacher.”

The great demons of scripture were not sudras but born in brahmana families. So do not look at countries or castes; all over the world there are people who claim to be religious but are actually demons.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:28 (auto-transcript): “Hiranyakashipu, Ravana and Shishupal, they are Brahmanas, not Sutra, they are Brahmanas. Right? They are powerful demons. Brahmana family?”

Maharaj asks where the Bhagavatam's Tenth Canto opens: with ksatriyas acting as leaders but behaving as demons, so that Krishna had to be invited to come.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:03 (auto-transcript): “The beginner of Bhagatam. where does he begin where does he begin 10th kanto 10th kanto 10th kanto where does he begin shatriyas who are acting as leader but demons where does he begin 10th kanto then Krishna was invited to come”

All over the world there are people who belong to no religious organisation and yet whose character is better than that of many who do. Maharaj gives examples from his own family and from the Bhagavatam.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:19 (auto-transcript): “All over the world you'll see, you'll see people who have never, who doesn't belong to any religious organization, but their character is better than those who belong to religion. One day, I had my mother telling my father from now onward,”

One day his mother told his father that from now on she wanted no more sex — finished, and that was it. She had never visited India or read the Bhagavatam; where did she get it? Her character was such. Do we have people like that today?

🎙 Maharaj at 22:52 (auto-transcript): “One day, I had my mother telling my father from now onward, I don't want sex again. Shiret Bhagavatam?”

A brahmana of Uttar Pradesh, still living with a prostitute in old age; the Yamadutas asked the Visnudutas what renunciation he had when he was doing that. Maharaj's point: read our scriptures properly and understand what is actually happening, instead of reading only the letters. — “Don't read alphabets.”

🎙 Maharaj at 24:46 (auto-transcript): “Where did he get the knowledge from? Where did he get the knowledge from? And where did he get the knowledge from? And where did he get the knowledge from? Brahman, no? And? And? And he was still living with a pursuit at what age? He was a Brahman in Uttar Pradesh, and in…”

Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati Thakura sent sannyasis to London and they came back without making devotees. Srila Prabhupada sent householders to the same place and they established Radha-Londonisvara. Maharaj asks: is that not a revolution?

🎙 Maharaj at 26:37 (auto-transcript): “Many people are thinking militias the first duty she went to London why did she succeed? Why did she succeed? Shla Bhakti Siddhanta Saraswati Thakon Sanyasiyo'n ko London bheja tha Unhain safalta nahin mili apne prachar karya mein Kya unhain bhakt banali Shla Prabhupat ki tara”

From the Hindi exchange: they did not have firm faith in the order of their guru. They decided it was not possible and went back.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:02 (auto-transcript): “Shla Bhakti Siddhanta Saraswati Thakon Sanyasiyo'n ko London bheja tha Unhain safalta nahin mili apne prachar karya mein Kya unhain bhakt banali Shla Prabhupat ki tara Why he didn't make Kya unhain bana pahai Prabhuji kehre hai ki unke andar eegdam dridh shraddha nahin thi…”

Where is Londonisvara? Among the very people the verse lists — mlecchas, yavanas, bauddhas. True or not? Maharaj asks.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:44 (auto-transcript): “In Londoneshwara is where? What is it? Where? Milichas. Milichas. Javanas. Bordas. True or not? I am talking to you, your preachers, you should open your eyes Otherwise, your preaching will not have effect”

Speaking directly to the preachers present: if you do not understand this, your preaching will have no effect on anyone's life, because you will discriminate geographically — and that is a disqualification. — “Otherwise, your preaching will not have effect”

🎙 Maharaj at 29:10 (auto-transcript): “I am talking to you, your preachers, you should open your eyes Otherwise, your preaching will not have effect If you don't understand these things You will not make any effect on people's life. Because you are going to discriminate geographically.”

Did you see what Caitanya Mahaprabhu was doing? Rupa and Sanatana, brahmanas, were placed in the Muslim government; Nityananda Prabhu was sent to Radhadesh. Maharaj says none of this was accidental — it was purposeful.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:14 (auto-transcript): “Don't you see what Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu was doing? Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu. Did you see what he was doing? Did you see? Rupa Sanatana Goswami is with Brahmanas. Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu sent him to Muslim. It was purposeful. Right.”

Haridasa Thakura was born in a brahmana family; his parents left early and he was raised among Muslims. Maharaj says it was not as we usually think, and it was purposeful.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:26 (auto-transcript): “He sent Haridasa Sakura. Haridasa Sakura was born in Brahman. the Brahmana family His parents left early He migrated to a Muslim He was purposeful He was not directly born in a Muslim family like we think Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu”

Hanuman from an animal species, Prahlada from a demon family, Ramananda Raya a sudra kayastha who in Krishna's pastimes is Visakha sakhi — yet they rank with the Gosvamis. This is a teaching, Maharaj says, not degradation.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:16 (auto-transcript): “Hanuman Ji Pashuk Yoni Pralad Devonik family Did you see that? When he came He brought all of them from wherever Ramananda Rai Krishna Nila is what? Vishakh Vishakh Saki Chetanila Shutra Kaya Stha Kaya Stha Kaya Stha”

Vrindavan dasa Thakura explains that Mahaprabhu sends devotees into low families to make that place glorious, and Mahaprabhu himself told Haridasa Thakura that his birth was superior to his own. Externally we condemn these people; Mahaprabhu promoted them all. — “Devotees are everywhere.”

🎙 Maharaj at 34:26 (auto-transcript): “What? Devotees are everywhere. Why? Why? Vrindavan Das Thakura said, Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu send devotees to burial lines to make the place fatal. And Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu himself, He confirmed that. My dear Haridas Thakur Your birth is superior to mine”

children.topic: Who is mleccha, who is brahmana?
children.note:
One born in a mleccha family is chanting at six years old, and a brahmana is eating meat. So who is the mleccha and who is the brahmana? Is it happening or not?

🎙 Maharaj at 37:10 (auto-transcript): “His own one born in Malachya family. He is chanting six-year-old. And a Brahman is eating meat. Who is Malaysia? Who is Brahman? Is it happening or not? All the people who wanted to kill Narutam Das Chakura, they were all Brahmanas worshiping Durga. All the people who want to…”

children.topic: Why they wanted to kill Narottama
children.note:
Those who wanted to kill Narottama dasa Thakura were not mlecchas but brahmanas, worshippers of Durga. Maharaj asks what his offence was: he was teaching about God while they were not, living off the offerings instead. The envy says, you are doing what I am supposed to do, and you are exposing my deviation. — “You are doing what I'm supposed to do.”

🎙 Maharaj at 41:06 (auto-transcript): “They want to kill Narutam Daszakura. Who wanted to kill Narutam Daszakura? Who were the people? The militias. Who wanted to kill him? Who were they? Who were they? Who were the Brahman? No, Brahman asked.”

Maharaj asks whether brahmanas worshipping Durga is itself the problem — and answers that the fault lies with the brahmana, not with Durga.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:56 (auto-transcript): “Do the brahman worship Durga? Why do the brahman worship Durga? Why do the brahman worship Durga? The brahman worship is the brahman. It is not Durga. Is it not? It is not. The highest form of religion is that by which one becomes fully conscious of the existence of God,…”

The same envy appears among devotees: I do not want to see anyone doing what I cannot do, because it shows me my inability. If you stop, I feel comfortable. Maharaj asks us to recognise this in ourselves. — “I don't want to see anyone doing what I cannot do”

🎙 Maharaj at 43:08 (auto-transcript): “Some devotees, they feel that it's going to be close because I don't want to see anyone doing what I cannot do if you are not doing it I will be happy because you cannot be done But you are letting me to see my inability.”

A comment on why people avoid devotees, a comment on Vrtrasura and Indra that Maharaj develops at length, and a question on the human species.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:24 (auto-transcript): “Comments? Yes, sir. Hare Krishna Maharaj, the Lord. Thank you. Today, there are many people who are with those devotees who don't like to go and talk to them in their past. Because if they come with those devotees, there are a lot of restrictions on eating. That's my…”

children.topic: Q1 · People avoid devotees for the restrictions
children.note:
A devotee observes that many people do not want to mingle with ISKCON devotees because of our rules about eating and conduct. Maharaj's answer: if I come to you, you will show me where I am. Nobody wants to look into the mirror and see an ugly face. Unfortunate. — “Don't show me the mirror.”

🎙 Maharaj at 44:40 (auto-transcript): “Today, there are many people who are with those devotees who don't like to go and talk to them in their past. Because if they come with those devotees, there are a lot of restrictions on eating. That's my question. Comment. Prabhuji has a comment to make that these days I've…”

children.topic: Q2 · Vrtrasura and Indra — who is the demon?
children.note:
A devotee recalls the acaryas' comment that in the fight between Vrtrasura and Indra, Vrtrasura, who taught self-realisation and wanted the Lord's lotus feet, should be called the sura, and Indra, who wanted to stay in the material world, the asura. Maharaj asks the room: so who is the demon?

🎙 Maharaj at 46:09 (auto-transcript): “In Srimad Bhagavatam, there is a fight between Vrithrasura and Indra, and Acharya is right in that commentary that Vrithrasura should be called as Asura, and Indra should be called as Sura Devata, but our Acharya write that in this episode where Vrithrasura was instructing on…”

Externally Vrtrasura is a demon, but look at his qualities. Pariksit Maharaja asked Sukadeva Gosvami how a demon could be so pure, and Sukadeva laughed — as the audience is laughing now.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:01 (auto-transcript): “Externally, Vritra Sur is a demon. But look at his quality. Parikshit Maharaj, I Shukadeva Goswami, this question. How can the demon be so simply? Shukadev Goswami was laughing like you are laughing. Right? He is supposed to be a demon but look how the activities are simply.…”

When Prthu Maharaja was performing his hundred sacrifices, Indra stole the horse in the disguise of a sannyasi and so introduced pakhanda, false religious orders. Who are Indra's representatives today? Those who do other things in the name of religion.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:49 (auto-transcript): “Do you remember when Prithu Maharaj was going to do the hundreds? Do you remember when Prithu Maharaj was going to do 100? Indra tried. He tried. He tried to be sure that it doesn't take place. He introduced Indra's religion.”

children.topic: Krishna spoke to Prthu, not Indra
children.note:
When Krishna came to settle the dispute, he did not address the one doing wrong; he spoke to the sinless Prthu, who could understand him, and Prthu stopped the sacrifice so that Indra could have peace. Prthu slept peacefully because he did what was right. — “Krishna didn't talk to Indra.”

🎙 Maharaj at 50:39 (auto-transcript): “So, when Krishna came, two devotees were having issues. Indra. Demonic. Pritho Maharaj. Prayos. When Krishna came, whom did he speak to? Is he the one who is speaking to or the person who is doing activities, sinful activities? He is sinless.”

children.topic: Q3 · 400,000 human species — on earth only?
children.note:
Of the 8,400,000 species, are the 400,000 human forms only on this planet or across the planetary systems? Maharaj repeats the previous day's answer: the species are spread all over the universe, not in one place.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:08 (auto-transcript): “Out of the 84,000 spaces of living entities, the 400,000 are human beings. Does it limit to the human beings on the earthly planet or to the different planetary systems in the material world. So, Prabhu Ji, the question is that the 4,000,000 human beings are the ones in the…”
