One in chains is fixed to one place. Attachment to family keeps us stuck, not moving toward Krishna — that is what Brahma condemns. — “shackle means what no movement”

🎙 Maharaj at 66:50 (auto-transcript): “content shackles shackles food shackles a person who is chained shackles do we move shackle means what no movement we are restricted to one place so our material attachment in the family is what a binding for that keep us one play no movement number man means that we're not…”

Maharaj says he read the purport before speaking today and asks the most interesting point. After many guesses he reveals it: the Vrajavasis also have homes, families and daily work. So why does Brahma condemn ours?

🎙 Maharaj at 67:37 (auto-transcript): “do you know the most interesting thing in this verse what the most interesting thing in this verse what's the most interesting thing in this verse you know usually i i i don't read the purple first but today i read the whole purple first before we started talking so what's…”

Brahma is not condemning cooking, marketing or raising children. What differs is the heart: for them it is Krishna. — “Brahma does not condemn the activities”

Look at the word: not just engaged, intensely engaged. Many of us function artificially; our practice is shallow, like a candle flame you can pass your hand over. — “we are artificially existing”

🎙 Maharaj at 72:17 (auto-transcript): “what? Intensely engaged in their loving service, O Lord, Krishna. I made the difference. Yes, intensely engaged, Krishna. Not just engaged, look at the word. Intensely engaged. Means what? Some of us, we are functioning artificially in Krishna consciousness. majority of…”

If you eat well it shows in your body; if you practise well it shows in your life. Many devotees are confused because the quality of their practice is low.

🎙 Maharaj at 74:22 (auto-transcript): “practicing is showing in his life that is bhakti what we are practicing to show in our life so sure just if you eat nicely to show in your body you cannot eat nicely I do not show nobody to show nobody so if you are practicing nicely to show nobody many devotees are…”

From the chapter's start Brahma says he does everything to please Krishna. A counterfeit looks just like the original — even brighter — but the difference is in quality: the motive to please Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 75:56 (auto-transcript): “said I am offering different just to please you this is just to please you so our activities will be only to please Christian that's you did the motivation the motivation to please Krishna they are intense practice of bhakti, please Lord Krishna. Therefore, the activities may…”

Because the Vrajavasis act only to please Krishna, he enjoys all their activities. With that motive we jump into the kitchen to cook for him.

🎙 Maharaj at 77:36 (auto-transcript): “therefore Chris I enjoy all the activities Christian enjoy all the activities everything the pretty person the motivation is Krishna I want to do this to please Krishna if a Christian enjoy everything to do we jump to the kitchen to cook for Krishna we jump beside the kitchen…”

children.topic: Ask how to dress the deities
children.note:
We don't enter the altar to show our expertise. After purification the devotee begs Radharani to teach him to dress them the way they like — a practical spiritual technology.

🎙 Maharaj at 78:05 (auto-transcript): “show our expertise in doing these things a devotee enter the altar and he goes straight to the deities after the necessary purification the next thing in the what is begging please go to there please rather bless me what they are understanding so I can dress you the way you…”

'Dressing every day, cooking every day — can't someone else do it?' It is boring because we are not doing it to make someone happy.

🎙 Maharaj at 80:00 (auto-transcript): “this to please Krishna because I will smile when you finish thank you thank you how would that do what you say that yourself is boring how would I don't you say like that ah this is boring every day every day were dated this is boring can't you can't somebody else do this…”

children.topic: What makes ice cream ice cream?
children.note:
Prabhupada said devotional service, not just service. Maharaj asks the class what turns ingredients into ice cream; the answer is sweetness. Affection for the person we serve is what makes service devotional. — “what makes it devotional it's about affection”

🎙 Maharaj at 81:46 (auto-transcript): “pull sorted it yes it's not yes what makes a ice cream ice cream what make it ice cream this is ice cream what makes it a tasty delicious ice cream the ingredients yeah uh-huh see what's on the ingredient know the ingredient my friend not ingredient and not flavor cream no it…”

After a free-writing reflection on how to intensify daily practice, three questions from the chat.

🎙 Maharaj at 98:44 (auto-transcript): “raise your hands um i have received a question in the chat box from health based madhuri Lina Mataji. Mataji is writing. Hare Krishna, Shri Kuru Dev. Please accept my humble abhai senses. Happiest, Yasa Puja, Guru Dev. My question is, what makes us forget at that time when we…”

What makes us lose control of our speech, and why do we feel tired, even mentally, in service?

🎙 Maharaj at 99:01 (auto-transcript): “My question is, what makes us forget at that time when we are not able to control our speech? Is it still the self-interest or sense gratification? And why we feel tired in our services? Not only physically, but mentally too. can you please shed some light on the same sorry…”

It shows we have not done our homework: we don't hear or practise properly. Like the butterfly that cannot fly once someone 'helps' it out of its cocoon, the struggle itself gives strength.

🎙 Maharaj at 99:47 (auto-transcript): “control our whatever passion whatever it means that we are not preparing our homework properly it's like the homework is not properly done so before the teacher when the teacher would ask for the work we have done we will not pass we will not satisfy him because we didn't…”

Anger is not controlled at the moment of provocation but by practice done beforehand; then you can smile and walk away. Without practice the problem multiplies. — “It is the practice you have been practicing before that time”

🎙 Maharaj at 102:28 (auto-transcript): “one, someone ought to control my anger, it is not when the person is provoking you that you control the anger. It is the practice you have been practicing before that time that will help us to get the strength of, as I said, not to have completed that issue. That you just…”

Is it keeping Krishna at the centre of all we do, or personally doing something that pleases him?

🎙 Maharaj at 103:56 (auto-transcript): “I would like to understand what is intense engagement in loving service of Lord Krishna? Is it just connecting all the activities we do and keep Krishna in center or personally do something that pleases Krishna, your insignificant servant Ishani Karani Devi Rasi? We have to…”

The motivation must be to please Krishna in all we do. — “We have to please Krishna with our services, with our activities, with our everything.”

🎙 Maharaj at 104:17 (auto-transcript): “We have to please Krishna with our services, with our activities, with our everything. We have mentioned many times, we should do things just to please Krishna. That is the point, if we do things, because I want to do this into please Krishna. When that is the motivation,…”

children.topic: Plan it like a fine soup
children.note: To make a wonderful soup you plan ingredients and where to get them before entering the kitchen, all with the same mood of pleasing Krishna. Then the whole process is already an offering, as in Bhagavad-gita 4.24.

children.topic: Q3 · Impure thoughts about my guru?
children.note:
Why do impure thoughts about the guru arise?

🎙 Maharaj at 107:19 (auto-transcript): “My question is, why do I get impure thoughts about my Guru? Why do I have? Impure thoughts about my Guru. Impure means your consciousness is impure. If the consciousness is impure, what will come from there? If the consciousness is polluted, what will come from there?…”

If consciousness is polluted, everything coming from it is polluted. Maharaj reads Caitanya-caritamrta Adi 1.45 — read that morning in Mauritius — on how the disciple should see the guru; without this understanding the mind fills with garbage.

Good association helps us hear properly and adjust our consciousness. A neophyte should not go too close too fast, or he destroys himself like a moth in a flame. — “So we should engage ourselves in proper hearing, in good association.”

nodeData.topic: Day 23 · Krishna Acts Like Us, for Us
nodeData.note: SB 10.14.37 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Brahma says the Lord, though beyond the world, plays a worldly role to increase his devotees' joy. Maharaj tells how Krishna tamed King Nagnajit's seven bulls, shows why an acarya practises like a beginner, and explains with the lamp and the diamond why Krishna's pastimes shine brightest in this dark world. In the questions he explains Krishna's special care for devotees, how to hear speakers whose conduct does not match their words, and why we fail to follow the guru's instructions. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: 10.14.37 — Beyond the world, yet playing in it
children.note: Brahma's prayer today is about the Lord appearing on earth and behaving as if he were part of this world, simply to give his surrendered devotees more varieties of joy. The verse is recited and two translations are read.

Since Krishna is everything, there is no difficulty in his behaving like everything. Maharaj adds that what we see, hear and do should all be Krishna. — “whatever we hear should be krishna”

🎙 Maharaj at 35:44 (auto-transcript): “you are very worldly of this world. You behave like a part of this world. After all, Krishna is everything. So what is the difficulty? Seeing him behave the way he will behave with everything. It's everything. Seeing his everything, it's everything. And whatever we see should…”

children.topic: He comes to spread his glories
children.note:
Maharaj recalls Brahma's words in the Brahma-samhita: Krishna displays here the activities of the spiritual world so that we can connect with his glories and save our lives.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:22 (auto-transcript): “so lord brahma also in his brahma samita he said that lord krishna came here to come and demonstrate his activities he does in the spiritual world just to expand his glories just expand his glories now what he says tending his glories to us so we can connect with that and…”
Citing the Gita's third chapter, Maharaj notes that Krishna has nothing he must do, yet he acts like a conditioned soul to keep people in order, just as King Janaka set an example.

Maharaj quizzes the class about King Nagnajit, who set a test for anyone who wanted to marry into his family: control his seven bulls.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:05 (auto-transcript): “of the conditional souls bound by activities after all we saw a show can manage it to not manage it has two daughters for marriage how many daughters think not legit how many daughters yes king not legit how many daughters we're doing yeah I'm sorry we are no answer okay…”

When Krishna asked for the marriage, the king bowed and said he knew Krishna was the Supreme Lord, but he had set a standard and would not make an exception — otherwise people would call him partial and untruthful. Krishna happily agreed.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:52 (auto-transcript): “daughters so I want to marry them number did she folded his hand before the orchestra please accept my humble food obeisances although I know you are the Supreme Lord but I have said a standard for anyone who will want to marry my daughters and you are not exempted otherwise…”

children.topic: Dhoti tied up, bull by the horns
children.note:
Like a pujari ready for work, Krishna tied his dhoti up to his knees and seized the bulls by the horns. Maharaj stresses the point is not the marriage but that Krishna behaves exactly like us.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:02 (auto-transcript): “and krishna when they look at the booth and joseph is dirty like you know pujaris they want to do every second they will fold their duties to their knee folded his duty to the knee tightened it very strong and went before the bulls and grabbed them in English they said take…”

Maharaj asks the class why the horns and not the legs. The answers — power, fearlessness, bravery — lead to his own: bulls take pride in their horns and fight with them, so Krishna grabbed their pride, and the bulls simply surrendered. — “they're proud of their horns”

🎙 Maharaj at 43:54 (auto-transcript): “he grabbed him by the horns meaning what what what does that mean why not like why the horns why the horns is is mentioned what why not the legs yeah power okay to show power fearless okay to control the bull you can control them by dragging the feet and break them like they…”

Teaching by doing is the acarya's duty. Following Rupa Gosvami, even a pure devotee keeps the sadhana of a beginner to protect newer devotees from imitation: no one copies a hundred years of steady chanting, but everyone copies the one day it stops. — “everybody will follow that one”

🎙 Maharaj at 41:54 (auto-transcript): “and the point is Krishna is behaving exactly like us why to teach us that is the duty of an Acharya Rupa Goswami said even if one is a pure devotee we must practice our sudden exactly like a neophyte devotee why to protect neophyte devotees otherwise we'll start imitation…”

children.topic: Does he look like a lusty boy?
children.note:
Seen from outside, Krishna risking his life for brides could look like a man ruled by his senses. Maharaj lets the misunderstanding stand for a moment, then shows how differently his devotees see him.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:35 (auto-transcript): “everything so God has to do like this so God has to he showed controlled by laws that he can't control his laws he has to go and fight bullful for girls yes come on you would think like that look at him look at him can't control his senses he taking risk because I risking his…”

The disappointed kings, who had performed austerities hoping to win the bride, attacked. Arjuna told Krishna to sit and enjoy himself while he alone pushed every one of them back. The kings fought because they saw Krishna as just another rival.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:16 (auto-transcript): “when christian took the bulls they took the two daughters all the losty saturday as you kept there couldn't do anything they became angry why this cowhead boy came and take our our meat because all the saturday they have not been sleeping for days thinking yes i will be the…”

Arjuna never competes with his friend. Sent by Krishna to ask a maiden what she sought, he learns she is Kalindi, the Yamuna, who says she is meant for Krishna; Arjuna gladly brings her to him.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:18 (auto-transcript): “because he knows his friend you know these two guys are for my friend krishna they know themselves even though arjuna and krishna they they chase ladies together they go hunting women together but that you know the girl is to chase in case i know you want you to chase…”

After reading Rukmini's letter, Krishna kept it under his pillow and could not sleep, thinking of her all night — Krishna living among us exactly as we live.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:07 (auto-transcript): “is exactly the same way we do exactly the same way when christian wrote a letter to rukmini sorry when the community wrote a letter to krishna yeah rukmini devi she wrote a letter to krishna after christian read the letter where did he put the letter where where did christian…”

Recalling yesterday's verse, Maharaj says the people of Vraja milk cows, trade and raise children just as we do; the difference is that they are intensely absorbed in serving Krishna, while we are absorbed in sense gratification. — “we are not intensely engaged”

🎙 Maharaj at 52:08 (auto-transcript): “dream about community yes don't forget yesterday the brahma told us that don't forget the brahma told us yesterday that the bridge buses they are busy householders taking care of their household and duty taking care of the children taking care of their duty milking the cows…”

children.topic: The gopis' love is not mundane
children.note:
Krishna himself says his dealings with the gopis are completely transcendental, nothing like lusty affairs in this world.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:13 (auto-transcript): “thing but but different on a transcendental level Christian himself is Tavi Kanapura Goswami and under bondable champion the Christian said my activities my relationship my dealing with the gopis are on a transcendental level completely different from the low class lost women…”

children.topic: A lamp shines in the dark
children.note:
Visvanatha Cakravarti Thakura's comparisons — a lamp in shade, a diamond on blue glass — explain why Krishna's pastimes amaze more in this world than in Vaikuntha. Pure devotees like Arjuna never judge Krishna by worldly standards.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:57 (auto-transcript): “that is true that is what we are discussing when the pure devotees like Arjuna see Krishna when when when Arjuna showcase are doing this it was I didn't were not thinking anything you would not think I look at my friend so lost like me then we are decent maybe I'm even better…”

A worldly-minded brother might boast that he is the better householder; an elevated devotee never sees himself above his exalted brother, because he sees from a higher level and only glorifies.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:29 (auto-transcript): “doctor and a number the money doctor told mother the money I'm a household I'm better than you because I behave properly according to you you say yes and yes you are notice and yes you don't look at the activities do you think you are notice and yes it actually I'm superior…”

In sunlight a lamp means nothing; in a dark room it is precious because it drives darkness away. A diamond is lost against silver but stands out on blue glass. So Krishna's pastimes stand out against the darkness of material life.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:32 (auto-transcript): “perfect example a lamp in the dark room very significant very significant one can see the benefit of lamp only in darkness not in a sunlight sunlight the light has no existence in darkness the light the lamp is highly appreciated highly appreciated because it will help us to…”

Devotees appreciate Krishna's activities. When Lord Varaha appeared, tiny at first and then expanding, the demigods clapped and rejoiced that their anxiety was over.

In ecstasy at their praise Varaha shook his body, and the water formed a lake the demigods came to for purification. Maharaj asks where it is — Melkote in South India, where Ramanujacarya spent much time — and tells the class not to forget. — “There is no fiction in our system.”

🎙 Maharaj at 59:50 (auto-transcript): “glorification he shook his body in ecstasy and that formed a lake in in where what is the lake i mentioned it already i mentioned it already what is that lake in this our class i mentioned in this our class where that lake is lost not what shook his body and the out of…”

The demigods knew Varaha was the Supreme Lord come for their good. Non-devotees understand nothing and commit offences, so what is meant for their benefit becomes their ruin.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:15 (auto-transcript): “No, they understood, this is the supreme procedure of God. And he has come for our interest. They were happy, they were happy. Non-devotis don't understand anything, therefore they will make offences. What is meant for our benefit will become our source of destruction, when…”

children.topic: He comes for his devotees' joy
children.note:
Killing demons is secondary; Krishna could do that through politicians, disease, earthquakes or famine. He comes to give his audience to devotees who serve him in disturbing circumstances. — “Krishna came to expand the joy of his devotees.”

🎙 Maharaj at 64:16 (auto-transcript): “Krishna came to expand the joy of his devotees. Not killing demons in secondary. He can do that by other means. He can do that by using our politicians, sending some disease. He can easily do that. Air quirks is there. Tornado is there. Famine is there. He can do it by all…”

Maharaj recalls how the world has crucified, poisoned, stoned and blasphemed holy persons; Krishna comes to appreciate such devotees by his presence.

🎙 Maharaj at 64:57 (auto-transcript): “or it's for the two daughters who came to this much say well that all was given anxiety by the people he tried to save so much anxieties the world is giving them anxiety this was crucified blaspheme denied Mohammed poisoned Steven stone to death many what is a necessity stone…”

His wonderful activities give devotees something to hear, discuss and meditate on, and that remembrance keeps us close to Krishna — which is his intention. — “it will keep us close with krishna”

🎙 Maharaj at 65:45 (auto-transcript): “that yes now you have something to meditate on you have something to discuss he performed these activities he devotee can talk about them devotee can hear about them devotee can meditate get absorbed in that so he did so many activities many wonderful activities marrying…”

Three questions, after a short reflection exercise led by the host.

🎙 Maharaj at 80:48 (auto-transcript): “We have our first question from Shwatana Puji. Hare Krishna Guru Maharaj, Danavad Pranam, my respectful and humble obeisances on to you. Guru Maharaj, I realized, I mean, I don't know it is my thought or, like Guru is equal to all the disciples. So Krishna is also equal to…”

children.topic: Q1 · Is Krishna equal to all?
children.note:
If Krishna, like the guru, is equal to everyone, is Radharani dearest because her service and meditation are greatest?

🎙 Maharaj at 81:05 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna Guru Maharaj, Danavad Pranam, my respectful and humble obeisances on to you. Guru Maharaj, I realized, I mean, I don't know it is my thought or, like Guru is equal to all the disciples. So Krishna is also equal to all the devotees, all the parts and parcels of…”

children.topic: Equal, yet a friend to devotees
children.note: Maharaj answers with the Gita's ninth chapter: Krishna envies no one, yet whoever serves him in devotion is in him and he is their friend. That is natural reciprocation, not discrimination.

Would anyone call it partiality if a worker who comes every day earns more than one who comes half the month? A company paying everyone the same would have workers who come only on payday. — “will you say it is partiality”

🎙 Maharaj at 86:07 (auto-transcript): “will you say it is partiality will you say would anyone say that is partiality if any any of our workers in your office a worker who is there eight to five pm and fully busy working very nicely 30 days working nicely and another worker is there he come to work 15 days a month…”

Some devotees speak deep philosophy but behave very differently. How can one overlook that and still relish their talks about Krishna?

🎙 Maharaj at 89:32 (auto-transcript): “Yes, Maharaj, my question is, most of the time, you talk more about the karata. the character of devotees how we have to live the rightful life and because whatever we do will go to the spiritual master my right we you demonstrate everything to us and even we are not close to…”

Sanatana Gosvami told Haridasa Thakura that many speak philosophy nicely without living it. A good brain from past karma can grasp and present the academic side, like a parrot repeating.

🎙 Maharaj at 91:10 (auto-transcript): “Thank you, thank you for your question. Yes, Sanatana Goswami, Sanatana Goswami glorified Namah Chaja Haridastra Kho. Sanatana Goswami said, my dear Haridastra, I have seen that many people, they speak the philosophy very nicely. Like you said, they know this philosophy, can…”

Talent used to please Krishna purifies; talent used for our own intellect or recognition does not, and such service fades when appreciation stops. Not everything done in a devotional setting is devotional service — only what is consciously offered for Krishna's pleasure. — “if we use our talent just entertain our own intellect we will never get purified”

🎙 Maharaj at 93:01 (auto-transcript): “is serving Krishna if we use our talent in serving Christmas sincerely will get purified if you use our talent in krishna consciousness only to entertain our own intellectual ability will never get purified as such do you understand the purification will not be as much it's…”

Watch a speaker before, while and after he speaks: if all three are consistent he is a pure devotee; if not, an orator. Maharaj recalls Kesava Kasmiri, the proud champion whose composition Mahaprabhu took apart — a torch held up to the sun.

🎙 Maharaj at 96:10 (auto-transcript): “like that orators his holiness but tomorrow says we should look at the person before he goes to speak we should look at the person while he's speaking i should look at the person what will do after speaking if the three faces are consistent means it's a pure devotee if they…”

children.topic: Go, but hear the verse and purport
children.note:
We belong to a community and should cooperate, so still attend. Fix the mind on the verse and Prabhupada's purport, and if you are eager Krishna will teach you something even through such a speaker; otherwise you leave frustrated.

🎙 Maharaj at 99:34 (auto-transcript): “class yes because this is a community it's a community there are two things decided the organization and the Krishna consciousness the two things here organization and the crystal consciousness so because you're an organization the prophecy should cooperate corporate means…”

children.note:
A question from the chat: I feel helpless and too weak to execute my guru's instructions. What can I do?

🎙 Maharaj at 103:05 (auto-transcript): “that is christmas mercy that is christmas mercy thank you so much i am very i am i am very weak to executing my guru's instruction how can i do i'm very disturbed because i feel helpless in my practices how can i do please help me that's a question from the chat box you…”

We cannot keep the instructions because we are not surrendered. Why accept someone as guru without giving ourselves? Maharaj compares it to marrying a person you do not like — no one forced you; if you are not ready, don't go; if you go, be ready to follow. — “we're not surrendered”

🎙 Maharaj at 103:49 (auto-transcript): “and this talks so what should I do we have we have answered the question many times that we are not surrender to the guru that is where we cannot keep the instructions as a problem we're not surrendered if you are surrendered you were to keep the instruction so that is it…”

maps.title: Brahma's Prayers · Day 24 · Brahma Says: I Don't Know

nodeData.topic: Day 24 · Brahma Says: I Don't Know
nodeData.note: SB 10.14.38 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. After a month of hearing grandfather Brahma, Maharaj says the one thing that matters now is application. In this verse Brahma admits that the Lord's opulences are beyond his mind, body and words, and Maharaj shows why 'I don't know' is so rare and so valuable — the self-confident are the easiest to cheat, while Krishna is conquered only by humble devotees. In the questions he defines humility, compares gurus to teachers with more degrees, and explains how to make amends after hurting someone. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Maharaj praises the devotees for listening to Brahma for a whole month like obedient children. Arjuna feared a battle that would kill the elders: the young have knowledge, but the elders have wisdom, and without them life loses its direction. — “The elders have wisdom.”

🎙 Maharaj at 36:15 (auto-transcript): “so we continue getting wisdom realization from the brahma yes an obedient children obedient children should listen to the parents so all of you have not made a mistake listening to lord brahma for one month you have done the duty of an obedient student so you are glorified…”

Kali-yuga began when leaders fell — when Sringi cursed the king and the brahmanas, the head of society, failed. Our suffering today comes from having no heads to guide the hands. — “The head has to guide the hands.”

🎙 Maharaj at 38:13 (auto-transcript): “That is the beginning of Kali Yuga. Kali Yuga begins when the leaders fell down, when no leaders. At the beginning of Kali Yuga, no leader. Sringi cursed the leader. Brahmanas fell down. Brahmanas are the head. So when the Brahmanas fail, what would happen? The head has to…”

In a cultured society the parents gather the children and share their realisations. Brahma, our grandfather, has been doing exactly that for us this month.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:43 (auto-transcript): “So all of you, all of you are doing the right thing, listening to our, our little Brahma, he's our grandfather, so Brahma is our grandfather, he is sharing his wisdom, this is the duty of the parents, with the culture, the parents call all the children together and sit down…”

Maharaj asks what matters most after a month of hearing. Among answers like transformation and prayer, the one he picks is application: without it, all we have heard is useless.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:34 (auto-transcript): “so for one month you have been hearing from our grandfather this is wonderful life now what is the most important thing in this one month we have listened to the brahma was the most important thing or the most important thing or listening to the grandma for one month what is…”

children.topic: Ghee on fire, not on ashes
children.note:
Hearing without practice is like pouring ghee on ashes. When we apply what we have heard, the ghee falls on fire and it blazes. — “the fire of bhakti will flame”

🎙 Maharaj at 42:53 (auto-transcript): “application. Application. What we have had for the whole month. Application. Without application, no results just like we have offered a blessing to ashes we'll get fire and for fire to burn in it to to the gear on fire not on ashes if you don't apply means we are adding G to…”

We have been trained and equipped with Brahma's wisdom; now, sword of knowledge in hand, we must cut our bondage. Then the result appears and the whole world feels the heat.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:07 (auto-transcript): “Swami said with the sword in hand we should do what caught the binding foresees knowledge knowledge so it means knowledge we have knowledge now we have been trained we have been equipped for lord brahma's wisdom now we have to apply it then the result will manifest the result…”

Brahma, concluding, lets others claim to know everything about Krishna; for himself he says the Lord's opulences are out of reach of his mind, body and words. The verse is read with two translations; the first is also quoted in the Caitanya-caritamrta.

children.topic: 'I don't know' — so hard to say
children.note:

maps.title: Brahma's Prayers · Day 25 · Giving the Universe Back

nodeData.topic: Day 25 · Giving the Universe Back
nodeData.note: SB 10.14.39 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Brahma asks Krishna's leave and offers back the universe he was only entrusted to manage — teaching us to stop claiming Krishna's property as our own. Maharaj shows Brahma's embarrassment through the image of a family meal spoilt, and Krishna's silence while Brahma talks on. He stresses finishing one's duty before moving on, and tells how Haridasa Thakura's previous lives were shaped by offences. In the questions he speaks on mindful service, making amends for offences to the guru, tulasi, discipline and Ekadasi. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Brahma begs permission to leave, recognising Krishna as the knower and master of everything, and offers him this one universe. The verse is read with a second translation and the Krishna book passage on Brahma feeling out of place amid the simple love of Vrindavan.

Brahma created the universe but did not manufacture its ingredients, so he cannot claim it. We do the same with every little thing we receive — who gave it to you?

maps.title: Brahma's Prayers · Day 26 · Obeisances As Long As the Sun Shines

nodeData.topic: Day 26 · Obeisances As Long As the Sun Shines
nodeData.note: SB 10.14.40 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. In the last class of the series Brahma ends his prayers by offering obeisances to Krishna for as long as the universe lasts, even to his gunja beads and the humble arka plant. Maharaj explains why the material world is real but temporary, why the open atheist is less dangerous than the religious cheat (the cat swami), and why Brahma calls himself a rakshasa from Satyaloka — teaching us to check daily whether our activities please or disturb Krishna. In the questions he distinguishes the gopis' self-forgetfulness from ignorance, and humility from self-pity, and ends by blessing the devotees after the month of Purushottama. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Brahma's final verse glorifies Krishna as the joy of the Vrishnis, the friend of the earth, demigods, brahmanas and cows, and the destroyer of irreligion and demons, and offers obeisances for as long as the universe exists. Gathered on the last day of Purushottama, the devotees hear it with two translations.

Maharaj takes Brahma's words personally: as long as there is life in this body, obeisances go on at Krishna's lotus feet without stopping. Sanatana Gosvami says Brahma is here in the ecstasy of nama-sankirtana, calling out names that recall Krishna's pastimes.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:30 (auto-transcript): “on to you as long as this life in this body as as long address life in this body my business is continuously offered at the lotus feet businesses is continuously offered at the lotus feet non-stop Nipopota Siddha Sanatangoswamy explaining According to Siddha Sanatangoswamy,…”

Brahma's 'millennium after millennium' prompts a question to the class about what it means.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:36 (auto-transcript): “be not such a biscuit um derma some tunnel party you get you get some of me you get you get some millennium after millennium that means what millennium after millennium means what was the minute us millennium after millennium after millennium after millennium what does it…”

The answer from the class: eternally. Brahma's obeisances and Krishna's pastimes continue without end.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:41 (auto-transcript): “me you get you get some millennium after millennium that means what millennium after millennium means what was the minute us millennium after millennium after millennium after millennium what does it mean what does that mean millennium after me what does that mean that was my…”

If the world were simply false, Krishna's appearance, his dancing and living in Vraja would be false too. They are real; the material world is real but temporary, sometimes manifest and sometimes not — and only for the unfortunate is it 'sometimes'.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:26 (auto-transcript): “continues so to say that material world is false is illusion from time immemorial to say that the material is false is illusion to say that material is temporal is real that is true otherwise why crisis appearing is illusion christian's advent is illusion christian's advent…”

Night and day keep alternating; no one calls the night false. It is real, but passing, and to see in it we need another energy — light. — “it is not false it is real but temporarily”

🎙 Maharaj at 46:07 (auto-transcript): “and the day comes night comes day comes night comes day comes so you cannot say the night is false no no it is not dark no it's not dark it is false you will see anything you won't see anything you need another energy the light the beauty to see in the darkness so it is not…”

children.topic: Hidden and open enemies of God
children.note:
Prabhupada's purport names two burdens on the earth: those who come alive after sunset for intoxication, gambling, illicit sex and meat-eating while calling themselves God-fearing, and open atheists.

Maharaj quizzes the class: the one who claims to be godly and cheats, or the one who says publicly there is no God? The atheist is better, because he is straightforward; the religious cheat invites you close and then destroys you.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:08 (auto-transcript): “atheists and demons which one is better after these two those who believe those who claim to be godly who belongs who claim to be godly those who claim to be godly those who claim to be godly and cheat people and those who declare who declare publicly I don't believe in God I…”

children.topic: The city is the real forest
children.note:
In the forest we know to beware of tigers; in the modern city, with water on tap, we never suspect danger — yet modern life drains our energy into sense gratification and makes us forget our real interest.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:50 (auto-transcript): “dangerous they're more dangerous yes just like our present society our present society are very dangerous than the forest when one is going to the forest we are sure we are concerned that there are tiger asses are the forest but when you live in the city what is it what is…”

children.topic: Bowing to all that is Krishna's
children.note:
Brahma offers obeisances even to Krishna's gunja necklace and to the lowly arka plant, because he now sees everything connected with Krishna as worshipable.

🎙 Maharaj at 62:34 (auto-transcript): “obeisances to all why because the brahma see that everything brought including your ornament and even the lowly archa tree are object of my worship oh lord who can be merciful merciless who can grant me auspicious or trouble i offer my respectful obeisances namaste to you…”

Having gained realisation, Brahma shows respect to everything related to Krishna; in Vrindavan even a grain of sand is worshipable.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:41 (auto-transcript): “with a little Krishna so Brahma has gotten some realization from knowledge and he is he's showing that respect yes brindavan even the grain of sunny brindavan is worshipable worshipping so vision i check it what is that could i open obeisance is sarva sansaya hiritsarva…”

Visvanatha Cakravarti Thakura notes that Brahma, ashamed, calls himself a demon from Satyaloka who came to disturb Krishna and his friends. Maharaj calls this the humility that knowledge brings: devotees facilitate Krishna's enjoyment, demons disturb it.

🎙 Maharaj at 67:05 (auto-transcript): “Krishna that's a devotee we have been mentioning so many times but is a science what is science is what is what am I my activities are my activities a blessing to krishna devotee or it is disturbing krishna demonic this is how to think this is how to check ourselves that is…”

maps.title: Radha Sunya · Session 01 · The Mercy Is Not Missing

nodeData.topic: Session 01 · The Mercy Is Not Missing
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Opening the Kartik series on the book Radha Sunya, Maharaj explains that Krishna's mercy is always available; what is missing is our appetite for it, and offences (apa-radha, being without Radha) are what deprive us. He stresses the power of a genuine 'sorry', service to Vaishnavas, and going inward through contemplation, and closes with forgiveness and a daily journal exercise. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Maharaj welcomes everyone to the yearly Kartik programme and compares Krishna consciousness to a feast: how much we take depends on how hungry we are.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:15 (auto-transcript): “We are very, very, very happy to have all of you attending this program, which we are doing every year, during the month of Catholic. We have done the government last year. It was very sweet. We went through the whole Brandavan the whole Brandavan and then we devoted”

Brazilians and the French wish each other a good appetite before eating. Devotees especially need a good spiritual appetite; without it we take very little.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:50 (auto-transcript): “Similarly, it is the same in Christian consciousness. Those who have good appetite, I've seen in Brazil and in French country, they have a very good approach towards eating. In English, we don't have good supplements towards eating. But South Americans, French people, they…”

children.topic: Lazy for Krishna, active for the body
children.note:
Many devotees show little appetite: lazy for japa, for hearing and for Krishna's work, yet energetic for whatever concerns the body and mind. Krishna consciousness lets each of us see where we stand individually. — “We are lazy for hearing about Krishna.”

nodeData.topic: Session 02 · Aparadha, Devoid of Radha
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj teaches that bhakti requires knowing what to accept and what to reject, and defines aparadha as becoming devoid of Radharani, the overseer of devotion. Progress in this age comes by mercy, received through humility, respect for all and the dust of the devotees' feet, as Brahma showed after his offence. In the questions he explains how to recognise and rectify offences we are unaware of, why to serve without expecting results, and how to keep practising even when prayer feels mechanical. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: What to accept, what to reject
children.note:
Success in anything needs evaluation and accountability; so does devotion. Pure Krishna consciousness is immeasurable, but practitioners should measure the quality of their practice, as a traveller who knows the distance knows what speed to keep.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:48 (auto-transcript): “A parada. So, what is to be accepted, and what are the things that should be rejected? Materially speaking, if we won't want to be successful in anything, there should be evaluation. Similarly, in vocational consciousness, there should be evaluation, accountability. as you…”

Stand still in a busy crowd and you are pushed from every side. Prabhupada called it a movement: every devotee must move forward, or he becomes a problem for himself and others. Even a good gardener with good seed and soil must know how to water the plant. — “stagnation brings anxiety”

Can you imagine you are in a very busy, every crowded place busy and you just stand in one place how do you feel very busy place people are moving from…”

A Bengali Gaudiya Vaishnava dictionary defines aparadha as Radha-sunya, being without Radha. Offences create a situation in which her blessings, mercy and protection are absent.

Radharani is Krishna's pleasure potency, the mother of devotion and overseer of the whole realm of bhakti. Without her there is no devotion, without devotion no Krishna, and without Krishna our suffering continues.

Semati Radharani means no Krishna. that's all there's no there's no middle way because devotional means rather than me and what it means so no devotional means no devotional means no Christian no Christian means our…”

We cannot advance without the mercy of Lord Nityananda and Srimati Radharani. Nityananda's mercy comes through service to Vaishnavas and the dust of their feet, as Haridasa Thakura explains in Harinama-cintamani. In Kali-yuga perfection comes by mercy more than by our expertise in sadhana.

Mercy cannot come to an arrogant person. Our minds are so weak that some are offended just by seeing someone; offending any living being is the beginning that leads to offending devotees and Krishna. — “Bend down low, and I will teach you what I know.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:43 (auto-transcript): “So, we need a mercy, and a mercy cannot come from an arrogant person, a music hero said, Bend down low, and I will teach you what I know. It means no pride, no arrogance. That's what it means. Bend down low, and I will teach you what I know.”

Without respect we cannot avoid offences. We call each other Prabhu, 'my master' — how then can I offend or disregard you? Yet we call someone Prabhu and chastise him, which is the opposite. — “It is Prabhu who will chastise us.”

This discussion is for cleansing the heart, not empty talk. Devotional service guarantees growth except where there are offences. That people fall down proves it works: one can only fall from a height.

Offences can stall progress for lifetimes and wipe out pious credit; offending a devotee can affect generations of one's family. In the pastime of King Nrga in the Tenth Canto, Krishna warns never to be angry with a brahmana. — “Not only we, generations.”

Devotion is not floating; Rupa Gosvami says it gives immediate relief and joy, felt as surely as an injection. Faith does not mean inactivity. Waiting at home for the guru to come and take you to hospital, or to bring food because he is omniscient, is foolishness. We make the effort; the result depends on guru and Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:19 (auto-transcript): “and being a dependent person does not mean foolishness it doesn't mean I should be inactive I am sick Krishna you are very merciful gurus are so kind you should know where you are that I'm seeking my she better come here and take me to hospital it's not not a dependence it…”

children.topic: Q2 · Offences we don't know about?
children.note:
What if we offend someone unknowingly and do not even know whom?

🎙 Maharaj at 63:15 (auto-transcript): “Krishna Maharaj, please accept my humble obeisances. Maharaj, my question was on offences. If we do any offence unknowingly or by mistake, if we are not aware of it, then what to do at that time? Like our bhakti will go down if we have offended a devotee. And if we don't know…”

As you know when you are sick, you can know: japa has no taste, no enthusiasm for programmes, seeing no pure devotee anywhere — something is wrong. Not noticing means we are not serious.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:44 (auto-transcript): “If we are sick, we should know. If you are sick, you should know I'm sick. my body is not functioning properly we should know the same way if we make offences we have got this cause if we make offences there will be stagnation that means offences are going on now so we should…”

When Rupa Gosvami's meditation broke, he did not say he had seen no one; he concluded he had offended someone, searched, and Krishna showed him the person. Thinking 'if someone is angry it is their problem' is a serious problem.

🎙 Maharaj at 66:46 (auto-transcript): “break the deities you go and break the deities that is one way second way Rupa Goswami when Rupa Goswami noticed that his meditation broke just see he was completely in deep meditation Rupa Goswami was in deep meditation he didn't see at all that somebody came to visit him…”

Avoiding offences with distant devotees is easy; how to tolerate those we live with every day?

🎙 Maharaj at 68:30 (auto-transcript): “and ask a question? Hare Krishna, Srila Gurudev. Thank you so much for the enlightening class. Srila Gurudev, you told us that we should avoid offenses. So when we talk about the devotees who are far from us, to whom we don't meet every day, so it's easy, a bit easy to avoid…”

The issue is the quality of our sadhana and consciousness. A developed devotee who appreciates and respects others handles every situation, near or far. — “It's not about distance.”

🎙 Maharaj at 69:09 (auto-transcript): “the issue is not the distance the distance we have with the person the issue is our inner development if we develop we are doing our service very nicely they will have the strength to overcome. We have already mentioned many times in this particular discussion how we should…”

We bring friends and relatives to the temple and feel sad when they show no realization.

🎙 Maharaj at 70:43 (auto-transcript): “Hey, Krishna Shlai Gohizeh, please accept my most humble responsibility. Gohizeh, I just wanted to ask one question that sometimes we have to invite our friends and our relatives to this Kaur temple where we make them seek in lectures, aarti and attain all the rituals and at…”

children.topic: Do your duty, leave the result
children.note:
As Krishna told Arjuna, the result is his. They saw the deity and devotees and heard the name; expecting a hundred new devotees will only discourage you.

🎙 Maharaj at 71:21 (auto-transcript): “In Babadigata, Krishna told Ajoun do your duty. Don't expect the result. The result is for me, not for you. So we have to do our duty. The result, forget about the result. Whatever comes, that is not for your duty. Your duty is encourage people in Christian consciousness. So…”

A devotee took his reluctant father, a wood seller, on pilgrimage. At Varanasi the father wept before huge piles of firewood; the son thought his heart had melted, but he was lamenting that he had missed such a lucrative wood business.

🎙 Maharaj at 72:31 (auto-transcript): “when we were talking I was remembering one when one devotee he tried his best to to encourage his father to be a devotee actually there are two two it just came to my mind he's trying his best to encourage his father to be the father is a he's a businessman he sells wood and…”

A devotee cannot feel helpless when praying to the acharyas; it feels mechanical and unhelpful.

🎙 Maharaj at 76:31 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna my dear Shri LaGurudev please accept my humble obeisances onto your lotus feet Guru Dev you mentioned in the class that before starting our sadhana we should always pray to our acharyas in a mood of helplessness but gurudev i am not able to feel helpless while…”

A devotee told Prabhupada he was not humble, so could not offer 'humble obeisances'; Prabhupada asked how else he would become humble. Another said he could not cry for Krishna; Prabhupada said to cry because he could not. Mechanical prayer accumulates into feeling.

🎙 Maharaj at 77:11 (auto-transcript): “One day, one devotee told Prabhupada, I'm not humble. So I'm not open of businesses. I'm not humble. Our tradition is what? Please accept my humble obeisances. I said, Prabhupada, I'm not humble so I can not open of businesses. Prabhupada said, yeah, that's very good. How are…”

Kunti Devi shows that material desire stops heartfelt prayer, so pray for it to leave and take sadhana seriously. — “Strong sadhana brings empowerment.”

🎙 Maharaj at 79:08 (auto-transcript): “why we don't pray feelingly because of material desires in it Kunti Devi said therefore we should be praying also for material desire to leave us and being engaging seriously in sadhana. We have been always mentioning strong sadhana, strong sadhana, sadhana, sadhana, sadhana.…”

children.topic: Q6 · Harsh words to noisy children
children.note:
During a Bhakti-vriksha class a devotee spoke harshly to parents whose children were noisy. Was it an offence?

🎙 Maharaj at 85:41 (auto-transcript): “Shri LaGurude Manisha Mataji You may please Hare Krishna Shri LaGurude Please accept my humble obeisances and your lotus feet Hare Krishna Thank you for the class Gurude Actually I was having a question that this Sunday we were having our Bhakti Vriksha class in the temple…”

Yes: Maharaj recalls his guru comparing harsh words to stoning someone. A teacher may check students; otherwise speak once, and if they don't listen, move the class or use earplugs rather than join their energy.

🎙 Maharaj at 86:40 (auto-transcript): “Aparath like that? Yes, to speak harsh words, to speak harsh words, yes. And Gurudev said it's like stoning a person. Harsh words are stoning a person. So if you are the teacher, yes, the password is good to check the student if someone else is doing the person is careless…”

children.topic: Q7 · Offending someone you can't find
children.note:
At a 24-hour kirtan a devotee played large kartals beside a mataji and only later realised the noise had disturbed her; he would not recognise her now.

🎙 Maharaj at 88:47 (auto-transcript): “Maharaj, my question is, I have some realization about what you are saying about offenses. Something happened very in the summertime when we were doing, I think, 24 hours Ketan in Norendravan. I was praying the characters, the big one. And when I was praying, there was this…”

When you cannot find the person, pray to the deities to forgive; Krishna will rectify it.

🎙 Maharaj at 90:30 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna, you can pray to the deities to forgive. Pray to the deities. Okay. Yeah, that is the solution. You don't know the person, and you cannot go and touch certain circumstances. You don't know the person. You pray, Krishna will rectify it for you. Thank you. Thank…”

How to protect ourselves from unwanted influence without being offensive?

🎙 Maharaj at 91:06 (auto-transcript): “she is asking harry krishna maharaj please accept my humble obeisances maharaj how to protect ourselves from unwanted unwanted influence without being offensive protect ourselves from unwanted influence without being offensive But if somebody is offering something which you…”

Decline politely what you don't want. If talk turns to nonsense, change the topic, which helps them too; if they are stronger, excuse yourself — 'I have service to do', 'this is too high for me' — and go. Even if they call you proud, just go. — “Excuse yourself and leave.”

🎙 Maharaj at 91:38 (auto-transcript): “But if somebody is offering something which you don't know, which you don't like, somebody is offering something, you can apologize, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm full, I'm sorry, I cannot take it. We should be able to distinguish what is garbage, so we don't respond, we don't…”

nodeData.topic: Session 03 · Offences Against the Holy Name
nodeData.note: SB 5.12.12 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. On Narottama dasa Thakura's disappearance day Maharaj recalls that the Absolute Truth is revealed only by a great devotee's mercy, then begins the ten offences against the holy name: blaspheming devotees, separating the name from the Lord, disobeying or minimising the guru, and offences to scripture and the name's glories. He urges treating everyone nicely when we cannot tell who is who, looking at our own faults instead of others', and begging humbly for mercy. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Krishna consciousness is the soul's natural, sweet activity, so devotees should have smiling faces. Recalling Bhakti Tirtha Swami's emphasis, Maharaj says we are maintained and nourished by the mercy of Krishna and the devotees — we are kripa-siddhas, perfected by mercy.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:16 (auto-transcript): “we begin our day Radha Sunya just to recap from the previous discussion it's already Bhattisar Mahara was emphasizing that our primarily Krishna consciousness stem from the mercy of Krishna the mercy of devotees the mercy we are nourished we are maintained, we are fed and…”
Jada Bharata tells King Rahugana that the Absolute Truth is not realised by celibacy, household rules, renunciation or severe austerities, but only by the mercy of great devotees.

Many Vaishnavas recite the ten offences daily; we should also develop strategies to avoid them.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:51 (auto-transcript): “Radha Sunia, Missing Mercy, Understanding and Overcoming Apparat of One, Offenses Against the Chanting of the Only Needs, Introduction, The Daily Reminder We Need, Daily Reminder We Need is what? So many Vaisalas have a daily habit of reciting the Das Nam Apparatus, the Ten…”

Reciting the offences takes three minutes in the morning, and Maharaj admits he does not remember them all day. Even during the recitation some devotees jump in and disturb others. One strategy: never speak badly of anyone, especially devotees. — “it's only 3 minutes in the morning”

🎙 Maharaj at 24:56 (auto-transcript): “This is what we do. we recite the 10 offenses how many minutes it takes? 3 minutes and the whole day we remember them I don't know but for me I don't remember them it's only 3 minutes in the morning not to criticize black women who have dedicated his or her life to the…”

Blaspheming devotees who spread the holy name is the worst offence; the name, identical with Krishna, will not tolerate it even from one who passes as great. The text even names Lord Shiva to show how serious it is — though as the greatest Vaishnava he would never do it.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:51 (auto-transcript): “Offenses 1 and 2. Blasphemy of the devotees of the Lord who are engaged in the propagation of the Hare Krishna is the worst offense at the Lord's feet or the Holy Name. The Nam Prabhu who is identical with Krishna will never tolerate such blasphemous activities even from one…”

children.topic: Offence 2: the name is the Lord
children.note:
Vishnu's name, form, qualities and pastimes are all transcendental. Separating the Lord from his name, form and qualities, thinking them material, or equating the names of demigods like Shiva with Vishnu's, is offensive.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:07 (auto-transcript): “In this material world, the holy name of Vishnu is all auspicious. Vishnu's name, Vishnu's form, Vishnu's qualities, and Vishnu's past things are all transcendental, absolute knowledge. Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu was so angry. Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, what day he was shouting?…”

Caitanya Mahaprabhu, who never spoke such words, shouted that he would destroy one who said the Lord has no form, name or qualities — such a person was cutting his body to pieces. His name, form, qualities, pastimes and abode are eternal.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:23 (auto-transcript): “Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu was so angry. Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, what day he was shouting? I will destroy him. I will kill him. What he never had, Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, was used this kind of word before. What? When are you going to destroy, my Lord? See, that man was cutting…”

children.topic: A secretary in the director's chair
children.note:
A secretary who sits in the director's chair is fired at once; one who declares himself prime minister is arrested before he finishes. Yet people declare themselves God for years and nothing seems to happen. — “A secretary cannot be a director,”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:12 (auto-transcript): “A secretary cannot be a director, except if he gets promotion to become a director. Only then he can be a director. But as far as he is a secretary, he is not a director. There's a difference. So if one plays a secretary on the restaurant's chair, it's an offense. Even if the…”

Krishna is taking serious action imperceptibly. After death, religious cheaters who declared themselves God are crushed for ages in Kumbhipaka, like sugarcane in a press, in the subtle body. Maya's trick is to make them think they are free and worshipped. — “The Lord is not keeping quiet.”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:50 (auto-transcript): “So what about spiritual life? A person can go on and on and on and on and declare himself as God. And it seems nothing is happening to the person. But the moment you come out and declare, I am the prime minister of this country, the next moment you're arrested. The next…”

To disobey the spiritual master, consider him material and envy his position. Krishna consciousness is reality — something felt, experienced and relished — not fiction.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:12 (auto-transcript): “Next. Offenses 3 to 6. To disobey the order of the spiritual master or to consider the spiritual master to be material and therefore to envy his exalted position. Very nice experience in the fourth tantosimed babotani. Indra was thinking his spiritual master, at this point…”

In the Bhagavatam, Indra, surrounded by worshipping demigods, felt no need to rise for his guru Brihaspati — he had already offered respects that morning. Maharaj asks: if your guru knows nothing, how intelligent are you to accept a fool as guru? — “What an intelligent person are you?”

🎙 Maharaj at 35:34 (auto-transcript): “Very nice experience in the fourth tantosimed babotani. Indra was thinking his spiritual master, at this point I'll offer business to you. it's okay now if I don't offer now it's okay after all now I have also I have done my part by offering a business to you as a disciple…”

If you abandon the medicine the doctor prescribed, the doctor does not suffer; you do. The guru's order comes from the Supersoul; follow it and you succeed. — “it is you who are going to suffer”

🎙 Maharaj at 40:39 (auto-transcript): “special massage and then disobeying the other i've given this example many times especially massage is like a doctor the doctor if one has gone to see a doctor and get a prescription from the doctor what to do for the sickness it is our duty to take the medicine as the doctor…”

Without a pure devotee's mercy everything stays difficult. Serving him, following his instructions, and taking the dust of his feet, his remnants and the water that washed his feet are potent ingredients that guarantee purity.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:49 (auto-transcript): “Because we need the mercy to grow. Without the mercy we can never understand anything. Everything will make difficult and unsuccessful Until we have the mercy of the pure devotee. There, it is a trunk, an express role for success. Express way for liberation is service of pure…”

Minimising a pure devotee as an ordinary person usually comes from envy. Pure devotees are the easiest to criticise because their activities are beyond a neophyte's understanding.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:48 (auto-transcript): “So one should be very careful to avoid minimizing the spiritualness, thinking of him as an ordinary person. And then naturally one will become envious. To think of him as an ordinary person due to envy. Envy. Are you pure? Are you better than me? Are you pure? What's the…”

In Pune a devotee told Maharaj he saw no pure devotee in the room — yet he had taken initiation. Maharaj laughed: then he took the guru as a fashion, which the scripture condemns.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:22 (auto-transcript): “This time I was in Pune. I said, Mahara, where is the pure devotee in this room? I have not seen anyone. I was laughing. I was laughing at him. I was laughing at him. I said, what is the guru? He mentioned. I said, oh. Okay, so you don't see me. is a purity and he went to…”

Brahmanas were outraged that Narottama dasa Thakura, born outside a brahmana family, initiated brahmanas — yet he is an expansion of Nityananda Prabhu. Maharaj tells how Durga herself told two brahmana boys to take initiation from him. Seeing a pure Vaishnava as ordinary is already living in hell.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:46 (auto-transcript): “was not so popular, Narutam Dasekura. He appeared in the Sudra family. He didn't appear in the Brahmanas family. So the Brahmanas did not consider somebody. They look at him as somebody. It's not another case. Until when Narutam Dasekura initiated Brahmana, then the Brahmana…”

At an international leaders' meeting a senior leader told Maharaj there were no pure devotees, pointing at a respected Vaishnava as a pretender — then stood to offer obeisances to someone he had called a neophyte. Many think worse in their minds.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:11 (auto-transcript): “One day we were sitting in a leader's meeting. All the leaders around the world were sitting in a meeting in a Michael. And one heavyweight JVC man was sitting on our table. And two of us were doing something. And he was sitting. Two of us were there. He never spoke to me…”

If you do not know who is who, do not judge; treat every devotee as well as you can. That is our security against offending a pure devotee. — “If you don't know who is who, please don't discriminate.”

🎙 Maharaj at 50:38 (auto-transcript): “we are mentioning these things also be careful you've got to be careful if you don't know who is who do not judge if you don't know who is who do not judge the security for in your fight devotee who does not know who is who, it is to treat all devotees the best you can,…”

children.topic: Offences to scripture and the name
children.note:
Scriptures guide like a mother, so blaspheming them is dangerous. Even scriptures for other levels, such as the Bible, are Krishna's deliberate mercy to elevate people; some devotees came to Krishna through them.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:54 (auto-transcript): “Blathomia of Vedic literature, or literature in portions of the Vedic version. Literatures are considered like a modern. Because the scriptures, they guide us like a modern. The one who guides is a mother. Mother guides. So sometimes you see neophyte people, they will burn…”

Letters are pure; the person arranging them makes words good or bad. Interpretation simply means explaining — mundane interpretation is the problem. Leave the name as it is and chant it: like poison, it acts whether we understand or not.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:29 (auto-transcript): “to eat i will try to be fed i will try to maintain to give some interpretation on the holy name of the lord we usually say mundane interpretation because when you say interpretation see this english everything is very meaningful in the beginning we would have made this…”

The demons of Lanka scorned 'just the name Rama', though it had already carried stones across the ocean, and were destroyed. The name's potency cannot be fully explained; the name is even more merciful than Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:52 (auto-transcript): “the glories of the holy name to be imaginary it might be like, oh this is an exaggeration, it's an imagination, how can the name be like this? No, it's not true. It's an offense. It's an offense. The example we gave last time is Rakshasa, who came from Lanka. They got…”

Have I criticised devotees as neophytes, focusing on their faults rather than their service? Everyone carries two bags: in front our flattering glorification, behind the faults we need to work on. A sincere devotee swaps them.

🎙 Maharaj at 58:51 (auto-transcript): “going internal through reflections yes that is where we are personal introspection five minutes five minutes personal introspection reflect on these questions one regarding devotees eh have i spoken critically about devotees engaging christian consciousness considering them a…”

In a dark room we see nothing; with the light on we see what is out of place. Turn on the light in the room of your consciousness — while we look at others' faults, when do we work on our own?

🎙 Maharaj at 62:28 (auto-transcript): “that we should all of us should put the light the light in the room of our consciousness to put on the light in the room of our consciousness we should put on the light in the room of our consciousness to put it on when the light is off in the room we don't see anything it is…”

Do I see my spiritual master with reverence, or as a mundane person prone to misjudgement, sickness and anger? Do I have 365 reasons for not executing his order?

🎙 Maharaj at 64:19 (auto-transcript): “Two, towards Guru. Do I see my special master with reverence or do I sometimes consider him a mundane person who is prone to misjudgment sickness anger and old age i'll just give an example of really one devotee is oh my guru doesn't know it doesn't do anything i know better…”

A devotee shares that hurtful behaviour makes him critical and dry in chanting. Maharaj: a cat sees what the dog sees and stays peaceful; the dog barks because the same garbage is in it. The temple is a hospital of the sick, each with a different load of karma, so look at yourself.

🎙 Maharaj at 75:41 (auto-transcript): “One time, I think it was in a horseshoe. I think in horseshoe we went at that time. I was sharing with devotees that, you see, a dog and a cat. Yes, Maraj. The dog. And the cat, both of them are animals with four legs. So a cat will see what you are seeing and just close his…”

This process is a hospital; take the medicine carefully and the cure is sure. Rupa Gosvami joins patience with confidence and enthusiasm. — “patience and enthusiasm”

🎙 Maharaj at 79:54 (auto-transcript): “Yeah, that is going on every day. And this process is designed for that to help us make a hospital. So we all come here. The only thing is for us to carefully take our medication. That's the only thing we need to do. If you carefully take our medication, it is sure that we're…”

After devotees share about correcting others and about bad association in Vrindavan, Maharaj notes that the same words can land as a stone or a lotus, and that we see unlimited faults or unlimited good according to our desire. Where devotees discuss Krishna becomes a holy place. — “association is very very powerful it can break us or it can make us”

🎙 Maharaj at 85:18 (auto-transcript): “yeah association is very very powerful it can break us or it can make us depending on the quality of association. As you say, with a pure devotee, you become a pure devotee. If you are sick with non-devotee, you become a non-devotee. If you want to see fault, you will see…”

children.topic: Offence 7: sinning on the name's strength
children.note:
To keep sinning while thinking that chanting will neutralise the reactions is the greatest offence at the feet of the holy name.

🎙 Maharaj at 87:33 (auto-transcript): “next one. Offense number seven. To think that seeing the Hare Krishna mantra can contract all sinful reactions. One may therefore go on with all his sinful activities and then, as a At the same time, chant Hare Krishna mantra to neutralize them. He is a greatest offense at…”

Ajamila called his son out of fear, without deliberate offence, and was delivered. Thinking 'I'll chant later' is a dangerous mentality.

🎙 Maharaj at 88:07 (auto-transcript): “Jamila, he chanted Hare Krishna, although he was calling his son. But there was no offense. There was no offense in him. It is not a deliberate offense. It's not that he was calling his son to consider that he's going to hell. it's just called out of fear by support so this…”

Planning extra rounds or an eclipse bath at Kurukshetra next month so one can offend now is very dangerous. One who offends Krishna can take shelter of the name, but who saves one who offends the name? A weak devotee's lapses differ from deliberate wrongdoing. — “That is very, very, very dangerous.”

🎙 Maharaj at 88:42 (auto-transcript): “and for one to think that yeah it's 64 rounds on a currency day taking birth in Ganga we see the postcard in the lunar eclipse and also So, give charge there and also, and the Khrushetra and the solar lunar eclipse. And there I can purify myself. So, next month I'm going to…”

List everything your guru or Srila Prabhupada expects of you, then see how far your life aligns. Every teacher and parent hopes the children succeed; we expect much of the guru but forget he expects of us. Repeat it in hard times — a U-turn in devotion. — “So why we don't think that he's expecting something from us?”

🎙 Maharaj at 92:09 (auto-transcript): “better okay i think that should be network so i was saying that generally we expect we have expectation from the Guru, but we don't think that the Guru also have expectation from us. So this is very, very good in introspection. So you can really understand that, yes, the…”

Three questions at the end of the class.

🎙 Maharaj at 95:02 (auto-transcript): “Yes, we are ready. Okay. So anyone who has questions, please raise your hand. Yes, Madhuji. Hare Krishna Shrila Gurudev, Lennar Pranam. Thank you so much Shrila Gurudev for adding in so much nectar to this session. I had a couple of questions, but maybe I'll ask just one of…”

If good sadhana pleases the guru, what more makes one perfected by mercy?

🎙 Maharaj at 95:24 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna Shrila Gurudev, Lennar Pranam. Thank you so much Shrila Gurudev for adding in so much nectar to this session. I had a couple of questions, but maybe I'll ask just one of them. It was also from the last class and what you mentioned today. It is that we will be…”

Even good sadhana needs mercy. Bhaktivinoda Thakura begged for the name and received it. Demanding prema as a right is arrogance; beggars have no choice, as they say in West Africa. Like Brahma after stealing the boys, approach humbly. Prabhupada writes that a pure devotee's mercy makes regulated practice easy. — “We are beggars of mercy.”

🎙 Maharaj at 96:18 (auto-transcript): “to be able to do successful sadhana we need a message that is why Bhaktivinoda Takura is teaching Bhaktivinoda Takura begged for the holy name, and he received it. That's what Mjeev Jaga said. He said, alone, I have no strength to change the holy name of Krishna. I beg you,…”

children.topic: Q2 · No time to pray first
children.note:
A busy devotee rushes into japa without praying, and when he does pray it is mechanical.

🎙 Maharaj at 102:03 (auto-transcript): “yes, there is Anurag Prabhuji Gurudev going to ask I think every day that tomorrow I will before starting my sadhana I will pray but in the heat of the moment I pick up my bead and start Hare Krishna Hare Krishna like that Maharaj I was just thinking just I was contemplating…”

If your girlfriend gave you an appointment you would find time; a feast of your favourite dish too. Start by serving devotees, even mechanically — invite them home, serve them on parikrama; in time it softens the heart. — “It's a question of interest, that's all I think.”

🎙 Maharaj at 103:22 (auto-transcript): “good if your girlfriend give your appointment to come and see her will you have time or not yes man you have to it's not because you don't have time It's a question of interest, that's all I think. Yes, my lad. The only name is not attractive. If it's attractive, we'll have…”

Some senior devotees say Prabhupada said things because he was old or because of where he was born. What is the danger?

🎙 Maharaj at 106:05 (auto-transcript): “So it's from Gauradaya Natha Prabhu, he's writing I heard from some senior devotees speak like this, Shrila Prabhupada said this or that because he was an old person and because he was born in a certain place. So this is why he speaks like that. Can Your Holiness speak about…”

Such statements make Prabhupada a conditioned soul and Krishna an Indian man. A sincere devotee recognises at once that this is a fall in consciousness; realising it only after fifty years is a chronic disease.

🎙 Maharaj at 106:33 (auto-transcript): “We cannot compare how dangerous this is. We cannot compare how dangerous it is. The statement shows that profit is a conditioned soul. That is what the statement shows. so it is dangerous and then just look at how foolish we are when did you get to know the properties from…”

People who know nothing of him see from his picture that he is no ordinary person. No one unempowered could spread Krishna consciousness around the world alone. Maharaj says nobody else could have melted his hard heart; as a seeker he would clear all books from his table except the Gita.

🎙 Maharaj at 109:32 (auto-transcript): “Prabhupada is a pure devotee. And it's not just a fanatical statement. I have met so many people who never know anything about the Prabhupada, who doesn't understand the question. By looking at the Prabhupada picture of the books, This man is not an ordinary person. Karameh,…”
