nodeData.topic: Session 04 · Inattention, Mother of All Offences
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj completes the offences against the holy name: equating it with atonement, giving it to the faithless, staying attached after full instruction, and inattentive chanting — which Bhaktivinoda Thakura shows is the root of all the others. He then explains parama-aparadha, the great offence of slighting devotees, and asks everyone to chant one round as if it were their last. In the questions he advises guarding japa time, neglecting the mind, chanting with devotees and keeping the maha-mantra intact in kirtan. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Aparadhas are the stumbling blocks on the path of bhakti; an intelligent traveller removes every obstacle to reach the destination. At initiation our promise to avoid the ten offences connects us to the parampara.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:14 (auto-transcript): “Radha Suniya Missing Mercy Here we want to understand how to become Aparah. Why? Because Aparah means all the blockages all the blockages all the stumbling blocks on the part of bhakti. We want to carefully avoid them so that we can make progress in our Christian…”

Problems come only when we deviate from the process. If you stand outside your own house, don't be surprised that rain and sun hit you. — “why the rain is hitting us”

🎙 Maharaj at 24:10 (auto-transcript): “only when a devotee deviated from the path that the devotee have done. Just like if one is standing outside the house it's your house, it is your own house. If one is standing outside the house we should not be we should not be surprised why the rain is hitting us why the sun…”

Advancing devotees do face serious difficulties, but as Prabhupada said, if our practice is strong they do not obstruct us — they even help our progress.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:11 (auto-transcript): “But as we quoted that day, the Papa said, if I was suddenly very strong, all these obstacles will never obstruct us, but it will help to facilitate our Christian consciousness. So when we say devotee will not have a problem, it means that we will never be obstructed in our…”

children.topic: Offence 8: the name is not atonement
children.note:
It is an offence to equate chanting with religious rituals, vows, renunciation or fire sacrifices, the atonements prescribed in scripture.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:16 (auto-transcript): “Offense number 8. It's a great offense to consider the chanting of the Adekrisa to be equal to the performance of religious ceremonies, holding austere vows, practicing annunciation, and fire sacrifices, which are all materialistic for special activities. It's an offense to…”

Atonement is like a bribe paid to escape the real fine, and it cannot remove the seed of sin.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:01 (auto-transcript): “Two things are important to understand here. The first thing is that attunement is a bribe, giving bribe. Bribe means what? We are not supposed to pay the amount due, but we don't want to pay that. We are giving something just to escape paying the real fine. That is bribe.…”

Atonement is like cutting a tree whose roots remain; it grows back, as some trees grow stronger for being cut. The holy name uproots and fries the seed of sin completely, so there is no comparison. — “It will grow again.”

🎙 Maharaj at 27:31 (auto-transcript): “So attunement is ineffective. It's like cutting a tree down. 100% chance of the tree growing is there, or 90%. Because the root of the tree is still on the ground there, and it's still getting some nourishment. So it will continue. In fact, some tree, like a soccer tree. If…”

Preaching the name's glories to the faithless is like giving pearls to swine; they cannot value it.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:50 (auto-transcript): “number nine offense it is an offense will preach the glories of the holy name for those who are not here and to those who have no faith in the chanting the holy name persons who have no faith in the name persons who have no faith in them who shouldn't give them the name…”

children.topic: A sweet for a lady on the street
children.note:
On harinama a devotee gave a sweet ball to a woman on the street who did not value it at all — a pig prefers other food.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:30 (auto-transcript): “give a sweet rice a piece. We don't enjoy it. I don't remember in Sichir, Highland, we were doing Harinam, so some, what do you call them, some clean people in the street. So we were distributing for a sudden, and the devotee gave one lady a sweet ball, so she So that is in…”

We first approach everyone; when reactions show no interest, forcing the name on them makes them offend and harms them. Leave them until their karma qualifies them for mercy. — “So we don't give valuable things to unqualified persons.”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:48 (auto-transcript): “So we don't give valuable things to unqualified persons. But we have to approach people first, before we know from their reactions that they are affected. They have no interest in this circumstance. We shouldn't continue to push them. You should leave them until when their…”

Doubt at the start — why be a devotee? — is a sign of intelligence. But if after many explanations and practical realizations one still thinks 'I am this body, all this is mine' and shows no love for the name, the name will not manifest. — “In the beginning, doubt is a sense of intelligence.”

🎙 Maharaj at 31:46 (auto-transcript): “There are 10 and 11 offenses. 10. If one has had the glories to the transcendental holy name of the Lord for many times, after many times, many instructions, ideas, suggestions, practical realizations, If all these have been given about the holy name of the Lord, but…”

Bhaktivinoda Thakura added inattention while chanting to the list.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:59 (auto-transcript): “Number 11 is, it is also an offense to be inattentive while chanting. This is added to the holy, the written name by Slabati Notako. he has this realization that inattentive chanting is the mother of all the ten offenses if one is inattentive and chanting then all other ten…”

Bhaktivinoda Thakura realised that inattentive chanting is the mother of the ten offences: without purification from the name, every other offence comes easily. — “inattentive is very dangerous”

🎙 Maharaj at 34:10 (auto-transcript): “he has this realization that inattentive chanting is the mother of all the ten offenses if one is inattentive and chanting then all other ten offenses will come in easily why? because one will not get purified from chanting therefore it will be very easy for us to make…”

Let go of the steering wheel on the expressway to make a phone call and an accident is certain. Letting the mind go wherever it likes during japa is just as dangerous.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:47 (auto-transcript): “it's like about you know to what I said in the modern of all different offenses. All that is stemmed from here. You're like if you are inattentive in driving you're on the on the express road you're on the high speed and you leave your steering and you're talking on your cell…”

Haridasa Thakura names three kinds: laziness — a round, then sleep, talk or cricket; indifference — the name is not a priority; distraction — something else seems more important. All come from lack of interest in the name.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:31 (auto-transcript): “And Hadidah Tsehkura said that this inattentive chanting is into three categories. One is laziness. Laziness means that one is chanting cannot completely say that chant your own and go and do something. Chant your own and go and sleep. Chant your own and go and have no…”

Sitting silently and looking inside is real communication with the Supersoul. Imagine an important meeting where the other person stays on their phone; now see yourself as that person and the holy name as the one waiting. Can we treat the name so and expect full reciprocation?

🎙 Maharaj at 37:50 (auto-transcript): “Going internal and through reflection. Personal introspection in four and five minutes. Sit quietly and honestly, examine your spiritual life. This one is a very, very, very powerful exercise because this is the real communication with the supernatural. One is not sleeping,…”

Two devotees confess they cannot chant attentively and are lazy, even chanting lying down to reach sixteen. Maharaj asks each for a practical plan, such as how they will get up early. — “What plan do you have designed to help you do concentrated Japa?”

🎙 Maharaj at 47:08 (auto-transcript): “What plan do you have designed to help you do concentrated Japa? What plan do you have? I don't have any plan. If I would have any plan in the last three or four years, I would have been successful. I am only dependent on your mercy and only because of your mercy, I am able…”

Asked how to stop the mind's distraction, Maharaj gives Prabhupada's advice: neglect the mind. Give it importance and it grows strong; instead hear the name and hear regularly, until what we hear takes over the mind. — “we have to neglect the mind”

🎙 Maharaj at 53:54 (auto-transcript): “the best way to the best way to get the mind out so that Papa recommended us to neglect the mind if we give importance to the mind then it will become strong in destruction we have to neglect the mind neglecting the mind means that we don't listen to the mind we should try to…”

children.topic: Why the name rises above offences
children.note:
Why does Bhaktivinoda Thakura say to keep chanting, even offensively? He knows our fickle mind and the end result: the name considers our effort and finally uproots the offences. Like a parent cheering a child who dreams of the Olympics, he keeps encouraging us. — “My dear brother, please continue.”

🎙 Maharaj at 61:01 (auto-transcript): “which we are making he's always very conscious of encouraging us to make efforts he said if you are a house soldier you are a son whatever your chance if you are happy or not happy chants whatever is the condition, chants he knows he knows the end result of chanting so he…”

Blaspheming saintly preachers is called the greatest offence; Jiva Gosvami's section on sadhu-ninda shows how devastating it is unless removed from our lives.

🎙 Maharaj at 64:23 (auto-transcript): “Parama Aparada So I've just described one offense as the paramapara, the greatest offense. Satam nindanamna paramam aparadam vittante, to blaspheme the saintly persons who are engaged in preaching the education matter. So the Jeeva Goswami in the Baptist and Daruba explains…”

children.topic: Not happy to see a devotee
children.note:
One form is being unhappy to see a devotee — 'why have you come, how long will you stay?' A devotee once asked Maharaj how long he would be in the room, as if he were suffocating. — “how long are you going to be in the room”

🎙 Maharaj at 65:35 (auto-transcript): “And it is also mentioned that the Parama Parada is also like six. One of them is not to be happy when seeing a devotee. I would have seen a devotee in the mind why have you come here why do you come here anyway how long are you going to stay like we met one devotee and the…”

Walking past a devotee without respect, greeting outwardly while unhappy inside, getting angry with a devotee, and backbiting are all counted. We may not feel the damage because our practice is gross; advanced souls feel it.

🎙 Maharaj at 66:54 (auto-transcript): “second is not to offer respect to a devotee or seeing a devotee just walk past or neglect a person a devotee it's paramaparat not offer obeisance here. I've seen these devotees do it regularly. For some, they don't know the consequences. It doesn't make sense for me to greet…”

Prabhupada told a devotee not to take the movement cheaply, as if we need no rules and Krishna will simply take us back. The acharyas warn from experience; 'devastating' means destroying. — “Better for one not to come to Krishna consciousness”

🎙 Maharaj at 68:36 (auto-transcript): “Better for one not to come to Krishna consciousness than to come here and do all these things. Since devotional service is so perfect, pure and potent that it can completely uproot the seed of our sinful lives. It is better for us to cheerfully go through it and avoid all the…”

children.topic: One round as if your last
children.note:
Homework: sit respectfully near Tulasi and chant one full round as if it were your last chance to call Krishna, then write what was different. Mahatma Prabhu's affirmation: I cannot afford to chant even one inattentive round.

🎙 Maharaj at 71:09 (auto-transcript): “Right, realization through contemplation. Keep a small notebook for this daily practice throughout our current journey. Focus around sadhana. Focus around sadhana. Dedicate one full round today, tomorrow, to chanting the Hare Krishna Maha Mantra as if it were your last chance…”

Prema is hard to attain and we need all help. Maharaj recalls an acharya who, though instructed directly by Mahaprabhu, still called Srinivasa Acharya to direct a deity installation and took permission from Jahnava Mata — showing us what to do.

🎙 Maharaj at 74:58 (auto-transcript): “We have two foot. Yesterday, we were talking about, Guru Dave mentioned, our process is what? The process of kripa, sadhana, kripa, mercy. So without the mercy, we cannot. This afternoon also, we were talking about another time, that's the correct principle. For him to…”

children.topic: No time to waste on bad japa
children.note:
Life feels too short to awaken love for Krishna, so we need every good round. Good chanting lifts us beyond our level and conquers obstacles; bad rounds leave us struggling with our conditioning. — “We don't have time to waste for bad japa.”

🎙 Maharaj at 77:17 (auto-transcript): “We don't have time to waste for bad japa. In other words, we need every good run we can get. And that depends on us. If we know that this is my life and so this is on and all in my life, they will give attention to it. but because we are not so fortunate to understand what is…”

We finish japa sighing that it was the hardest thing we ever did, but nobody calls sinful enjoyment difficult — 'leave me alone, I'm enjoying my life'.

🎙 Maharaj at 77:52 (auto-transcript): “ah it was so difficult so, so, ah the most difficult thing I ever did in my life but when we are doing sinful activity we don't sit like that we don't say that we are doing simple activities we don't say it's difficult Rabu, I'm enjoying my life and you cannot interfere with…”

Questions on japa and parama-aparadha.

🎙 Maharaj at 81:34 (auto-transcript): “Guru Dev, can we take some questions? Yes. It is a time for questions. Shweta Mataji, can you unmute yourself? Okay, we can proceed to Pratik Prabhu. Can you unmute yourself? Hare Krishna. Hare Krishna. Yodamur Karanikali Gurudev. So I have one question and one comment. So…”

At the temple, devotees come to greet or chat during morning japa. Is it offensive to put them off?

🎙 Maharaj at 82:05 (auto-transcript): “So I have one question and one comment. So one question is, you mentioned that we should avoid distractions by our own. But usually I go to temples in the morning to chant. And occasionally what happens is while I'm making my best effort to not get distracted by myself, but…”

children.topic: Better to offend them than the name
children.note:
We have no right to discuss or plan the day in japa time, which Prabhupada set aside. Say you'll talk later, or face the wall so people know. A devotee adds his habit of leaving his phone charging in another room. — “So time for Japa is for Japa.”

🎙 Maharaj at 83:00 (auto-transcript): “yes it's better to offend them than the holy name because they are sources of destruction we have no right to have discussion during Japa time. We are not the one who created this time. Prophet created this time for us. So time for Japa is for Japa. It's not for discussion.…”

children.topic: Q2 · Why is anger so grave?
children.note:
How can being unhappy to see or angry with a devotee be parama-aparadha, and how do I stay consistent?

🎙 Maharaj at 85:28 (auto-transcript): “Shilagruday, for doing this open heart surgery for all of us. Especially me, I'm having a lot of diseases. These Param Aparads that you mentioned, first I thought that laziness, indifference and everything else is more important than chanting Japa, but then there was a slide…”

Anger with devotees comes from false ego. If someone calls my face dirty, why be disturbed? I am not the body. For steadiness, chant with sincere devotees who have taste for the name. — “Chant with devotees.”

🎙 Maharaj at 86:46 (auto-transcript): “that's what we mentioned is paramaparabhi why we should get angry with a devotee that is our false ego it's a false ego that you need to respond by a supreme person and you need to organize that that's the reason we get angry why do you get angry for us for example if…”

How to be happy to see devotees whose life seems to be disturbing others?

🎙 Maharaj at 88:50 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna Gurudeva thank you for the wonderful class my question is about Sadhu Nindana it said if you don't be happy seeing a devotee it is an offense however there are some devotees who looks like their life is to create disturbance for everyone and they are among us and…”

When blasphemers mocked Kolavecha Sridhara dancing in kirtan, he did not even hear them, his senses being connected to Krishna. We hear because we are external; Krishna uses such people to show our level. Don't meditate on them. — “But we hear and see these people because we are external.”

🎙 Maharaj at 90:53 (auto-transcript): “Like, I mentioned many times, when the Kulavayi Sidara, in the Kirtan, he was dancing from his heart. All the blasphemer they look at him, they say, just see this one. He had no even clue to put on In his body, the one who told her that he's a pure devotee, see, see, look at…”

A mataji chants loudly to stay awake; even in the back corner or another floor devotees complain.

🎙 Maharaj at 93:44 (auto-transcript): “Shilakribe this question is related to also Paramapurada and also that I've asked you previously also but somehow the results are not working so I try to chant loudly because if I don't, I will sleep. So as I do that, even if I am at the back of the temple, the corner most of…”

If you have moved and they still complain, it is their problem — they are not hearing their own chanting. When a devotee complained about a loud chanter, Prabhupada told him to go behind, and that was all.

🎙 Maharaj at 95:10 (auto-transcript): “you mentioned that when you chant with devotees they complain and then they went to different floor they still complain yes but there are some devotees and that is a problem so it's not minor It is their own problem. They have problems, so you should not look at that. If you…”

children.topic: Q5 · Kirtans that alter the mantra
children.note:
Some senior devotees lead kirtan repeating or dropping words of the maha-mantra.

🎙 Maharaj at 97:06 (auto-transcript): “oh my god this is working now yes thank you i was thinking uh sometimes we see especially here in brazil some senior devotees they want to make like um a kirtan and in a different way and they don't chant like the Mahamantra properly. They chant like Hare Krishna, Hare…”

children.topic: Leave the mantra as it is
children.note:
That is wrong; the name is not a plaything. Musicians may have style, but must not go off balance — Maharaj's own recorded Hare Krishna track keeps the full mantra. If you cannot correct seniors, quietly leave. — “We should not make a joke of the whole thing.”

🎙 Maharaj at 98:02 (auto-transcript): “That is wrong. Hare Krishna, Hare Krishna. Kisha, kisha, kisha, kisha. Hare Rama. Rama, Rama, Rama, Rama. That is not correct. That is not correct. We should not make a joke of the whole thing. Don't do the right thing. It's simple. Don't take it simple. Chanting full name as…”

Day-to-day interactions keep replaying in the mind during chanting and offering.

🎙 Maharaj at 101:12 (auto-transcript): “before we go actually the offense will it affect physically also Maharsha or just only internally in Chaba it will affect offense and then outside communications when we are just day-to-day communications also some disturbance comes internally also Maharaj so even if we chant…”

What took long to cultivate takes time to go; be steady and patient, as Rupa Gosvami teaches. Maya is Krishna's energy and cannot control the name; given time and attention, the name removes it. When we drop japa for a call, the mind shows us the garbage we picked up.

🎙 Maharaj at 102:01 (auto-transcript): “They will gradually go as we come to practice. Not just one day it will disappear. It will take some time because it took a long time to cultivate all these things. So it will take some time for you to get killed. That's how Rupa goes to be patient. We should be steady in…”

maps.title: Radha Sunya · Session 05 · Humbler Than the Grass

nodeData.topic: Session 05 · Humbler Than the Grass
nodeData.note: CC Adi 17.31 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj explains why enthusiastic devotees decline: when taste for chanting and hearing fades, offences are being committed, whatever the outer circumstances. Real respect comes from seeing every soul as Krishna's part, and Mahaprabhu's ideal of being humbler than grass and more tolerant than a tree. In the discussion he advises neglecting envious people without hatred, taking the essence of correction, dropping grudges and recognising true well-wishers. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Krishna consciousness means absorption in Krishna. As Prabhupada said, it is our responsibility to design our day so that Krishna fills all twenty-four hours; studying Radha Sunya is one way to plan never to lose Radharani's mercy. — “no space for Maya.”

🎙 Maharaj at 17:49 (auto-transcript): “Yau welcome to another wonderful Kati day another day of celebrating our Krishna consciousness in the best way the best way is to be absorbed in Krishna absorption in Krishna that is Krishna consciousness no space for Maya. No space. A devotee should not have space. Our 24…”

Why do some devotees, once eager to chant, read and pioneer, become different people? They take in less of Radharani's mercy. Krishna consciousness is a mirror: rising taste for chanting, hearing and serving means mercy is flowing; falling enthusiasm means aparadha is at work, imperceptibly.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:52 (auto-transcript): “The creeper wants to miss that. The mystery of devotional decline. Why does one person advance constantly in devotional service? Why another excels wonderfully at a certain stage? And then, somehow, the creeper seems to become shocked. We see again and again in the variety of…”

Thinkers may object that the Pandavas and Vasudeva-Devaki suffered constantly. Kamsa slept on his hill with nightmares, while Vasudeva and Devaki slept peacefully in prison. Narada and Yamaraja feel no pain in hell. Kunti prayed for calamities because in them Krishna stayed with her. — “So the environment doesn't matter if you're a devotee.”

🎙 Maharaj at 23:38 (auto-transcript): “Then you can ask me, so what about the Pandavas? Is a mercy pouring in or not? because you don't seem to have any spare time of not having problems. So the mercy pouring on is a mercy or that devoid or the offensive. Pandavas are offensive. You can ask me that because we're…”

Holika, who took Prahlada into the fire, burned, and the men who lit it fled, but not one hair of the child was burnt. Don't judge a devotee's state by his circumstances.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:05 (auto-transcript): “Kralat Mahara was inside fire. Was he burnt? but the person who said the fire was burnt Holika was burnt, she was crying for her brother please, please I am burnt, but fire please help me the people who said the fire was afraid to go to the fire because they entered, they…”

When offences start, interest in chanting and programmes drops and old attractions return. Maharaj recalls missing his old nights out with friends — 'nobody respects me here'. Regret at being a devotee is a sign of offences; real problems cannot stop a serious devotee. — “It means we are regretting being a devotee.”

🎙 Maharaj at 31:36 (auto-transcript): “I remember when I was going to, with my friend, for such a short place, spend the whole night and saying, I'm missing all this now and I'm staying here in this place and nobody respects me. It means we are regretting being a devotee. It means offenses are being committed. The…”

A godbrother dropped the keys in Maharaj's hand, afraid of what was coming, and left. Maharaj stayed and is still chanting — not yet pure, but hopeful that even offensive chanting will bear fruit. — “I'm confident in that.”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:31 (auto-transcript): “I think one day, one godfather told me, Prabhu, take the key, he dropped the key of the movement in my hand. He said, I'm leaving. What is going to happen? I don't want it to happen to me. I don't want to work there. happen. I said, sit down, you stay there and see what will…”

The soul is like a flower that grows with sun and water; when it begins to wilt, offences are the cause. The acharyas lament too — 'O Lord of Mathura, when will I see you?' — but that lamentation is prayer.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:26 (auto-transcript): “The mood behind addressing one as Prabhu. His soul is like a flower or a plant. When the sun is present and the water is absorbed nicely, the plant or flower will grow. However, one day we see the flower changing color. wilting waning until he dies or is on the verge of death…”

Mundane lamentation sounds different: I'm not a temple president, GBC or sannyasi, no spouse, latecomers have disciples and money, I can't even buy shoes. An advancing devotee has no space for these thoughts. — “I'm not even a GBC”

🎙 Maharaj at 34:53 (auto-transcript): “it's even a lamentation oh look at me I'm not a temple president I'm not a GBC after 100 years of this movement I'm not even a GBC I'm not a Sanyang I'm not a wife i don't have a husband and see see people who join after me see now they have disciples yeah they're making…”

Recognising Vaishnava-aparadha is crucial; an advanced devotee sees the importance of devotees and never disrespects them. To appreciate devotees we must understand who we are eternally.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:55 (auto-transcript): “This apparatus. Recognizing Vaislama apparatus and understanding it is very important, very, very important. When one is advanced, one can see the importance of devotees, and therefore, never disrespect another devotee. Disrespecting another devotee is a greatest offense,…”
This Gita verse, quoted often by Maharaj, says that one who receives knowledge from a realised soul sees all living beings as parts of the Supreme. Maharaj stresses the word 'all'.

No sane person throws his phone on the floor; how much more respect is due to the soul? Krishna consciousness is a culture of respect — even the Bhagavatam begins with obeisances. — “It's the culture of respect.”

🎙 Maharaj at 38:59 (auto-transcript): “Even an intelligent person should respect non-living things. Is it not? One does not take his cell phone as much on the floor. It's only a crazy person. We keep it very nicely. And if you miss it, we have an anxiety. What about the spiritual who can manifest these things? How…”

Seeing tall or short, African or Indian, man or woman, rich or poor, we cannot respect devotees. Krishna told Arjuna to transcend these temporary dualities; seeing the eternal soul is the basis of unity in diversity.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:47 (auto-transcript): “So we cannot have respect for devotees when we are looking at devotees on the body. when you are tall you are short you are fat you are thin africa india america japan you can man woman boy girl illiterate literate poor rich we cannot deal with dualities and become successful…”

Prabhupada's instruction to address devotees as Prabhu should not stay on the lips; devotees are our masters, and we should not try to become theirs.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:38 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, we emphasize Sri Lapa Prabhupada's instruction to address devotees as Prabhu. This should not simply be spoken by the lips. It should be realized. What our devotees are our Prabhu's, our masters. It is not that we should try to become their masters. Fine.…”

children.topic: Lower than grass, tolerant as a tree
children.note: Who can always chant the holy name? Mahaprabhu's verse describes one who is humbler than grass, more tolerant than a tree, expects no honour and gives all respect to others. A culture of respect is compulsory for a Vaishnava community.

A tree asks for nothing yet gives shade, fruit, oxygen and medicine — papaya even from its roots. Cut down, it does not protest; its wood and even its charcoal still serve.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:19 (auto-transcript): “a tree a tree never asks for water never asks for help when they're being caught down never us. Yet, the tree will not stop giving service. If the tree is standing, it's giving shed, it's giving fruit, it's multiplying the fruits, it's giving oxygen, it's giving medicine, the…”

Grass springs back up when the foot is lifted; Mahaprabhu asks us to be humbler still. This humility is both the practice and the goal — a truly humble person is a pure devotee. — “A devotee should remain down.”

🎙 Maharaj at 46:57 (auto-transcript): “Trina. Trina means grass. Grass. Chita Mabu said we should be more tolerant than tree and the grass. If we step on the grass, the grass will burn down because you step on it. If you remove the feet from there, the grass will stand up. So Chita Mabu said a devotee should not…”

Rupa and Sanatana's humility was so real that Mahaprabhu said it was breaking his heart. The Muslim officials who beat Haridasa Thakura and others felt such acharyas' humility and purity.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:54 (auto-transcript): “yes sirupa Goswami they are not pretending and Chita Ava said please your humility is breaking my heart please stop you are breaking my heart but when I tell you like that it doesn't break your heart because you're not pure but still we have to follow the process to get there…”

Am I humbler than grass, more tolerant than a tree? Haridasa Thakura was caned in twenty-two marketplaces and remained undisturbed. When corrected or opposed in service, do I stay enthusiastic or hold that devotee negatively in my mind? Which devotee near me exemplifies tolerance?

🎙 Maharaj at 49:17 (auto-transcript): “Going into an hour, draw reflections. Am I humbler than a blade of grass? Am I more tolerant than a tree? Meditate on the Haridas Takura. Haridas. Sakura was beaten with a cane in 22 bazaars or markets, but he was never disturbed. Instead, he smilingly derogated the beating,…”

When corrected, do we say 'fine, I'm no good, you do it'? Or do we humbly ask to be shown how to do better? — “Can you show me I can do it?”

🎙 Maharaj at 50:38 (auto-transcript): “When I'm corrected, how do I feel when I'm corrected? Okay, you do it. Okay, you do it. I'm not good. So you can do it. Now you should do it. Do we feel like that? Or we feel humble and please, can you show me I can do it better? Can you show me I can do it? We saw the queens…”

Krishna's queens met Draupadi privately to learn how she served five husbands so well; neither they nor she was proud. Maharaj also mentions the Yajnic brahmanas' wives approaching another devotee to learn how to become dear to Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:10 (auto-transcript): “We saw the queens of Krishna coming to pick Drupali to teach them how to serve. They were not proud. They were not proud. And Drupali called them. They personally had a meeting with themselves and came to meet in the Dvapadi privately. Please, you are so expert and superior…”

Devotees share from the reflection and ask questions.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:38 (auto-transcript): “all right we have two devotees who've raised their hands from romil mataji”

children.topic: Q1 · Friends envious of my progress
children.note:
A devotee serves everyone, but some friends turn jealous when she is appreciated and exclude her. Should she keep tolerating like Haridasa Thakura or keep distance?

🎙 Maharaj at 58:53 (auto-transcript): “we are waiting for you first of all malas today your voice is very low you are saying so many great things but i have to to keep my ear close to this I don't know maybe my system issue but thank you so much for great insights that you are giving throughout the lecture Maharaj…”

Don't expect everyone to be on your level; most people envy others' progress. Prabhupada explains that a real Vaishnava rejoices at another's success, and envious people in Vaishnava dress are to be neglected. Don't be angry with them; don't advertise your success before them.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:30 (auto-transcript): “you don't expect that everybody would be on the same level with you that that is not always the case that everybody will be on the same level with no so that's the first thing you should understand you will appreciate people with knowledge that yes whatever anyone is getting…”

If you tolerate and still feel hurt, you are only holding back and will one day explode. Better to keep a distance and still help when you can; pure devotees like Narada are not hurt at all and so purify their abusers. — “To keep distance doesn't mean hatred.”

🎙 Maharaj at 71:09 (auto-transcript): “and feeling hot that means you're not tolerant so you don't feel hot you're just you're just holding yourself one day you will explode so so the best thing is to avoid so I avoid the other way I know it is too much I have to live for 10 years now what is this are you the only…”

A devotee from Nairobi reacts well outwardly but suspects the corrector's motive. He tells of an elderly devotee who stood calm and fearless before angry residents who came with weapons.

🎙 Maharaj at 74:10 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna, Shila Gurudev. Hare Krishna. Thank you. Gurudev, I wanted to answer the first question and also the second question. Yes, I do. I try to react positively when devotees are correct. they tell us to change something about how we are doing an activity or something…”

That elder's pure mind affected his attackers — the power of purity. Even if someone corrects harshly, that is their nature; take the essence: he wants me to be a better devotee. — “it doesn't matter the way the person put it”

🎙 Maharaj at 77:32 (auto-transcript): “When we are corrected. If we are Gentiles who know that, yes. I'm here to learn even the person who corrected me in the harsh way that is the person's nature but what is the essence of that he want me to be better devoted so he's talking to me this way so let me take the…”

children.topic: Q3 · Letting go of old pain
children.note:
A mataji tells of devotees she admires for humility and service, but cannot release painful memories, and asks how to stand up for what is right without ego.

🎙 Maharaj at 79:02 (auto-transcript): “please accept my number of businesses thank you yeah so first i would like to share uh quickly about two defaultees that really stood out in my community I could observe. One of them is a close friend of ours and there was a situation where he was being publicly falsely…”

Whoever holds fire gets burnt; the offender may have forgotten while we keep the fire alive, so drop it. Maharaj recalls King Kulasekhara praying to die while healthy so he could remember Krishna. Protecting your own child is simply responsibility. — “So keeping grudges are holding fire.”

🎙 Maharaj at 83:47 (auto-transcript): “Anyone who holds fire will get burnt because of the nature of fire. So keeping grudges are holding fire. It cannot be peaceful. It will be restless. It will be angry. It will be frustrated. That is the result of keeping grudges. Therefore, having known this and also seen the…”

Arrogance and pride are our greatest enemy, and maya's biggest weapon is to make us criticise saints. Outside forces cannot stop us; when we cannot withstand them it is from internal lack of spiritual potency. Radharani's mercy manifests only as far as we are free from offences.

🎙 Maharaj at 87:59 (auto-transcript): “maya's biggest people vice opera requests open stems from arrogance and pride is our greatest enemy. Maya is always present and can do so much damage. Maya's biggest weapon is to influence us to criticize shadows. External forces cannot really stop our movement. We have to…”

Watch real grass for two minutes — how it bends and does not resist — and read the third Siksastakam verse slowly. Journal three devotees you consider below you and how their devotion may be better, where you seek recognition and why, and three devotees above you. Duryodhana saw no one as his superior; be like Arjuna.

🎙 Maharaj at 89:47 (auto-transcript): “realization through contemplation. Continue your 30-day notebook with today's focus on recognizing apparatus effects. Find actual grass or visualize it vividly if unavailable. Sit and observe it for two minutes. Notice how it bends, how people step on it, how it doesn't…”

Further questions after the slides.

🎙 Maharaj at 94:22 (auto-transcript): “So, we have Aman Prabhuji. Prabhuji will give an end. Hare Krishna, Srila Gurudev. Hare Krishna. Thank you so much for the wonderful session, especially in one of the previous questions or reflections where you mentioned that we should go for the essence and not the way it is…”

When corrected on subjective matters by someone with no authority over him, a devotee's first thought is: why interfere in my life?

🎙 Maharaj at 94:45 (auto-transcript): “Thank you so much for the wonderful session, especially in one of the previous questions or reflections where you mentioned that we should go for the essence and not the way it is presented so i really felt it as a point to aspire for uh in first reflection uh i just uh…”

children.topic: We interfere more than we think
children.note:
Even our dress and body language send messages; our thoughts reach people too. See whoever comes as sent by the guru, and cultivate the attitude of gratitude. — “We are 90% internally connected with people than physical.”

🎙 Maharaj at 97:44 (auto-transcript): “Yes, we feel that, okay, I'm not interfering with someone's life. Why is this interfering with my life? Well, that is not true. That is not true. We are interfering with people's life more than what we think, what we feel. Our dressing can give a very powerful message to…”

How can I stop negative feelings rising towards devotees when my ego is triggered?

🎙 Maharaj at 100:29 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna, Maharaj, please accept my most humble pranams Maharaj, I have been questioned that sometimes I mean many times when my ego gets triggered, negative feelings are raised over another devotee and only after some time I realized although but even for some time…”

The only way is to raise the quality of daily sadhana; then good qualities develop and negative ones are transcended.

🎙 Maharaj at 101:18 (auto-transcript): “the only way to do that is to improve the quality of our daily practice. If that is improved, we will develop all the wonderful qualities, or we will transcend all negative things. The means is transcended. That's the means. All right? Yes, very much. Thank you.”

If all beings are parts of Krishna, what if those we avoid feel offended?

🎙 Maharaj at 102:20 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna Hare Krishna Gurudev thank you so much for the wonderful class Gurudev my Gurudev my question was it was mentioned that all living beings are part of the supreme lord and at the same time in the purport it was mentioned that envious should be avoided so my…”

Avoiding them is love: it protects them from more offences and us from anger. Going close out of fear of seeming superior only disturbs everyone; this is Radharani's mercy, not Radha-sunya.

🎙 Maharaj at 103:15 (auto-transcript): “It is love. It's such a love. How is it love? Because I love you. Therefore, I want to protect you from making offenses and and i i also want to stop being also angry or get hurt by uh activities therefore i'm i'm avoiding you it is my love for you because i'm helping you not…”

A devotee keeps silent until his rounds are done and is called arrogant; he trusts his guru's instructions but doubts others' intentions.

🎙 Maharaj at 105:40 (auto-transcript): “Gurudev, my question was that as you have mentioned last time in Vrindavan as well, and today as well, that we lack attitude of gratitude or different sources are the instruments sent by Krishna or Guru. But Srila Gurudev, many times in the purpose of Srila Prabhupada, we…”

Whoever asks about your rounds and rising time is a well-wisher. A thief about to be executed bit his mother's ear: she never told him stealing was wrong. Without gratitude we love flatterers and see real helpers as enemies.

🎙 Maharaj at 108:04 (auto-transcript): “advising us what to do to improve our Krishna consciousness, he says, he says, he says, well-wisher. He says, well-wisher. it doesn't have to be labelled my well-wisher before the person can say something that they give me but the person is dealing with me so I would know…”

nodeData.topic: Session 06 · Why Devotees Fall
nodeData.note: SB 10.14.8 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. On the appearance day of Radha Kunda, Maharaj teaches that devotees fall only because of aparadha, and that consciousness matters more than being right: one can be right and still offensive. Fall-down itself proves that the science of bhakti is real, and Brahma's prayer shows the mood of the devotee who waits patiently for mercy. The holy name is a perfect medicine that works when taken as prescribed, and in the sharing he answers questions on correcting others, feeling superior, and why chanting seems not to work. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
On Radha Kunda's appearance day Maharaj calls the class a feast and a heart surgery, and opens the second session on the impediments that devastate the creeper. He asks again and again why a devotee falls: the only real cause is aparadha; everything else is an excuse. — “Nobody can stop anyone from Krishna consciousness.”

🎙 Maharaj at 16:48 (auto-transcript): “Why devotees fall? Why? Why devotees fall? Why devotees fall? Why should a devotee fall? What makes a devotee to fall? Nothing but a product, a product.”

Consciousness stands above action. It is not mainly about who is right and who is wrong: one can be right and still offensive and suffer the reaction, while one who is wrong and offensive suffers twice over.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:08 (auto-transcript): “Consciousness over action. It is not always so important who is right and who is wrong. You can be right but still be offensive. Very important. Cossing you to literally suffer the reactions of those offenses. You may be wrong and offensive and suffer double or triple. This…”

Maharaj's principle: when two devotees keep a quarrel going on their own, even to the point of physical attack, he does not look for who was right. — “For me, with my little mind, both are guilty.”

🎙 Maharaj at 19:00 (auto-transcript): “For example, it is my principle that if two devotees are having an issue, it is not reported. The both of them go on and on on their own, to the point of physical attack. For me, with my little mind, both are guilty. Both. Both are wrong. So Guruji is saying here, yes, it…”

Maharaj asks where the offence lay in the king who became Gajendra. He was retired in the forest, as scripture approves for a leader, and so deep in meditation that he saw no one and thought of no one.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:00 (auto-transcript): “What was the offense of Rupa Goswami? That a devotee who came to see him was disturbed. What was this offense? First of all, he didn't even see anybody. That is clear. If I don't see you, I'm not thinking of you. I wouldn't offend you. I can offend you. I'm thinking of you.…”

Agastya Muni arrived, took the meditation for a pretence to avoid honouring a brahmana, and cursed the king to become a dull elephant. Maharaj recommends reciting Gajendra-moksa in Kartik.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:43 (auto-transcript): “Agassi Muni came there and saw him in meditation and cursed him. What was his offense? Look at this man. He's pretending to meditate because he doesn't want to show respect to the brahmana. He cursed him. Because he's so dull. He becomes like an elephant. Dull. Elephant,…”

Some are so blocked they see nothing wrong in their own actions and cannot say sorry. Yet a mighty king and devotee living for years as an elephant is suffering: offence always brings its reaction.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:27 (auto-transcript): “Gajendra did not suffer, being an elephant. A king, a mighty king, devotee, taking elephant body, is not suffering? Is he not suffering? Being an elephant body for years? It's always offense, you'll get that. He may be wrong and offensive and suffer double or treble. That is…”

We must stay conscious of body, words and mind. Book distribution may truly be among the most important services, yet one can be condescending and disrespectful to others while promoting it.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:50 (auto-transcript): “You can be right in your idea and should be wrong in your expression of it. That is true. You can be right that one of the most important services is distributing books. But then you can also be condescending, arrogant, and disrespectful to the wise. Even though an activity…”

A senior leader once told Maharaj that cooking is not service, as if the sankirtan devotees' food fell from heaven. Maharaj has seen many powerful book distributors leave the movement while the devotee who cleaned bathrooms for years is still serving. — “So we should not be disrespectful because every service that we do is important.”

🎙 Maharaj at 26:06 (auto-transcript): “but one day he told me yeah he should be cooking he should be cooking cooking is not a service it's cooking not a service a Sankitan devotee does not eat who want to who want to cook the food he eats from heaven just by distributing books in the state from heaven the food…”

A story devotees used to hear often in earlier days, told to show that consciousness decides everything.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:32 (auto-transcript): “It is a very beautiful story. Those days we regularly hear them, but these days we don't hear all those powerful, powerful stories. because we are talking about the consciousness. This story we heard many times those days of a prostitute and a brahman child. A prostitute is…”

The prostitute keeps lamenting her low position and thinking of the temple and the devotees going there; the man at the temple keeps counting the people going to her house — one, two, ten, fifty.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:03 (auto-transcript): “A prostitute is always thinking, oh, I'm very low, so unfortunate. See, everybody is going to the temple. They are worshiping Christ. He's constantly thinking about the temple, devotees, people are going to the temple. I'm not so fortunate like this. I had such a nasty…”

At death each went where the mind had dwelt, as the Gita teaches: she became a devotee. So we should examine our consciousness, because it stands above our action. — “The consciousness, the consciousness is most important.”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:28 (auto-transcript): “The consciousness, the consciousness is most important. What do the body then do? They went opposite. They went opposite. Bhagavad Gita already told us that what we constantly meditate on, that is what we're going to remember at the time of death. So this devotee who is…”

Krishna needs nothing and no one; he wants our love. He has countless goddesses of fortune and gopis serving him, so the one thing he lacks is his own heart — his devotees have taken it.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:04 (auto-transcript): “Krishna does not need anything or anyone. He wants our love and devotion. He wants our hearts. He said, hey, partijani person. Padmana. Jesus said, give me your heart.”

No one comes to Krishna asking for his hands or face; we beg for himself. He asks us for the heart, not gold or diamonds, because nobody asks for what he already has in abundance. — “That's the only thing Krishna doesn't have,”

🎙 Maharaj at 33:13 (auto-transcript): “Krishna wants our love. He does not need anything. Why? Lakshmisa has sata samdhamma saidyamana govindamadipo shantamdhamam gojami Krishna has inumerable lakshmish gopis who are serving him what affects him inumerable so what we need for somebody he has everything the only…”

Maharaj reads a prayer to Jagannatha that refuses kingdom, gold and beauty and asks only that the Lord remain the object of one's sight — this is what Krishna wants from us.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:29 (auto-transcript): “I do not pray for a kingdom, nor do I pray for gold, rubies, or wealth. I do not ask for a beautiful wealth as desired by all men. I simply pray that juggernaut Swami, whose glory is the chief, as always sings, may be the constant object of my bishop. This is what Christian…”

Where there are aparadhas, the spiritual immune system weakens and fall-down follows. A reversal after growth does not mean bhakti was a bluff; it shows the science is real and potent.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:06 (auto-transcript): “He wants the heart. This is one reason why we see devotees in big positions make mistakes, over or even fall. Where they are aparats, the spiritual immune system becomes weak, and we become susceptible to fall down. Fall down is always connected to aparate. If we are growing…”

Like mathematics: apply the formula properly and you pass, misapply it and you fail. Some rise and fall, some never start, some continue to the end. — “It's simply to balance the equation.”

🎙 Maharaj at 39:28 (auto-transcript): “Just like if you know the formula of mathematics and get it right, you have a pass mark. If you don't know the formula, or if you don't know the formula properly and don't get the mathematics right, It's a failure. Just simple that. It's simply to balance the equation. The…”

Those who continue to the end often face more problems than others, yet they carefully avoid offences, build faith in Krishna, guru and scripture, and show respect to all of them and to the devotees. — “They are diligently following the system.”

🎙 Maharaj at 40:12 (auto-transcript): “What is the difference? And people who continue to the end always have more problems than those who are not making it to the end. So why are they making it to the end? Because they are very careful about the apparatus. They are careful. They are very careful. They are…”
Brahma's prayer gives the vision of a successful devotee. Maharaj stresses that Brahma speaks from his own realisation, not from philosophy.

children.topic: Accepting reactions with a good heart
children.note:
The devotee who does not fall waits patiently, accepting every difficulty without grudge: I am receiving what I did, and Krishna gives only part of it because of my spiritual master. As I enjoyed the sins, let me accept the bill.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:56 (auto-transcript): “That means what? So a devotee who does not fall down, a devotee who wait, who presently wait, presently wait, why presently you? Because he's accepting, he's accepting all the difficult and challenges. All the challenges, he's accepting them, not with grudge, but with a good…”

A reflection for the notebook: when correcting someone, was I warm outwardly but seeing their faults more than their potential — superior or compassionate? If I carry this for years and feel dry inside, is bhakti failing, or is it too pure to tolerate duplicity?

🎙 Maharaj at 45:17 (auto-transcript): “Going internal and through reflections. Remember, we should always remember. A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step. Start your reflection from here. Consciousness of our action. Have I ever tried to help or correct someone by outwardly being very warm, but…”

After five minutes of reflection, devotees share their realisations and Maharaj responds.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:32 (auto-transcript): “devotees want to share may raise your hands and then we can take them up in sequence I would like to request”

A devotee realises she has judged others many times, more critical than compassionate, and asks how to change.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:48 (auto-transcript): “I have realized that so many times I have passed so many kinds of judgments to others but most of At the time, I was more critical than compassionate, so I'm also tired because I was more critical. I don't remember when I was really compassionate towards others by judging or…”

We carry two bags: in front, what we like to see and hear about ourselves; behind, what we really need to work on. Bring the back one to the front — switch on the light in the room of consciousness and see what must change. — “we should put on the light”

🎙 Maharaj at 55:14 (auto-transcript): “Take the one in the front to the back, the one in the back to the front. Because the bag in the back contains all the things that we need to work on in our lives. Because by working on that, we have our goal achieved. But my joy is part that he will allow us to keep that bag…”

children.topic: Q2 · Should I still speak up?
children.note:
A devotee stopped correcting improper behaviour in the temple after being taken the wrong way. Should one speak up?

🎙 Maharaj at 57:38 (auto-transcript): “gurudeh earlier i was like i was telling people that okay don't do this whenever i see i just just speak up that don't do this don't do that like that and nowadays i just keep thinking but still i don't speak up so i want to check whether it is okay or not by giving you…”

children.topic: Say the right thing, take criticism
children.note:
Speak the right thing when necessary — politely, as in pointing someone to the shoe rack. Everyone great was criticised, even Prahlada; if the person gets angry, accept it. Hiding the truth for fear of criticism may bring material profit, but not bhakti. — “You should take it joyfully.”

🎙 Maharaj at 61:53 (auto-transcript): “So tell the right thing, whenever necessary. If someone is angry because they tell, oh, Prabhu, please don't keep the shoe here. This place is not meant for shoe. Can you keep it to the side? There's a shoe stand, please. You can keep the shoe there. Why are you to tell me…”

A devotee who chants from 2 or 3 a.m. feels a hidden superiority when people ask how he manages. How to overcome it?

🎙 Maharaj at 64:14 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna, Srinath Gurudev. Hare Krishna. Thank you so much. Please accept my humble obeisances and to the dust of the lotus. Thank you so much. And we are just very delighted after attending this class of Radha Sunya. is very, very much informative and very much learnful…”

Both complexes belong to the body. What matters is doing the right thing at the right time, and the consciousness behind it, which shapes how we see and deal with people. — “Both of them are material.”

🎙 Maharaj at 66:57 (auto-transcript): “It is not a matter of being inferior or superior. Being inferior or superior is body. You don't know about that. It's about doing the right thing. At the right time, to run the right person. So, inferiority, compliance, or superiority, complex. Both of them are material. They…”

A devotee thanks Maharaj for the tool of introspection: when bhakti feels dry, look for the fault in ourselves, not in the process. He asks Maharaj to go deeper.

🎙 Maharaj at 70:31 (auto-transcript): “I want to share a realization also thanks a lot your holiness for this powerful powerful tools that your holiness is giving us I want to share that my experience or my appreciation for this really powerful tool that be introspective when for example you're feeling dry you're…”

Prabhupada was no cheater; he gave the process with full conviction. If it is not working for me, that is my misfortune, because of my offences; it plainly works for others, or they would not stay. — “Yes, if it's not working for me, it doesn't mean it's not working.”

🎙 Maharaj at 74:44 (auto-transcript): “Yes, if it's not working for me, it doesn't mean it's not working. It's working for others. That is why others are going and not falling down. Because it's working for them. If it's not working for anybody, it's not a question of falling down. From where? From where? that…”

Haridasa Thakura chants almost all day and never tires; Rupa Gosvami longs for more tongues and ears to taste the name; Haridasa tells the Muslim ruler that every piece of his body would still call Krishna. Nobody keeps eating tasteless food.

🎙 Maharaj at 75:50 (auto-transcript): “they are not so sinful. That is why you can see Harada Sekhura chanting 24 hours a day or 22 hours a day, 24 hours, 22 hours, 24. It is working for him. That is why he could continue like that day in, day out. And he's not tired. And he doesn't have any alternative to…”

The acharyas laboured without eating or sleeping to leave us a legacy; they would have thrown it away if it did not work. No taste for chanting means aparadha is keeping us from the name. — “The problem is the chanter.”

🎙 Maharaj at 79:21 (auto-transcript): “And for this, they work very hard. If it's not working, they will not do that. They throw it away. And then they will declare to people, don't waste their time to do this thing because it doesn't work. I have done it for a million years. Even if a person did it for a million…”

children.topic: The medicine of the holy name
children.note:
Taken properly, the holy name makes us grow; neglected, it leaves us deviating. Either way it proves Krishna consciousness is real — we have the medicine, whether we take it or not.

🎙 Maharaj at 81:28 (auto-transcript): “the medicine of the holy name when we are practicing in the right way we will grow and benefit and when we are not falling no matter who we are we will suffer a disturbance of deviation from our devotion when someone has a dwindling of their devotional creeper or someone…”

Maharaj confesses he once took something he had been warned against and felt the reaction at once. Those who practise for some time notice old habits losing their pull, and those who stop taking the medicine see the difference by its absence. — “All the bad habits are not so attractive again.”

🎙 Maharaj at 84:08 (auto-transcript): “Those who are practicing for some time, you can notice that, that yes, there's something, something. All the bad habits are not so attractive again. Of course, some are still there, but they're not attractive as before. That is a sign. That is a proof that Christian is…”

children.topic: Am I taking the full dose?
children.note:
If I skip doses of a prescription, I cannot blame the medicine or the doctor. Our prescription is sixteen rounds in the early morning, without offences; Maharaj laughs at the excuse of needing sleep from someone who sleeps ten hours and still dozes in class and japa.

🎙 Maharaj at 86:32 (auto-transcript): “Realization through contemplation, page one. Continue your 30-day notebook with today's focus on the medicine analogy. If my doctor prescribes the medicine to tablet morning, afternoon and night, some before food, some after. And I choose to take just one, or I forget the…”

Even with regular rounds the heart may stay dry because we chant with pride or criticism. Nama Prabhu is a person, fully aware of what we are thinking, so we should ask which of the ten offences we may be committing and beg forgiveness. — “So the name knows what is going on in our mind while we're chanting.”

🎙 Maharaj at 92:00 (auto-transcript): “And we should always remember, we should not forget, we should always remember that Nam Prabhu is a person, is a person who is fully conscious of our every single situation. So the name knows what is going on in our mind while we're chanting. He knows it completely. And we'll…”

A devotee confesses guilt over a restless mind and begs for mercy; then three questions close the session.

🎙 Maharaj at 94:37 (auto-transcript): “unmute Hare Krishna and dear Guru Maharaj please can you my my respectful of essences all grown to Shilapopad and all grown to the wonderful as I'm with you go to peace Maharaj I'm feeling a little bit nervous and and I shame and a lot of guilt especially the last the last…”

children.topic: Q5 · Pressed to take initiation elsewhere
children.note:
Devotees at a local temple keep urging a devotee to take initiation from their own guru. Maharaj: no one should force this — no scripture says so; make up your own mind. — “It is not scriptural”

🎙 Maharaj at 100:11 (auto-transcript): “has this question that in his local temple some devotees are recommending her to take initiations from their spiritual master and they are quoting that this will help them stay connected Mataji wants to know what should be her reply because this is happening multiple times…”

Told she would then have godbrothers and godsisters to help her, Maharaj calls the argument nonsense: whoever one takes initiation from, one has godbrothers and godsisters.

🎙 Maharaj at 103:44 (auto-transcript): “That what? They suggest that if you take initiation from our spiritual master, we will be, you know, God brothers and you'll have God brothers and God sisters nearby in your local temple. You can take help. Any person you take initiation from, she will have God brothers and…”

The mind keeps coaxing — just today, don't worry. That is its trick. Prabhupada said to neglect the mind; listen instead to Krishna, scripture and guru. — “So don't listen to the mind.”

🎙 Maharaj at 105:00 (auto-transcript): “I have two questions. First is, whenever I get some unwanted desire, which is happening every single day, so I feel that it's not me, it's my mind, and I try to convince myself that, okay, Krishna is more important than this, but somehow, I don't know why, I sometimes I…”

children.topic: Q7 · Too ill to rise early
children.note:
A sick devotee's mind tells her to rest at 3 a.m. Maharaj: get up, chant first and take the mercy, then rest — the body will heal better.

🎙 Maharaj at 107:09 (auto-transcript): “Thank you so much, Maya. I have one more question from some two, three days because of my bad health. I was not able to get up on time and I was not able to chant in drummurta. So every time at 3am I used to wake up and then my mind says okay, take some rest because you are…”
