nodeData.topic: Session 17 · Begging Forgiveness from the Offended
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. On Srila Prabhupada's disappearance day Maharaj warns that pretenders take shelter in religious institutions, and that the demons succeed because they know their goal while devotees often do not. Through Jahnava Devi's attackers, Haridasa Thakura and Srivasa Thakura's offender, he shows that the fortunate are corrected and freed only by begging the offended devotee and obtaining their mercy — through an intermediary if needed. In the questions he speaks on hurt from managers, apologising freely, effort and mercy, anger in the family, working wives, and living with a non-devotee parent. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
The most dangerous people create false appearances of authenticity and enter religious fellowships to destabilise them, so that sincere people flee.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:48 (auto-transcript): “To be honest, the most prominent, cruel, and sinful people are those empowered for destruction and who often take shelter in religious institutions. Your most powerful soldiers or your most powerful warriors are those who engage in espionage. They may not only be good at…”

In Kali-yuga the easiest way for anyone to rise demonically is through religion, since other fields are already crowded with powerful people. One who is not a devotee hides under the guise of religion.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:50 (auto-transcript): “Especially in Kali Yuga, we see this phenomenon, very common. Because in Kali Yuga, the easiest way for anyone to rise demonically is through the process of religion. because in the social world, so many people already do occupy the spaces that if someone tries today, their…”

Sincere seekers get discouraged when their efforts are frustrated at every step by such people, who pretend a lot and accept every austerity to reach the position from which they can act out their real desires.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:58 (auto-transcript): “Many people get discouraged when they find out that their attempt to be God-conscious is being frustrated at every step. Because these people, they pretend a lot. They pretend a lot. In the beginning, they do everything as various parts. Because they have an ulterior motive,…”

children.note:

🎙 Maharaj at 87:47 (auto-transcript): “A guru knows that. A devotee wants to go somewhere. A guru says, no, don't go. They do this service. You know the best. By doing that, you become specific. One friend told me, he was a guru, his guru engaged him in deity, he was the head of deity department for a long time,…”

children.topic: Go through the offended one's friend
children.note:
Some don't know how to approach the person they offended. Not asking someone who knows is false ego.

🎙 Maharaj at 89:16 (auto-transcript): “Some devotees have mentioned that they didn't know how to approach a person and whom to approach. When Indra had a serious, Indra had a serious love for the Lord Kirsten and he knew that what he did was really, very, very disturbing, Indra didn't go directly. He went to Loh…”

After offending Krishna, Indra went to Brahma, who sent him to Surabhi. When Krishna saw Surabhi he smiled, and the matter was over before Indra could speak. — “we should ask people who knows.”

🎙 Maharaj at 89:33 (auto-transcript): “When Indra had a serious, Indra had a serious love for the Lord Kirsten and he knew that what he did was really, very, very disturbing, Indra didn't go directly. He went to Loh Brahma to beg him to assist. Loh Brahma suggested he would not go because he had not finished, he…”

children.topic: Sent back to the one offended
children.note:
The offending brahmana was sent by Mahaprabhu to Srivasa; another offender went to Brahma, Shiva, Narada and finally Narayana, and was sent back to the devotee, who said he had been waiting all along and was not offended.

🎙 Maharaj at 91:49 (auto-transcript): “if you are keeping quiet, this this Brahmana, he went to Chitama told him, go to the person who offended. And he went there immediately. He said, oh, forget it. I already forgot about it. Forget it. That was it. The same thing with He went to Brahma, he went to Shiva, he went…”

children.topic: A father's call to the minister
children.note:
Materially, a father with a friend in the ministry makes one call and his son passes a hundred waiting applicants. Spiritually the same principle works perfectly.

🎙 Maharaj at 92:54 (auto-transcript): “Materially, that is how things are working. If you know somebody, if your father has a friend with a minister, your father will just call him and talk with him. Hey, my son is here. He needs a job. That position. Can I keep it? Please tell him to come. That's all. So her son…”

Questions from the chat and from devotees present.

🎙 Maharaj at 93:37 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna, Guru Dev. There is one realization from Raksha Bhatmataji in the child box. She's mentioned, Hare Krishna, my dear Srila Gurudev, please accept my most humble obeisances unto your lotus feet. Gurudev, my reflections are that personally with me what happened is…”

What should a devotee do when hurt by what the managers say?

🎙 Maharaj at 94:21 (auto-transcript): “He's asking, if from management, if they are telling something to the devotee and the devotee gets hurt, then what should we do? If the man is telling us something, we get hurt by what they are telling us? Yes, Guruji. Yes, Guru, there. So, well, it depends on that thing…”

First see whether the hurt comes from our own ego — as when corrected for coming late. If they are wrong but it does not stop our chanting and service, forget it; if it does, seek advice and address it properly.

🎙 Maharaj at 94:57 (auto-transcript): “So, well, it depends on that thing they're telling you that you get hurt. Maybe we are getting hurt because of our ego or because the manager, they are wrong. Which one? My ego may make me to get hurt because he told me that this morning, I came late on the program, so he…”

My mind says I'm right and that apologising again will let people take me for granted. Should I take my stand?

🎙 Maharaj at 96:41 (auto-transcript): “One question. Hare Krishna Maharaj. Please accept my humble obeisance Maharaji, when some disagreement happens with non-devotees, my mind always gives reasoning why I am right. And when I humbly apologize to confront, my mind says, how many times apologize and what if they…”

Saying sorry a hundred times costs nothing and builds humility. Holding our stand only expands the problem; a humble, tolerant person is protected and never truly taken for granted. — “Don't listen to your mind.”

🎙 Maharaj at 97:10 (auto-transcript): “Don't listen to your mind. Don't listen to your mind. the mind will always talk nonsense don't mind, don't mind the mind neglect the mind if you if you offend somebody a hundred times, say a hundred times sorry, do not remove one hair from your body rather it will give you a…”

Refusing to apologise has broken marriages, relationships and even empires; even demons spare one who says sorry. Srila Prabhupada and Maharaj's own spiritual master said sorry many times, and Maharaj recalls a Vrindavan pastime where Krishna apologised to his pujari.

🎙 Maharaj at 99:21 (auto-transcript): “we have mentioned many times that many people never say sorry and so as devotees their life is very dangerous not to say sorry very dangerous position so we should say sorry and we have said how destructive this mentality I'm not saying sorry, yes. It has broken marriages, it…”

How does someone who never realises his mistakes come to accept correction?

🎙 Maharaj at 102:20 (auto-transcript): “Shilagurudev, um one of my questions was when you were mentioning um about uh some of ours are very unfortunate and we are cursed actually to be never um getting some message or the corrections like uh today's cases all the people we saw they were like grossly very very…”

Such people have been told; they are stubborn. When we suffer enough for our nonsense, Krishna shows compassion. Shiva once dropped a gift into a beggar's hand at Parvati's request; the beggar gave it away and stayed poor, because he had not suffered enough to value it.

🎙 Maharaj at 103:12 (auto-transcript): “our nonsense, then Christians will show compassion and remove that. Then we also have the fortune to be able to respond to the correction. These people who never agreed to go and beg for forgiveness, they have been told. I give an example. One collaborator was telling me he…”

Saying 'it's my karma, I must suffer more' and skipping the programme is laziness. The whole month of Kartik celebrates just two things, effort and mercy, which Krishna teaches by example in his Damodara pastime. — “try and try.”

🎙 Maharaj at 107:44 (auto-transcript): “but one can say that yeah, it's my karma to suffer like this I don't have to struggle to challenge my karma I'm not suffering enough yet so let me continue, if I don't go into program yeah, that is okay because I say I have to suffer more that is foolishness that is…”

When a family member keeps repeating a mistake and we keep anger in the mind, is that an offence?

🎙 Maharaj at 110:13 (auto-transcript): “Gumaraz, referring to the reflection, the discussion that was just devoted that participated. In family life, very often one member or some family member, they continue to do their mistake. They're not trying to rectify it, but they still keep on doing the same mistake. Then…”

Negativity kept in the mind matures into mental, then verbal, then gross and even fatal offences, leaving both wounded. Address it maturely, forget it, or keep your distance. — “it will become a mental offense”

🎙 Maharaj at 111:13 (auto-transcript): “it's an offense because when we keep things in the mind negatively it will continue to progress it will be maturing it will be progressing negatively it will become an offense it will become a mental offense it will become verbal offense and it will become gross offense it…”

Should Matajis take jobs so the family can afford education and expenses?

🎙 Maharaj at 114:11 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna Maharaj, Mataji is asking that that is it necessary for matajis to do a job or service to earn money because as per the shastras we are not supposed to go outside and do service but sometimes it happens that if both the husband and wife are earning then it will…”

Times are complicated, so make the best of a bad bargain: if it is truly needed, a wife may help for a time by agreement. Maharaj rebuked a man who would marry only a working wife — that is business, not marriage. — “It should not be a force.”

🎙 Maharaj at 115:02 (auto-transcript): “These days things are complicated now. Things are complicated. So employers say we should make the best use of a bad bargain. If it is necessary for the wife to work, it's okay. If it is not necessary, it should not be a compulsory thing. It should not be a force. I was not…”

children.topic: Q6 · A non-devotee mother disturbs me
children.note:
Misunderstandings with my mother ruin my whole day and I can't remember Krishna. How to overcome this?

🎙 Maharaj at 117:50 (auto-transcript): “the daily activities we will be spiritually we will be progressing nicely and suddenly the interactions comes and there is some like a major like a balcony it will be Rais Maharaj so in that situation the day itself will be totally collapsed so in the devotee side it's not an…”

Expect a battle every day. Don't expect devotion from a non-devotee; plan your sadhana around what is available, and any help becomes a bonus rather than a cause of anxiety.

🎙 Maharaj at 118:57 (auto-transcript): “Yes. Like a battle. Yes. So, every day we shall expect that. What is going to what is the war front? Who am I going to fight today? That's a warrior. A warrior means what? I know I have a battle to fight. There is no rest. so we should know this so we can plan ourselves okay…”

maps.title: Radha Sunya · Session 18 · Rupa Kaviraja's Fall from Bhava

nodeData.topic: Session 18 · Rupa Kaviraja's Fall from Bhava
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj tells how Rupa Kaviraja, an empowered speaker already at the stage of bhava, let a seed of envy grow when the assembly honoured Krishnapriya Thakurani, whose tongue never stopped chanting — and lost his empowerment, preached a bogus philosophy, died of leprosy and became a ghost. He warns against repeating sins after initiation and against scholarly pride that dismisses simple devotees. In the questions he speaks on behaviour in the dham, over-checking for offences, false accusation, true humility, public displays of 'ecstasy', envy and the restless mind. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Rupa Kaviraja was a powerful scholar blessed by great devotees, whose explanations enthralled the Vaishnavas.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:33 (auto-transcript): “once there was a great scholar and devotee called who had also been blessed by and other great pure and advanced devotees he was a powerful pundit and sastry the vajstamas were enthralled when he would explain the philosophy of Krishna consciousness that's what happened…”

To be empowered is to be invested with extra energy beyond our own strength, so that we can do what is beyond our ability. — “beyond our ability and we can act in a wonderful way”

🎙 Maharaj at 20:01 (auto-transcript): “that's what happened that's the meaning of empowerment and when he's empowered means what we have been invested with extra energy beyond our own strength it's not we have been invested energy have been added to us a vision a vision a vision we've been powered a special…”

He was no neophyte or intermediate devotee but at the stage of bhava, where sinful reactions are already gone, just one step from prema. Maharaj stresses that until prema one must still be very careful not to spoil all one's effort through an offence.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:39 (auto-transcript): “He's not on the Bremer stage. He had not reached the Bremer. But he was just one step, only one step before. entering. So it's on the power stage. Very, very, very high. Very, very high. We are here to let us understand how dangerous a power is. That even on this level of…”

children.topic: A seed of envy in the assembly
children.note:
As he spoke on the Bhagavatam one could feel his spiritual master's presence. When Krishnapriya Thakurani entered and the devotees honoured her, he ignored her and threw himself harder into his talk.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:01 (auto-transcript): “It was said that when the Rupa Kavala Goswami is speaking, one can see the manifestation, the presence of the spiritual master speaking to him. As we mentioned, the experience one always has, when the empowerment is what's on it. So one could feel it. often feel that his good…”

He resented the respect going to someone else — 'why has she come to disturb my class?' Maharaj marks this as where the contamination began. — “So that was the beginning of the contamination”

🎙 Maharaj at 25:41 (auto-transcript): “Robert Kaviraj was not happy because he felt the envy of giving respect to someone else instead of him. He felt that. So that was the beginning of the contamination, the seed of contamination he planted. just by the presence of Christian Priyata Kureni and the respect she…”

A speaker on the vyasasana need not rise for others, except for his own spiritual master. But she stood on the platform of prema, above him, and was neglected because she had a woman's body.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:09 (auto-transcript): “When it is on the asana, one doesn't have to get down to offer respect to someone who has also come inside. But if one spiritual master enters, one must get down from the person of a respectful of the senses. And in this case, Rupa Kavari is on the platform. Christian Pranip…”

She had come only to hear, for one in prema never tires of hearing about Krishna. Her one 'fault' was that her tongue chanted the holy name softly day and night, even while eating and sleeping. — “She cannot stop chanting.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:02 (auto-transcript): “She only came to hear. Because as a pure devotee, she can hear. She can hear from anybody. Because a sign of Krishna Pramita is that one is not tired of hearing of Krishna. One is not tired of hearing of Krishna. Krishna Pramita currently has one fault. Only one fault. A…”

children.topic: Pure devotees do everything at once
children.note:
When he rebuked her she humbly apologised and asked him to continue. Conditioned souls cannot hear two things at once, but a pure devotee can hear, chant and see together. No one else even heard her chanting; only his envy did, and he shouted at her to be quiet.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:28 (auto-transcript): “A condition, so some of us conditions, although we have two ears, we cannot hear two things at the same time. But that is not with the pure devotion. Christian Prima Takurani can hear and can chant. She can see. She can do everything. at once because it's on the brain level.…”

Scorning her as a sentimental woman, he went on speaking — but no longer from his guru's empowerment. The ripe fruit of envy makes one unfit for anything auspicious; this is Radha-sunya, the absence of Srimati Radharani's blessing. — “Now it is coming from envy.”

🎙 Maharaj at 35:04 (auto-transcript): “Now he cannot speak again because the envy has germinated and is producing results now. So whatever I will speak now, it's not coming from the empowerment of the spiritual master and other exalted. Now it is coming from envy. When the seed of envy grows and becomes mature,…”

He began teaching that only sannyasis can be gurus, though Nityananda, Advaita Acarya and Srinivasa Acarya were householders — Srinivasa and Advaita with two wives each — and had many exalted disciples.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:08 (auto-transcript): “Srinivas Acharya has married two wives, not even one, but two. He has two wives. And he has so many disciples. Adwita Acharya, many disciples. two wives also many disciples two wives many disciples two wives all of them back to North Dakota he was going for two wives he also…”

Offence is like an investor pulling his capital out of a company: it can no longer pay its workers and crumbles. Likewise Indra became ordinary when his guru Brihaspati's mercy left him, and the demons, noticing, defeated him.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:09 (auto-transcript): “Yes, this is, now one is eating the fruit of envy. This is what will happen. One becomes completely depleted. Intelligence is gone. The empowerment, the empowerment, that empowerment, that investment is taken away. Adashunya. The investments have been withdrawn. Like someone…”

children.topic: What will you remember without hearing?
children.note:
He claimed hearing and chanting were unnecessary and only remembrance mattered — the argument of ordinary jnanis. But to remember or meditate one must first hear about the object. — “What will one remember?”

🎙 Maharaj at 39:53 (auto-transcript): “This is what the Gyanis do. Now he has come back to ordinary Gyanis. No more a Baba Bhakta. Not a Baba Bhakta. Now he's just a Gyanis. Their argument is that chanting and hearing is inferior to remembering. But they forgot that. What will you remember if you don't hear? What…”

children.topic: Leprosy, a ghost, and fame that precedes
children.note:
He became a sahajiya, justified himself more and more, died of leprosy and became a ghost. Wherever he ran, the news of his offences arrived first, just as a pure devotee's fame runs ahead of him; as a ghost he haunted those who offend Vaishnavas, as atonement.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:58 (auto-transcript): “He's now speculating. Wherever he goes, before he... Okay, now, I have been identified as a fallen soul. So he ran away from one place. before you go to the place he's going, his news has already been waiting for him there. As soon as he gets the people, oh, this is Rupa…”

Mahaprabhu took Jagai and Madhai's sins and his body turned dark; after their bath in the Ganges he ordered them never to repeat their old life. Maharaj calls this the instruction for every initiated devotee.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:27 (auto-transcript): “a ghost and his service was to hunt those persons who offended Vaishnavas. So it's somehow Mahaprabhu said that after he took all the sinful activities of Jaga and Madai, and then he asked devotees, how am I looking like? Lord Adhita says, oh, you are now Shama Sundara. Grace…”

One repeated sin brings back the memory of all the others, and Mahaprabhu sends Jagai and Madhai's sins to those who blaspheme devotees. That load is why we struggle to keep principles, chant our rounds and keep vows.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:11 (auto-transcript): “So we should be careful so that we don't start having difficulties, while we don't make advancement in our Christian consciousness, it's because of offenses. and Chitam Ho is sending the sinful activities of Jagad Madai to us so that load is weighing us down that we have…”

The Lord revealed himself to devotees who were free of offence, fully convinced and faithful. If it is not happening to us, either scripture and the acaryas are wrong or we are — the lack is in our faith. — “We don't have confidence, we don't have the faith.”

🎙 Maharaj at 48:57 (auto-transcript): “you have to have faith and be fully convinced that what our chariots and the scripture are teaching are perfect and complete. Otherwise, if anyone of us say that I am fully convinced and I have faith and free from offenses and then nothing is revealed to us, it means that the…”

The reflection asks: does my knowledge or position make me feel superior to simple devotees, have I called someone sentimental who was more absorbed than me, and if he could fall from bhava, how vulnerable am I?

🎙 Maharaj at 52:13 (auto-transcript): “Examining our own scholarly pride and dismissiveness, ten minutes, personal contemplation, policy-based devotion. Do I ever feel that my knowledge, my service, or my position makes me superior to simple devoting? Have I ever thought someone was merely sentimental when they…”

A group reports that new devotees, often less offensive, feel genuine emotion for Krishna as special mercy; seniors who call it sentimentality should instead feel happy and correct themselves.

🎙 Maharaj at 72:35 (auto-transcript): “In regards to the first question, one devotee shared that for new devotees that are coming to the movement, it is common to see their amazement and awe with Krishna. and sometimes some of us who were in the movement for longer might feel this is mere sentimentalism whereas it…”

Pure devotees never feel accomplished. Brahma had knowledge yet could not understand Krishna; Vyasadeva had compiled the Vedas yet was despondent; neither Jiva Gosvami nor Srila Prabhupada called himself accomplished. — “it is empty boasting”

🎙 Maharaj at 86:37 (auto-transcript): “I feel spiritually accomplished. Pure devotees never feel accomplished. Of course, Babakita, I guess I use that word. Babakita, 4.30. that is those who have attained success and knowledge, but still, we see that there are many devotees who have full knowledge. Brahma has…”

children.topic: The proud scholar and the boy
children.note:
Keshava Kashmiri nearly died of shame when defeated by a boy and cried to Sarasvati; she told him the 'boy' was her master and he should take his shelter. Those who feel spiritually accomplished are doomed to fail.

🎙 Maharaj at 89:11 (auto-transcript): “Keshavakasmi almost died he almost died he cried to Saraswati. Why do you describe me before a boy? Why not a man? He almost died. Saraswati had to chastise him until he distant to me. That person you are calling a boy is my master. Better go and take his shelter. So, and we…”

What we are absorbed in when alone and not performing reveals our state. Looking honestly, Maharaj says, many of us find we are mostly not Krishna conscious inside. — “Our internal dialogue is negative.”

🎙 Maharaj at 90:29 (auto-transcript): “and check carefully, we see that we are 99%, some of us, 99% not Krishna conscious. Our internal dialogue is negative. Part two, the reflection plan, five minutes. Approaching those who are dismissed, choose one simple devotee whose devotion is undervalued. This week,…”

Questions from devotees present and from the chat.

🎙 Maharaj at 92:19 (auto-transcript): “So the hands are already raised. First we have Kamalakshi Mathaji. Madhya Ji, you can unmute yourself and ask your question Hare Krishna Hare Krishna Gurudev, please accept my most humble obeisances again and again on to your lotus feet Hare Krishna Gurudev, my question is…”

children.topic: Q1 · Envy at the stage of bhava?
children.note:
How can one who has reached bhava, free of anarthas, still be envious?

🎙 Maharaj at 92:47 (auto-transcript): “Gurudev, my question is that how an exalted devotee like Rup Kaviraj who is in Bhava stage he still has envy in his heart because any devotee can reach on the level of Bhava when he finished all his unearth nivritti completely then only he can reach on that so how a devotee…”

children.topic: An extreme case to warn us
children.note:
It is a rare, extreme case recorded to show how dangerous offences are; until prema we are still at risk and must be careful. — “So this is an extreme case.”

🎙 Maharaj at 93:31 (auto-transcript): “uh there are situations there are situations we call extreme case extreme extreme case not normal this is an extreme case that in history you don't see many people don't bother as far as i know it's only people i know in the whole uh it's only people like i remember there is…”

children.topic: Q2 · How to behave in the dham
children.note:
What attitude brings the full mercy of the dham? Maharaj says to cultivate the mood of the devotees discussed earlier, like Jiva Gosvami, before even setting out: 'I am not going to an ordinary place.'

🎙 Maharaj at 95:28 (auto-transcript): “Yes, Gurudev my second question is that when you are discussing the topic of offenses to the holy dham, then you mentioned that first offense is to offend your spiritual master who reveals the dham so my question is that knowingly or unknowingly every one of us do some kind…”

In 1997 Maharaj and a godbrother climbed to Barsana while boys pulled at them for money all the way. He said nothing but grew angry inside, could not pray and left; afterwards he was warned not to think the place ordinary, and learned his lesson. — “In my mind, I was angry.”

🎙 Maharaj at 98:32 (auto-transcript): “So two of us, we went and we climbed all the steps and climbed and climbed and got there. As soon as we started climbing, our test started. More than 10 boys left and right, dragging hand, dragging shirt, money, money, money. I was tolerating. so I'm going to see some…”

Asked about pushing away begging children, Maharaj says not to do it. Even a mental reaction there is an offence; we are fortunate to be warned before it grows into a chronic disease. — “Quietly go your way.”

🎙 Maharaj at 103:36 (auto-transcript): “I just mentioned. So, it's not doing like that. So, Guru Deh, what should we do if they are very much begging? Just quietly go your way. Quietly go your way. But Guru Deh, they are continuously pinching us. So, break their hand and go to hell. Break their hand and go to hell.…”

If my japa dips after mangala-arati, should I suspect an offence?

🎙 Maharaj at 105:57 (auto-transcript): “dear gurudev you are always speaking about the importance that we constantly check ourselves to see our offenses um is there a situation where we can be doing this like overdoing this in the sense for example because in my understanding as far as you have offenses and as far…”

Going through the day suspecting offences is useless. The series aims to understand the danger so we can avoid it; we become what we meditate on, so check yourself and do the right thing. — “If we meditate on offenses, then we become offenses.”

🎙 Maharaj at 107:16 (auto-transcript): “are over checking ourselves if you are going to go the whole day thinking I will make an offense okay I two percent on this one I'm feeling very sleepy oh Oh, I've offended somebody. That is useless. That is useless. We are becoming conscious of the aparada and not into the…”

Accused of something I never thought of, and blamed even after apologising, what should I do?

🎙 Maharaj at 109:17 (auto-transcript): “Maharaj, my question is from yesterday. For instance, if you are, you are accused wrongly like severely uh i'll give an example like when we give a class about lashman and ram when ram went to the bush and he uh lashman want to take off uh sita and he accused him that oh you…”

children.topic: Accept it, let time defend you
children.note:
Don't justify or explain; accept it as past karma and thank Krishna, and you are purified. Haridasa Thakura would not curse such a person. Time will prove you right. — “let the time prove it”

🎙 Maharaj at 111:12 (auto-transcript): “Don't break your head. Don't break anybody's head. Just accept it whatever it is I didn't do it this lifetime but I was done in the past and now it has come thank you Krishna don't justify don't try to explain just accept it you get purified by that but Maharaj the question…”

How to remove hidden pride behind outward humility?

🎙 Maharaj at 113:12 (auto-transcript): “like a question from Vaishali Mataji is Hare Krishna Maharaj sometimes we are humble outside but feeling superior inside, we may say but internally somewhere the pride is there how we should eliminate this kindly enlightened Maharaj that is not humble that is not humble a…”

That is not humility but false pride, which one day explodes. A servant must be a servant inside too; that is Krishna consciousness and character. — “Character is power.”

🎙 Maharaj at 113:32 (auto-transcript): “that is not humble that is not humble a person who is humble will be eastern and outside it's true humility will be eastern and outside that is false ego do you know how humble I am can you see you are doing nonsense you are so whimsical how much I am very humble that is not…”

A newcomer at a Sunday feast shook and beat her head on the deity's feet until she bled. Was it wrong to call it sahajiya?

🎙 Maharaj at 116:35 (auto-transcript): “So, Gurudev, Mataji is saying that one day on Sunday Feast, there was a Mataji who came with her Laddu Gopal and also she do not chant and she is very new to scorn also but she started dancing and by calling Prabhu and Prabhu she started shivering also and she started beating…”

Neither the Gosvamis nor Srila Prabhupada behaved like that; Mahaprabhu's ecstasies in the Gambhira were in private. Gaura Kishora dasa Babaji drove away a 'premi' who could not walk but could eat: a pure devotee no more displays prema than a chaste woman shows her body — and a true one would not have run away.

🎙 Maharaj at 117:33 (auto-transcript): “When you see Rupa Goswami, I was Goswami. When you see them go like that? Did you see our Goswami like that? They all have deities. Did you see Prabhupada like that? We don't see them. We don't see them behave like that, bringing their deity and beating their heads. Only to…”

If I still feel envy for someone Krishna keeps putting before me, should I keep my distance?

🎙 Maharaj at 124:24 (auto-transcript): “mataji you can unmute in your seat my question is how dangerous and we earlier also even knowing but today we saw it a little little that it can we can fall from the bhava stage also so my question is still we feel enviousness in ourselves like I feel enviousness for not for…”

Don't run away: do practical, physical service for the person you envy, and keep doing it, not just once, and you will be purified. — “you should go and do physical service”

🎙 Maharaj at 125:30 (auto-transcript): “you go and serve the person you should go and do physical service for that person you envy you should do physical service for that person you will get purified it's not running away you have to do something practical to do that do service that I try to do I try to do yes you…”

My mind creates offensive pictures while I try to meditate. How to overcome this? A second question asks how to replace the urge to be master with the mood of a servant.

🎙 Maharaj at 126:49 (auto-transcript): “Please accept my most humble obituary. My question is, how can we overcome the offenses cursed by mind something like happen it happens with me single that i try to meditate on something else but the crooked mind it creates some other picture i get i really feel frustrated…”

Ignore the mind and engage it practically in planning services. It took ages to make the mind this way, so tolerate the results joyfully, pray for strength and persist; Krishna releases us when he sees sincerity. As Rupa Gosvami says, be patient but enthusiastic.

🎙 Maharaj at 127:34 (auto-transcript): “Yes. We ignore the mind. Given the principle, we have to ignore the mind. Engaging the mind in just something practical, something physical. In the beginning of Christian consciousness, the mind has to be physically engaged in something. We have to engage in planning our…”

Is initiation in the Gaudiya Matha also in the sampradaya? Maharaj says Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati Thakura established a pure process, from which Srila Prabhupada also comes; what matters is following properly.

🎙 Maharaj at 131:33 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna Maharaj, thank you to take my last question. I started crying. I thought maybe I couldn't able to ask my question. so my question was about initiation that when i went to kolkata maharat so when i was preaching there i met some devotees who were initiated from…”

maps.title: Radha Sunya · Session 19 · What to Accept, What to Avoid

nodeData.topic: Session 19 · What to Accept, What to Avoid
nodeData.note: BG 4.10 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj teaches the dual approach of bhakti — accepting what is favourable and rejecting what is unfavourable, happily and without regret — built on faith that the goal is attainable, as Krishna shows Arjuna by pointing to those who already succeeded. Faith, determination and enthusiasm come from knowing the goal; Maya is never stronger than Krishna, only our purpose is weak, and residual karma passes if we do not repeat our sins. In the questions he speaks on faith, austerity without advertising, balancing family duties, chanting in the morning, and the dust of a pure devotee's feet. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Day 19 looks at what to accept and what to avoid for a healthy Krishna consciousness. Wherever there is no check and balance, Maharaj says, it is a fool's paradise. — “a foolish paradise.”

🎙 Maharaj at 19:10 (auto-transcript): “So today, we are day 19. Day 19, we are looking at understanding what to accept and what to avoid. What to accept and what to avoid. Yes, there is always check and balance. Anywhere there is no check and balance, it is a foolish paradise. Anywhere there is no check and…”

A senior Vaishnava always said procrastination is the thief of time, and Maharaj recalls a leader telling a huge Diwali crowd in South Africa: what has to be done, do it now, not tomorrow. Not even a moment can be bought back. — “So we shouldn't allow our time to be stolen.”

🎙 Maharaj at 20:52 (auto-transcript): “Bhakti Vasudev Mahara, he always said like, procrastination is the thief of time. He likes it. He always says that. Procrastination is a thief of time. So we shouldn't allow our time to be stolen. No procrastination. And then Guruji was celebrating Diwali in South Africa.…”

children.topic: 4.10 — Faith that the goal is attainable
children.note: We need conviction that the goal can be reached, and seeing others who reached it gives that conviction. In this Gita verse Krishna tells Arjuna that many in the past, free of attachment, fear and anger and absorbed in him, attained love for him.

First ask: did I choose Krishna consciousness myself, or am I pushed? If yes, study the whole 'curriculum' — how to chant, hear, read, eat, sleep and speak — like a student researching each subject of a four-year course.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:50 (auto-transcript): “If an intelligent, Guruji also explains many times in the lecture, if an intelligent person wants to do something, we must check. First of all, is it what I have decided to do or someone is forcing me? Is it what I have decided to do? Is it what I have decided? Is Christian…”

Our teacher teaches what he has gone through. The sages of Naimisaranya did not ask Suta Gosvami for theory but for the experience he received from his teachers, since they had no time to go through every philosophy.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:07 (auto-transcript): “we have to get this done then the next question is is there any person who have done this and become successful and is anyone I can see that yeah there is example yes this person okay okay the teacher who teaching me he not teaching me why because he has gone through all…”

Krishna offers Arjuna a tested method, not an experiment; follow it and you get what others got, do something else and blame no one. The prostitute who followed Haridasa Thakura's chanting reached his result, while one who eats sweet rice cannot expect to burp gulab jamun. — “We will get a different result.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:29 (auto-transcript): “So Christian is telling Arjun here, see Arjun, what I'm teaching you now, I have taught it before, and they followed it, and what is the result? They attained perfection. They attained translation, that's a lot for me. what the Christian is saying. So if you follow the same…”

Dhruva went to Madhuvana with a material desire, yet while meditating he was fully absorbed in what his guru gave him, not in the kingdom he wanted — and so he attained the goal. — “He was fully absorbed in what he was given.”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:53 (auto-transcript): “This is what Dhruva Maharaj did. It's a good example you should understand. Dhruva Maharaj, he had material desire. You know that he went to Madhuvan with a pure Krishna conscious heart. He went to Madhuvan with material heart. Yes. To get something. But when he was doing his…”

Transcendental faith keeps expanding; that is the proof of advancement. When faith starts going down an offence has entered, breeding doubt and confusion until everything is lost. — “Faith doesn't go down.”

🎙 Maharaj at 34:47 (auto-transcript): “So we're talking about faith. Faith is very, very important in anything we want to do. And in Christian consciousness, you'll see, as we continue to practice and engage ourselves fully in this process, There is one thing that keeps going on and on and on, faith. Faith…”

children.topic: Know the bad to reach the good
children.note:
We study what is bad in order to run towards what is good, not to dwell on it; becoming over-conscious of faults defeats the purpose of learning.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:23 (auto-transcript): “That is the reason. We should know what is bad so we can avoid it. We should know about what is bad and continue to meditate on bad. We should know what is bad so we can approach what is good. That is the point. We were getting a question yesterday. Oh, I become too conscious…”

One who knows his destination knows what speed to keep. A traveller who sees an accident should learn how to avoid it, not stop on the road or keep talking about the crash. — “That is foolishness. That is not learning.”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:43 (auto-transcript): “We should know where we are going. If one knows the destination, we know the speed to use to get there. If you are traveling and you're just on the road, just not care about what you are going, I don't know how many years you're going to you want to take you to get there and…”

children.topic: Yama and niyama: the kanistha's struggle
children.note:
The dos and don'ts — the four regulative principles, sixteen rounds, hearing, service, association — are the first qualities of a surrendered soul. Still struggling with them means we are kanisthas, a risky platform where one offends without noticing; we should rise to madhyama.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:47 (auto-transcript): “These are for canister. Those and they don't need for canister. Canister is struggling with these two things. The things I shouldn't do. No LCC, no gambling, no education, no flexibility. The thing I should do. I should chance to succeed on minimum. I should hear. I should do…”

Whatever helps our Krishna consciousness we accept even if we dislike it, like rising very early; whatever does not help we reject even if we like it — happily, without complaint or remorse. — “we should accept it without regret”

🎙 Maharaj at 41:17 (auto-transcript): “So, the dual approach, accepting what is favorable, rejecting what is unfavorable, and this should be done happily, not with grudge. It should be done happily. The things that should be rejected, I should reject it without remorse. Oh, I'm missing something. What am I…”

No one tells an adult not to sit somewhere; a child must be told. We are given rules because we are babies, and they refine us until we naturally do what we should.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:30 (auto-transcript): “you don't tell an adult you don't tell adult don't sit here adult knows the child will tell don't sit here because it's not good for you it's a child so we are babies who have to be told the thing we should the thing we should do the thing we should do he didn't tell him like…”

After the six divisions of surrender are read — accepting the favourable, rejecting the unfavourable, faith in Krishna's protection, accepting him as guardian, self-surrender and humility — Maharaj explains 'no separatist mentality'. — “Our oneness doesn't mean we are merging.”

🎙 Maharaj at 47:58 (auto-transcript): “No separatist mentality. Our interest and Krishna's interest will be the same. A oneness. That is oneness. as understood by our acharyas. That's our oneness. Our oneness doesn't mean we are merging. Our oneness means our interests will align to be aligned with Christian's…”

Oneness, as the acaryas understand it, means our interest becomes aligned with Krishna's interest. That is success.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:12 (auto-transcript): “Our oneness doesn't mean we are merging. Our oneness means our interests will align to be aligned with Christian's interests. That is oneness. That is success. Right? Accepting those things favorable to devotional service and rejecting all unfavorable things, even if you like…”

With these three, and a vivid sense of how wonderful the goal is and how painful it would be to miss it, we make steady progress. Like the demons, who always know their goal, conviction makes our determination strong enough to carry a mountain.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:26 (auto-transcript): “So when you see these six qualities, faith, determination and enthusiasm very powerful qualities faith, determination and enthusiasm if we have faith determination and enthusiasm accompanied by the realization of how wonderful it will be when we attain Christian consciousness…”

Without conviction any small challenge becomes an excuse: 'there are no pure devotees, so I'll chant four rounds'. Maharaj asks: if you don't see one, what stops you from becoming one? Srila Prabhupada said many in the movement are not interested in going back to Godhead. — “What stops you from it?”

🎙 Maharaj at 51:53 (auto-transcript): “So where are the pure devotees? I don't see anyone. I haven't seen any pure devotees. There is no pure devotee here. Prabhu, let me tell the truth. Let me tell the truth. There is no pure devotee in his con. He cannot produce pure devotee. There is no pure devotee here.…”

children.topic: Those who know cannot be stopped
children.note:
Sanatana Gosvami circumambulated Govardhana every day, and had to be told to reduce it. Those who know the goal cannot be stopped; a little confusion stops those who do not.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:28 (auto-transcript): “How many times? Satan goes for me to do parikam every day. How many times? Satan goes for me. Two times a day. Morning and evening. But that failed. Every day. See, Satan has to tell him to say, yeah, yeah, yeah, reduce this thing. Oh, how can I do it? These are the people…”

To stay motivated without anxiety or complacency, know the goal, repeat it to yourself every day as an experienced preacher advised, and associate with those who have attained it. — “We should know the goal.”

🎙 Maharaj at 58:09 (auto-transcript): “We should know the goal. Let us know the goal. We should be convinced for the goal. What is the goal? We should know the goal. And according to one experienced preacher, he said the goal should be continuously repeated. We must repeat the goal in our head every day so that we…”

children.topic: Maya is never stronger than Krishna
children.note:
In 1972 Srila Prabhupada answered 'why is Maya so strong?' by saying our purpose is not strong. Maharaj adds that determination decides whether we let Maya in. — “So our determination is not strong.”

🎙 Maharaj at 93:36 (auto-transcript): “in Neobrandaman 1972, Sir Papa was asked the question, why is Maya so strong if our purpose is to be with God? Sir Papa immediately replied, your purpose is not strong. Because if our purpose is strong, we will not allow Maya in. And that is where determination plays the role.”

We feel offended at small challenges, but Prahlada was neither afraid nor offended when his father tried to kill him, because his purpose was strong.

🎙 Maharaj at 94:38 (auto-transcript): “determination is very strong we get offended when we get some challenges but brother was offended once his father was going to kill was he afraid was you offended was it i think so why why you allow this you know i'm a devotee they will never because they don't feel it we are…”

Progress is not always vertical, and old reactions — like the blades of a fan still turning after it is unplugged — may still reach us. It is a debt we owe; nothing comes without a connection to us. Pay it, and be careful never to repeat the sin.

🎙 Maharaj at 97:36 (auto-transcript): “So when one is paying for the things we have done in the past so we can get free, we may think that, oh, why? Why all this? It is a debt we have owed, and we have to pay it. And nothing could come to us without having some connection with it. Everything comes because we have…”

Questions from devotees present and from the chat.

🎙 Maharaj at 103:12 (auto-transcript): “Now we can we take question answers? Yes. That is where we are now. Okay. Thank you so much. So Madhvi Manjidhi Mataji can you unmute yourself? We cannot hear you. We cannot hear you. Mataji you are muted.”

children.topic: Q1 · My faith or a pure devotee's?
children.note:
A pure devotee implants faith in his hearers. How do I know whether it is mine or borrowed?

🎙 Maharaj at 104:07 (auto-transcript): “So my question is, Maharaj, so I heard pure devotee implants faith that they have in their heart, in the listeners who are hearing them. How do one know whether one has their own faith or we are operating under Shraddha Baas or faith that was given to us by pure devotee? Need…”

If faith keeps increasing whatever happens, it is transcendental and pure; if it falls when something happens, it is our mind working on its own. — “Whichever one is there, faith is faith.”

🎙 Maharaj at 104:34 (auto-transcript): “Whichever one is there, faith is faith. If it is strong, it will act powerfully. If it is a strong faith, genuine faith, it will always keep us in tools in Christian consciousness. So if our faith is increasing, whatever happens to us, our faith is increasing, it means that…”

children.topic: Q2 · They won't appreciate the Vaishnavas
children.note:
If someone I'm helping does not appreciate the Vaishnavas, should I still take them to my teachers?

🎙 Maharaj at 106:28 (auto-transcript): “Mayas, I have heard from my seniors that if I want to truly help someone, then I should connect them with the pure devotees somehow but sometimes even when a person is suffering, they don't wish to understand the they don't want to understand the greatness of the Vaishnavas…”

A devotee kept taking his contacts to a senior who discouraged them, and they quit each time. Maharaj told him not to wait for the Supersoul to tell him to stop: take people where they are encouraged, and accept or reject by what helps their Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 107:18 (auto-transcript): “Although we are following a process of rules and regulations, But that doesn't mean that we don't use our intelligence sometimes. It's a use of intelligence. One devotee told me he was preaching to some people. And every time he takes these people to a senior devotee, the…”

Senior devotees ask why I fast so strictly in Damodara month and on Ekadasi. What should I do?

🎙 Maharaj at 109:35 (auto-transcript): “this is regarding on Paramgati Maharaj Paramagati so even in Damotar Prabhupada has given that Urjha Vrtha and even Ega Desi also it has to be followed as a Nirchal but even the senior devotees are thinking why you are making so much austerity like that, why you are doing so…”

Keep it to yourself, as the Gosvamis did their great austerities quietly; telling those who don't do it breeds hidden envy. Seniority is measured by surrender, not years. Nothing wonderful happens without austerity, so design your own life and don't be led by those not going back to Godhead. — “do it but don't advertise it”

🎙 Maharaj at 110:49 (auto-transcript): “not doing something it's only not doing something if you go and tell the person about that they will not give you a very good result so don't don't go and tell them just keep this thing to yourself yes so about this is what it's a career he performed chat to the Messiah he…”

Pleasing husband and family sometimes seems to spoil bhakti. How to balance?

🎙 Maharaj at 115:33 (auto-transcript): “Krishna, Gurudev Mataji is asking which are the particular things which we need to follow because sometimes it happens that we have to please our husband or the family also and we get confused and sometimes we feel that our bhakti will get spoiled. so what exactly and how we…”

Everyone has the same general duties — rounds, principles, service, hearing. Plan household and devotional activities like a student's timetable; extra austerities are personal, according to faith.

🎙 Maharaj at 116:14 (auto-transcript): “we have general duties we have general duties that everyone should follow married or not married wife or husband we have general rules to follow that we have to chances here as minimum whatever we are we should do that, keep the principles whatever we are we have a service…”

children.topic: Q5 · Must rounds be done in the morning?
children.note:
Is it compulsory to finish sixteen rounds in the morning?

🎙 Maharaj at 120:50 (auto-transcript): “Gurudev Mataji is asking that is 16 rounds compulsory to chant in the morning will that affect our progress in Krishna consciousness Harakrishna Mantra we chant it anytime any time, the whole 24 hours you can chant the holiness and astronomers or astrologers they are based on…”

The name can be chanted any time, but the early morning is in goodness, the afternoon in passion and the night in ignorance; the favourable time helps us, the conditioned ones, not the name.

🎙 Maharaj at 121:07 (auto-transcript): “we chant it anytime any time, the whole 24 hours you can chant the holiness and astronomers or astrologers they are based on their understanding about the planetary systems and the stars, positions they have designed the 24 hours into three sessions goodness, passion and…”

That is why it is called mangala-arati. The acaryas begin their writings auspiciously and one of the Gosvamis teaches that we should also end auspiciously, as a meal ends with sweets; the day you don't finish your rounds in the morning is the most disorganised.

🎙 Maharaj at 123:38 (auto-transcript): “Our morning duty, we should get up early before 4 o'clock and chant, do mangal arati. We call it mangal because we don't call afternoon mangal. We don't call evening mangal. This morning, we say mangal, mangal aspicious. And it is good to begin things auspiciously. So we say,…”

Should I keep practising with anarthas, or first stop the unfavourable activity, which sometimes burns me out?

🎙 Maharaj at 127:01 (auto-transcript): “Maharaj Ji, initially it seems difficult to do Pratikulyasa Varjanam so shall we keep on practicing with the anarthah, with the hope that unfavorable things will eventually go away or first stop the activity which sometimes burns us out. Kindly enlighten Maharaji. If we do…”

Everyone begins impure; the potency of the practice gradually clears the anarthas. Mahaprabhu established bhakti so that whoever attempts it succeeds, and Srila Prabhupada promised success to those who stick to the process. — “Stick to the process.”

🎙 Maharaj at 127:19 (auto-transcript): “Maharaji. If we do auspiciously, we cannot be burnt out. Our japa, no conditions will begin chanting with the pure chanting. Otherwise, we cannot call it namah para, namah baas. We begin everything from the beginning in an improper way. Then gradually by the force of the…”

children.topic: Q7 · The dust of a pure devotee's feet
children.note:
What does taking shelter of a pure devotee's foot-dust mean in practice?

🎙 Maharaj at 129:42 (auto-transcript): “right taking a dust at lotus feet of pure devotee, sheltered by love, sheltered internally, being another shade of lotus feet Mahaseva, being connected always so I wanted to hear from you again about this I wanted to have a better understanding the dust from the feet I want…”

Quoting the Bhagavatam's verse that austerity, charity and the rest do not succeed without the dust of great devotees' feet, Maharaj says take foot-dust, foot-bath water and food remnants directly, serve physically and give gifts to devotees — at least take remnants every day.

maps.title: Radha Sunya · Session 20 · Sin Is Dust, Offence a Thunderbolt

nodeData.topic: Session 20 · Sin Is Dust, Offence a Thunderbolt
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj contrasts sin, an assault on ordinary morality that can be washed off like dust from a mirror, with aparadha, an attack on sanatana-dharma that strikes like a thunderbolt and affects our whole devotional life and even our family. Offences to devotees seem invisible because no one arrests us for them, yet even Krishna would not free Durvasa: only the offended devotee can forgive, so we must beg and actually obtain their mercy. In the questions he speaks on leaving blasphemy, quality practice and surrender, real knowledge, offences one cannot trace, correcting grown children, and how to approach the spiritual master. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Day 20 asks what devastates spiritual life most. A sin is an assault on morality and ordinary piety; an aparadha attacks sanatana-dharma itself, sabotaging the attempt at transcendence, and is far harder to rectify.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:54 (auto-transcript): “sin versus aparada the critical question what is more serious a sin or an aparada think about it they are actually different an aparada is more serious because it is not as easy to rectify as a sinful activity an assault on ordinary dharma”

children.topic: Dust on a mirror, a thunderbolt
children.note:
Quoting a senior Vaishnava, Maharaj says sin is like dust on a mirror that a hand or cloth can wipe off, while an aparadha is like a thunderbolt that no hand can turn away. — “Thunderbolts are devastating.”

🎙 Maharaj at 19:11 (auto-transcript): “His Holiness God Kishore Bahara said sin like a dust and a mirror we can use cloth to clean it we can use our hand to clean it we can use cloth to clean it apparats like thunderbolt You cannot use hand to turn away thunderbolts. Thunderbolts are devastating. So they are…”

Taking intoxicants, illicit dealings, uncleanliness and habitual lying go against morality; one can become free from them relatively easily.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:05 (auto-transcript): “For example, what is sin? So, I take alcohol. That is sin. You want to take alcohol. That is sin. You want to break principle. That is sin. Elicit condition. It is sin. Who can rectify these sins? Yes. It may also be against someone else or involve someone else. Like for…”

Killing or insulting a devotee is aparadha, because then preaching cannot go on. — “Preaching will not go on.”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:21 (auto-transcript): “How do we attack the Sanatana Dharma? So, apparada. If one kill a devotee or insult a devotee, it's an apparada. It's an apparada. Preaching will not go on. We don't have a devotee. Preaching is not going on. Or people who are misrepresenting religion of Krishna, Sanaparath,…”

Misrepresenting Krishna's religion confuses people: hearing that this philosopher says one thing and that one another, and seeing religion used to misbehave, people lose faith.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:18 (auto-transcript): “We mentioned the other day, people who are faithless and doubtful, they are doing this because of Canada said this, Jaimini said this. Kapil said this. Gautam said this. So which one is correct here? Which one? Because what I will say, what you say, what you say, whatever you…”

children.topic: A special hell for religious cheaters
children.note:
As political leaders get a special prison, there is a special hell for religious cheaters, who make the preaching duty very difficult; blaspheming Mahaprabhu and the acaryas is also devastating.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:08 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, a special hell has been created for religious cheetahs. Special. Special. Like, you know, we have a special hell for political leaders. Political leaders have a different cell. A presidential hell, prison. Yes. So it's a special hell for religious cheetahs.…”

Sin can be settled impersonally, like paying a court fine for theft without ever meeting the victim. But killing a person is more than a sin, and an aparadha deprives us of mercy and directly cripples our devotional service. — “It is more than a sin.”

🎙 Maharaj at 25:42 (auto-transcript): “If you want to steal something, you go to court. They charge you a fine. They charge you a fine for stealing something. You pay a little fine. It's not worse. But if you kill a person, if you kill a person, It is no more a sin. It is more than a sin. We can break a law and…”

If I break a principle my family does not suffer for it, but with an aparadha the family members participate in the offence and are deprived of help too. — “So it's more serious.”

🎙 Maharaj at 27:40 (auto-transcript): “Yeah, if I break any pill, your family members are not going to suffer for that. That's more secret or taking alcohol. Your family members are not going to do that. But if we are of any purity, family members will participate in that offense. That's it. So it's more serious.…”

Srila Gour Govinda Swami's explanation: lifetimes of sin are layers of dust, washed away even at the stage of namabhasa, as for Ajamila calling his son Narayana; offences are thunderbolt-hard layers. Maharaj adds that a thunderbolt strikes the head and everything is over. — “It's finished. It's finished.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:29 (auto-transcript): “Slagovina Maharaj's explanation. Duli Lepa, that is dust, versus Pajra Lepa. One should understand that there is a difference between sinful activity and offense. One may be a greatly sinful person who has committed many sinful activities in this life and previous lives. But…”

children.topic: Even the creeper at Krishna's feet
children.note:
The Caitanya-caritamrta describes how even a powerful devotee whose creeper of devotion has climbed to Krishna's feet can lose everything through an offence.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:46 (auto-transcript): “In Rupa Shiksha, Chaitanya chapter 8, Madhalila, chapter 19, it is described that even if a very spiritually powerful person whose Bhakta Lata devotional creeper has climbed up to the feet of Krishna commit offenses, everything can be finished. Reflection. What are some…”

children.topic: Why offences to devotees seem invisible
children.note:
Announce on the radio that you are president of Nigeria and you will be arrested before you leave the station. Declare yourself God for a lifetime and you get followers, property and people drinking your foot-water — nothing seems to happen. — “You will be arrested.”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:15 (auto-transcript): “justify or forget than moral or ritual mistakes if one if one go to the radio station announce ladies and gentlemen from today I am the president of Nigeria the Federal Republic the commander-in-chief for the Federal Republic of Nigeria. I am now the president of this…”

children.topic: Swearing in court or at a shrine
children.note:
People swear on scriptures in court as a formality, but will not swear before traditional deities, because they know justice there is immediate and there is no hiding.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:38 (auto-transcript): “In the social world, you can go to court and use the scripture to swear. You can swear with the Koran or Bible or Bhagavad Gita, but you cannot swear in our traditional worshippers.”

Group reports add that offences are subtle and internal: anger, not listening, not offering obeisances — no one is there to check us, unlike gross mistakes. Remedies offered include strong sadhana, gratitude and seeing devotees' qualities.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:22 (auto-transcript): “So the discussion where as you mentioned that it is easy to declare ourselves as president. It is easy to declare ourselves as God rather than declaring ourselves as president. So the uprothers towards devotees are so subtle in nature that it cannot be upfront recognized.…”

Krishna told Durvasa he could not help him; only Ambarisa could. If the Supreme Lord does not wash it off, who can? Only the Vaishnava who was offended. — “That is a process.”

🎙 Maharaj at 67:43 (auto-transcript): “That is a bona fide process. The same thing happened to that Brahmana who wanted to defame Sri Va's bondage, Navadipa. He offended Sri Baas. Now he got leprosy. And he's going to Luchita Mahaprabhu to go and beg him for people. You are part of the police. Excuse me. Luchita…”

The brahmana who defamed Srivasa Thakura got leprosy and begged Mahaprabhu, who drove him off and then told him the only way: go to the one you offended.

🎙 Maharaj at 67:46 (auto-transcript): “The same thing happened to that Brahmana who wanted to defame Sri Va's bondage, Navadipa. He offended Sri Baas. Now he got leprosy. And he's going to Luchita Mahaprabhu to go and beg him for people. You are part of the police. Excuse me. Luchita Mahaprabhu for the first time…”

Some do wrong and get some third person to declare them forgiven. If someone takes my phone, how can a bystander forgive it? The one who lost it is the one who feels it.

🎙 Maharaj at 68:31 (auto-transcript): “otherwise there are a group of Christians who will do something wrong and go and tell somebody to forgive them and the foolish people will tell them you are forgiven how are you forgiven? because the person I have taken your cell phone and someone is forgiven for taking my…”

Durvasa went to Brahma, Shiva and Narada, who could not help, and finally to Narayana, who sent him back to Ambarisa; there he fell flat, touched his feet and obtained his mercy.

🎙 Maharaj at 69:21 (auto-transcript): “The same thing, Christian told Dravastamuni, yes, Dravastamuni, Dravastamuni went to Brahma, Lord Brahma said, I'm sorry, I cannot help you. He went to Loshiva, Loshiva said, I'm sorry, I cannot help you. And he went to Naradham, and Naradhamunni told him, the same thing, I…”

Begging is incomplete without obtaining mercy or making restitution — return the phone or buy another. Search for a phone lost in Mumbai in Mumbai, not London: beg the very person you offended, take the dust of their feet, and you get the strength not to repeat it.

🎙 Maharaj at 70:13 (auto-transcript): “So begging for forgiveness is not complete without obtaining the missing. Or there should be restitution. Restitution means that, yeah, return my phone back to me, or you buy another one and give it to me. So my mind will be off from that of the pain I will get for not saving…”

Daksha begged Lord Shiva's forgiveness but thought himself superior to his son-in-law, never obtained Shiva's mercy, and kept repeating the offence.

🎙 Maharaj at 72:57 (auto-transcript): “This happened to Daksha because when he offended Loshiba, he didn't obtain Loshiba's mercy. He went to beg to Shiva for forgiveness, but he did not obtain his mercy because in his eye was his thinking, I'm superior to this person. He's my son-in-law, so he's superior to me.…”

In the contemplation devotees picture Krishna saying he will not wash away their offence, feel it, then write which devotee they must approach, what they will say and when.

🎙 Maharaj at 73:30 (auto-transcript): “Realization through contemplation. Sit quietly, close your eyes, visualize this sin. You are standing before Krishna. We have committed a serious parashamaparad like Dr. Vassamuni did. We are begging him, Krishna, please forgive me. Please wash this away. Krishna looks at you…”

Questions from devotees present and from the previous day.

🎙 Maharaj at 75:53 (auto-transcript): “so we will now open the floor for further questions if anybody have any questions they want to clarify please feel free to raise your hand and we will request Srila Gurudev to address them we have a question from yesterday okay just checking until then Gurudev we have…”

If I leave or stop someone blaspheming a devotee and they get offended, is that an offence? What about in-laws who expect us to listen?

🎙 Maharaj at 76:52 (auto-transcript): “Maharaji, my question is that if some devotee blasphemes the other devotee and we are standing there and if they are talking and we somehow go away from that place or if we ask the devotee to not talk about the other devotee, and if that devotee who is talking gets offended,…”

Rejecting an attempt to drag you into offence protects you and helps the speaker. If you cannot change the topic or the person, excuse yourself and leave. — “Even if the person gets angry, that is not an offense.”

🎙 Maharaj at 77:23 (auto-transcript): “No, if you have to. Someone is trying to rub you into his or her sinfulness, your offensive mentality, and you reject it. Even if the person gets angry, that is not an offense. That is correct. you have defended yourself and also help that person because if you don't give the…”

How do we raise the internal potency to handle external things?

🎙 Maharaj at 80:24 (auto-transcript): “In one of the sessions, Maharaj, there was a point, we are unable to handle external things due to lack of internal potency. And then how to raise that internal potency you mentioned by increasing the quality of daily practice. So I would like to understand from you What does…”

Chant and hear nicely, avoid distractions and joking around, and don't compromise: skipping Ekadasi for a childhood friend's party, or keeping relationships by joining what is improper, means we are not ready.

🎙 Maharaj at 80:56 (auto-transcript): “Quality practice Chant nicely So hear it nicely Try to avoid all distractions There's no joking around Not compromising What we're supposed to do we should just be sentimental about everything oh no this is this is my friend this is my childhood friend”

children.topic: The shoe doesn't choose its day
children.note:
A shoe never tells its owner to wear it only on Sundays, and a soldier cannot tell his commander he will come next week. Many write that they cannot follow instructions; the only reason is that we are not yet surrendered — one who is finds following easy. — “That is surrender.”

🎙 Maharaj at 84:24 (auto-transcript): “A shoe cannot tell the owner, no, no, no, Master, don't wear me today. You can only wear me on Sundays. A shoe cannot do like that. Our watch cannot do like that. Our dress cannot do like that. Our car cannot. No, no, no. It can't drive me today. Only on one is this. No. They…”

Having real knowledge one sees all as part of Krishna. Why don't we see it?

🎙 Maharaj at 88:27 (auto-transcript): “So you mentioned one of the sessions, like, you know, Bhagavad Gita 4.35, having obtained real knowledge, then you start to see everybody as a part and parcel of the Supreme Lord. So what does it really mean by having obtained real knowledge, Maharaj? I mean, we have been…”

When the knowledge is received, we cannot abuse or disrespect anyone. If not, our approach, inquiry or service is not selfless; Arjuna said his illusion was gone and he would do whatever Krishna said, and so everything entered him. Sitting with the guru while blocked inside, the message cannot enter.

Do sixteen rounds mean one is surrendered? And is harming a non-devotee also an aparadha?

🎙 Maharaj at 95:47 (auto-transcript): “Ranvath Pranam my respectful and humble obeisance is on to you Guru Maharaj as you wonderfully explained surrender right now so I want to ask according to each person surrender must be different I don't know how different but surrender must be different so like Prabhupada…”

children.topic: Motives, and anyone can be offended
children.note:
One can chant and follow just to be sent abroad; that is not surrender. Aparadha can be done to anyone — a child, a spouse, a friend — and whoever it is, if you beg you will be forgiven.

🎙 Maharaj at 96:41 (auto-transcript): “It is not always that someone is chanting, she's here only surrounded. I can be chanting, she's here with some motive. I may chant, she's here around, keep the principle so that a special master will send me to America. I will go to America. That's the ultimate goal of my…”

children.topic: Q5 · I can't trace everyone I offended
children.note:
Must we go to every devotee we offended? What if we cannot remember them all?

🎙 Maharaj at 99:02 (auto-transcript): “she is asking that we usually you know often so many devotees so is it like we have to go to everybody and ask for forgiveness is it like we have to message them or we have to go to each one of them and ask for forgiveness so I think with your answer you have clarified that…”

children.topic: Go to them, or to the deities
children.note:
Madhai, unable to remember all he had offended, served by building a bathing ghat on the Ganges so that all who came would bless him. If you know the person, go; if not, beg before the deities, and serving Srimati Radharani brings Krishna's help.

🎙 Maharaj at 99:48 (auto-transcript): “Madai told I don't remember I can't remember everybody that I offended because in my madness I don't I don't see people I offended and there are too many I don't even know who are the people so what to do so all I need to say is we go and dig with God at the Ganga so people…”

Can we just ask Lord Jagannatha's forgiveness?

🎙 Maharaj at 101:20 (auto-transcript): “Maharas accept my humble opinions if we ask forgiveness from the Lord Jagannath in some situation if you go and ask forgiveness from Jagannath, please forgive me like that, so on, so on happen like that before you go through Jagannath you should go and beg the person first if…”

children.topic: First the person, then the Lord
children.note:
If you know the person, beg them first. You can pray to Jagannatha to help that devotee's heart forgive you when you go sincerely.

🎙 Maharaj at 101:47 (auto-transcript): “you should go and beg the person first if you know the person you should go that will give me a prediction then you can tell the Jagannath later or tell Jagannath to please help the person you are going to beg so the person can forgive you I know my friend is very great…”

children.topic: Q7 · Karma from free chanting beads?
children.note:
Maharaj says there is no karma in giving beads freely to encourage people to chant; he knows of no acarya who says otherwise.

🎙 Maharaj at 102:22 (auto-transcript): “one more question Maharaj regarding this chanting beat so when the newcomers come when we give the chanting beat back so sometimes they were very knowable person so when right now they don't have money so I can get like amount like later Maharaj that will come to the karmic…”

Is correcting a grown son an offence — for example a brother who left brahmacari life?

🎙 Maharaj at 105:30 (auto-transcript): “Shreela Gurudev, Maharaj is pointing out with a question that she understands that aparadha made even to the kids are also aparadas. But let's say we are as parents, we are correcting our grown-up childs, let's say 20-year-old child. does that also quantify as aparadha? And…”

children.topic: Correct nicely; better marry than cheat
children.note:
Parents must correct, as Yashoda carried a stick for Krishna. Changing from brahmacari to householder is his choice; it is better to marry and practise sincerely than to stay unmarried while breaking principles — that duplicity disturbs the movement.

🎙 Maharaj at 106:25 (auto-transcript): “The parents have the responsibility to correct their child. Even though Krishna is the Supreme God, the parents are correcting him. Why is Madhya Yashoda carrying a stick? He's so correct, Krishna. Because he's not my child. He's my child. I have to train him to behave…”

children.topic: Q9 · Keep away from the guru?
children.note:
Fearing unknown offences, should I keep my distance from my spiritual master? And is touching seniors' feet wrong?

🎙 Maharaj at 112:07 (auto-transcript): “Maharaj, my question is that at that time you were saying that if somebody is in your fight it's good that he don't come close to the spiritual master because he will he will uh commit a lot of offenses or no offenses so we were like this so um at what point can we we feel…”

Go — but to hear, ask, get service and direction, not to sit in front making phone calls or eyeing favourite disciples. Touching a sadhu's feet is respect and purification, not a show, nor a way to dump our sins on him while not following.

🎙 Maharaj at 113:59 (auto-transcript): “If you want to do something, you better understand what to do. I said, you want to go to the special master? Yes, you should go to the special master. You have the right. But you should know what I'm supposed to do there. I said, you go and sit there and look at him. No…”

children.topic: Q10 · Slapped for touching her feet
children.note:
A devotee who bumped a senior Mataji in a crowd touched her feet and was slapped. Maharaj says the apology is enough; she may have felt karma was being passed to her.

🎙 Maharaj at 119:46 (auto-transcript): “Marad, my question was accidentally in the crowd in that tear kadam i pushed one very senior mataji she was behind me and i was totally unaware the crowd was just moving so i immediately touched her feet and she was got so furious she slapped and i'm like oh krishna what now…”
