nodeData.topic: Session 24 · Krishna Conscious on Life's Battlefield
nodeData.note: BG 2.15 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Taking up devotional service is declaring war on Maya, and our Kurukshetra is our own consciousness. Krishna is present, but as with Arjuna we must fight: the austerity we spent acquiring bad habits must now be spent removing them, and the devotee who stays steady in happiness and distress is dear to Krishna and fit for liberation. In the questions Maharaj speaks on tolerance, honouring prasadam mindfully, forgiveness, Bhishma-pancaka fasting, and transforming lust back into love. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: We have declared war on Maya
children.note:
Being tested is part of devotion. When we take up devotional service we declare war on Maya; Arjuna represents everyone trying to take shelter of Krishna, and the Gita is not ancient history or a novel but Krishna speaking to us.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:43 (auto-transcript): “The Bhargita is our story. It is a part of the process of devotion. and from time to time, everyone must be tested in various ways. When we check to a devotional service, we are declaring for a gay smile. We are on a battlefield, engaged in our own battle of crucifixion. We…”

children.topic: The Gita is speaking to me
children.note:
Srila Prabhupada opened a talk to a Rotary Club in Chandigarh by saying they had gathered to hear what Krishna wants to tell them. Our approach to the Gita should be to hear what Krishna is telling me, not someone else. — “but what Krishna is telling me.”

🎙 Maharaj at 24:35 (auto-transcript): “So the Papa was in Chandigarh to address the Rotary Club members. So Papa said, ladies and gentlemen, you are welcome to this evening discussion on Bhagavad Gita. All of us have gathered here to hear what Krishna wants to tell us. This is the approach. What Krishna wants to…”

Arjuna was never truly bewildered; Krishna put him in that position to speak the Gita for us. Standing between the armies, Arjuna understood everything because he was Krishna's friend and devotee, while Duryodhana understood nothing. Likewise the Gita existed long before, but only Srila Prabhupada's, coming from a devotee and friend of Krishna, had the potency to reveal Krishna to the world.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:45 (auto-transcript): “So we should understand that Arjuna is not a conditioned soul. When you look carefully in Bhagavad Gita, Krishna had already declared Arjuna to be a good case. It is one who has conquered illusion, one who is not bewildered. Arjuna had to undergo bewilderment and serious…”

Our Kurukshetra is not in Haryana but in our own consciousness, and the opponent is Maya. We are not fighting a harmless child but a formidable servant of Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:52 (auto-transcript): “So we are on the battlefield. In another book, Gurudev explains, our battlefield is not physically on the battlefield in Khrushchev in Haryana, India. Our battlefield is our own consciousness. That's our consciousness. And the target is what? The target is Maya. Gurudev said…”

Krishna calls his external energy divine and very difficult to overcome; we, conditioned souls, are not called divine. We cannot defeat a power thousands of times stronger — only by surrendering to Krishna is it made easy.

children.topic: Krishna is present, but we fight
children.note:
Krishna did not tell Arjuna to go and meditate while he destroyed the soldiers with his disc. He explained the whole philosophy and then told Arjuna to do his duty; he wants his devotees to earn the credit of staying devoted through difficulty.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:23 (auto-transcript): “Next. Krishna is present, but we must fight. We will also have to undergo challenges and deal with all kinds of choices. But Krishna is always there for us too. Krishna did not tell Arjuna. We have been together since time immemorial. So you just sit back and watch me deal…”

Krishna did not put these destructive narratives in our consciousness; we worked tirelessly, with sleepless nights, to acquire them. Consciousness is covered, not diluted, and it is our duty to uncover it. — “We have to do our duty.”

🎙 Maharaj at 34:36 (auto-transcript): “Yes, we have to deal with all the narratives we have accumulated in our consciousness. Because it is not Krishna who put all those narratives. We work tirelessly, having sleepless nights, performing all kinds of austerity to acquire all these destructive narratives.…”

Sense gratification itself takes great effort — people work day and night, even perform austerities for power, to rob or cheat. The same seriousness is needed to get free, through Bhishma-pancaka, Ekadasi and all the vratas.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:07 (auto-transcript): “We should know why posterity is necessary. Why is posterity necessary? We use posterity to accumulate all the sinful things that have covered our pure consciousness. Is it not true that we make a lot of sacrifice, a lot of austerity to commit all the sinful activities? Is it…”

In the twelfth chapter of the Gita Krishna says devotees who are unaffected by happiness and distress are most dear to him — not those who stay focused only while given opulence, fame and comfort. Their austerity has removed the dualities.

The verse names the steady person equal in happiness and distress as eligible for liberation. Maharaj stresses that Krishna does not say the joyful or the distressed qualify — both are dualities. The purport adds Mahaprabhu taking sannyasa at 24, leaving wife and mother for the higher cause. — “Eligibility for liberation is completely outside duality.”

children.topic: In the world, not of it
children.note:
Krishna will arrange many experiences. Even in a materialistic environment we should not give in to duality because others do. A person of character does the right thing whether seen or not.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:54 (auto-transcript): “Krishna will arrange many experiences for us. He has already arranged. In the midst of duality and strife, we should not become of the world. Even though we may have to participate in worldly things or be situated in a materialistic environment, we should not give in to a…”

If someone kindly gives a hungry person food, he does not then feed him with his own hand. Glorifying the giver as saviour of the fallen is fine, but we must eat until satisfied — the guru supplies strength, but does not fight our battle for us. — “We should now use our hands to eat the food.”

🎙 Maharaj at 48:53 (auto-transcript): “If we are hungry, helpless, if we are fortunate to have some provide us with food, it is not the person who gave us food that he or she should come and use his hand to feed us. We should now use our hands to eat the food. Yes, that is our duty. They have cooked.”

children.topic: The plane is given — fly it
children.note:
Srila Prabhupada said in a lecture that the airplane has been built and fuelled; now we have to fly it. Every facility is given — now sit and chant attentively, hear the glories of Krishna and his devotees, and plan our service.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:26 (auto-transcript): “satisfied and i don't need to eat anymore that is my duty yes so the proper give give one lecture And he was saying that all of us who are in our airplane, we have to fly it. That means that the airplane has been given to us, where everything it is made is fueled, now we have…”

Distractions are necessary to check the quality of our focus and how ready we are. They are not mistakes; they come by Krishna's arrangement. — “nothing can come without the permission of Krishna”

🎙 Maharaj at 51:44 (auto-transcript): “There will be a lot of distractions. Those distractions are necessary to check what is our focus in Christian consciousness, to check the quality of our focus in Christian consciousness, to check how much we are ready in Christian consciousness. That is why other distractions…”

Devotees ask where they find it hardest to stay spiritually focused, how to see Krishna's presence in their worst circumstances, and how to balance detachment with necessary worldly work.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:41 (auto-transcript): “going internal through reflections. Your personal culture, 10 minutes. We are on a battlefield engaged in our own battle of culture, personal reflection. In what situation do I find it hardest to remain spiritually focused? Two, how can I see Krishna's presence even in my…”

Groups name work pressure, illness, anger, lusty thoughts and poor morning sadhana; small subtle anarthas are harder than big crises. Balance comes from following guru, sadhu and sastra, completing sadhana first, and doing one's duties fully as an offering — not neglecting family while managing a temple.

🎙 Maharaj at 69:34 (auto-transcript): “we will request the group representative to please raise your hands and then we'll take them we'll hear one by one I don't see any other hand up so probably I can go first for as a representative for my group Srila Gurudev so in the in the discussion when we talked about what…”
SB 10.14.8 is shown again: one who patiently bears his past reactions while waiting for the Lord's mercy and bowing with heart, words and body has a rightful claim to liberation.

Those who give in are like students who cheat or don't study: they fail and lose what they could have learned. We must not join a culture of cheating, deviation and aparadha just because it is easy or common; the universe runs on laws.

🎙 Maharaj at 86:10 (auto-transcript): “Those who give in are like the students in school who cheat or don't study. Later, such people fail, but they have cheated themselves because they miss out on the opportunity to learn something which you will have been of use. They cheat themselves. We must be careful not to…”

children.topic: Results are not ours to decide
children.note:
We are free to act, but higher authorities decide the result. A devotee who deliberately misbehaved asked Maharaj to just forgive him without consequence — scripture does not allow that. Bribing an examiner may pass an exam, but when we must perform, we have cheated only ourselves. — “The high authorities, they decide.”

🎙 Maharaj at 87:19 (auto-transcript): “that is shown. Karma driver, let's do it now. We have the right to do the activity. That freedom we have, but what it is done, we don't have the right to get over the result. The high authorities will decide. The high authorities, they decide. Not we. Like for example, the…”

children.topic: A claim that has been paid for
children.note:
The kingdom of God becomes a rightful claim because we have paid the price by doing our part well — as one who has done his business well enjoys its profit.

🎙 Maharaj at 89:54 (auto-transcript): “Let us do the right thing. by doing the right thing when it is said here the kingdom of God becomes one's rightful claim it is the rightful because we have paid the price if we don't pay the price we cannot claim it is a rightful claim the rightful claim because we have done…”

Each morning, pray aloud that today's difficulties may be reactions or tests, asking not for their removal but for strength to stay conscious of Krishna, fighting like Arjuna with Krishna beside us. Each evening, check honestly whether we remembered him.

🎙 Maharaj at 91:14 (auto-transcript): “until your 30 day notebook for today's focus but refute consciousness every morning before facing your day pray this out loud Manipaya Krishna today I face difficulties some are reactions to my past some are tests you have given me I don't know which is which but I am not…”

Questions held over from the previous day on tolerance, prasadam, forgiveness and deviated devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 93:36 (auto-transcript): “we will now open the floor for questions Srila Gurudev, there are certain questions pending from yesterday's session is it okay if you take them first Srila Gurudev yes so the first question is from his grace Vishnumurthy Sevak Prabhuji he wants to know like how to consider…”

How to tolerate while serving, and how to see cooking and honouring prasadam as something great?

🎙 Maharaj at 93:52 (auto-transcript): “his grace Vishnumurthy Sevak Prabhuji he wants to know like how to consider cooking, serving or honoring prashadam to be something very great. As Srila Gurudev you mentioned in one of the past times about Srinivas Acharya where he distributed prashadam to 10 brahmanas. And he…”

A moment of tolerance can save a hundred years in jail. We cannot call summer when we dislike winter; intolerance is passion, full of anxiety, while tolerance comes from knowledge, in goodness. — “If we don't tolerate, we just suffer.”

🎙 Maharaj at 94:37 (auto-transcript): “To tolerate you have to learn to understand what is tolerance what is the benefit What is the benefit of tolerance? Why should I tolerate? Why? Why should I tolerate? For what purpose? Because we know that. We have spoken about this so many times. Simple. If we don't…”

Who would go out for book distribution or preaching without prasadam? Mahaprabhu said even Brahma and Shiva seek mahaprasada, which gives love of God. Fasting at his departure, Haridasa Thakura still bowed to the prasadam brought to him. — “Prasadam is spiritual food.”

🎙 Maharaj at 98:52 (auto-transcript): “So, cooking, we need food to give us the strength to do our sadhana, to do whatever. So, it's one thing that cooking is useless. book distribution is the best yes brahmana brahmana I'm going to preach to the professors I'm going to preach to the university I'm going to meet…”

Stepping on or over prasadam and talking over it are offences; Maharaj avoids meals where senior devotees hold discussions. Mindfulness means remembering everyone behind the plate — whoever paid, shopped, cooked, served and offered it, the guru and Krishna. Some temples once had a reader during meals.

🎙 Maharaj at 102:02 (auto-transcript): “to avoid offenses for prasadam. Otherwise, we'll get a good problem. To step on prasadam is an offense. To step over prasadam is offense. To talk on prasadam is also an offense. All that disrespect. And when we have the heavy consequences. So many devotees, when they're…”

Forgiveness is given when someone begs for it, and we forgive because we need forgiveness too. With a serious crime we remove it from our mind but take care not to expose ourselves to such people again — and Krishna will still act. — “But Krishna will not forgive.”

🎙 Maharaj at 105:06 (auto-transcript): “We have a question from Raksha Bhatt Mataji. It is related to the previous sessions where we discussed about forgiveness. She wants to know, Gurudev, if someone has committed heinous crime and not feeling bad or repenting, so in this case, is forgiveness a right choice?…”

children.topic: Q3 · A devotee joins another group
children.note:
If a long-practising devotee goes to another sampradaya, talk to him if you can; if not, pray for his success.

🎙 Maharaj at 107:20 (auto-transcript): “Next, we have Gitanjali Mataji. She has a question. Wants to know if a long practicing devotee gets deviated for some other Sampradaya, let's say Gaudi Amat, what can be done to get him back? You can talk to the person, if you can. If you can, then you talk to the person. If…”

You cannot truly beg forgiveness while feeling you did nothing wrong. Only when you see your fault, whether before a senior or a junior, can you sincerely apologise — and it is for your own benefit.

🎙 Maharaj at 108:15 (auto-transcript): “One last question from yesterday is from Vaishali Mataji. She wants to know if a person is a non-devotee but belongs to a family and is elder and is invading our personal space which seems wrong to us but right to them how can we seek forgiveness and even if I don't feel it…”

Questions on the Bhishma-pancaka fast, the title Srila, and how to be free of lust.

🎙 Maharaj at 110:22 (auto-transcript): “Dair Rupsham, Dair Rupsham, Amataji, maybe please request you to unmute and have your question. Hare Krishna Maharaj, please accept my humble wishes. So, my question is very tiny. I have this question Maharaj that like from tomorrow when we start fasting for Bhishma Panchak,…”

Srila is a term of respect and opulence for an exalted person. For the fast: no grains or beans, eating once after sunset — fruits, nuts, boiled roots, ghee with limited spices — decided in advance and kept, not turned into a feast. Maharaj describes the traditional fuller observance for those who wish, and reminds devotees to give charity according to their means at the end.

🎙 Maharaj at 110:22 (auto-transcript): “Dair Rupsham, Dair Rupsham, Amataji, maybe please request you to unmute and have your question. Hare Krishna Maharaj, please accept my humble wishes. So, my question is very tiny. I have this question Maharaj that like from tomorrow when we start fasting for Bhishma Panchak,…”

How can lust be uprooted?

🎙 Maharaj at 122:25 (auto-transcript): “Mataji can please hear from you my humble obeisance is on to you Thank you for everything Guru Maharaj Thank you Because of saints like you we are getting something otherwise we are not so qualified or not so great to access Guru Maharaj my question is that We know all that…”

Pure love is what the soul is made of, like milk and sugar in a rasagulla, so it cannot be uprooted — only purified. As we worked hard to become sinful, we must work hard to transform it. — “So we have adulterated this pure love, what we call now lust.”

🎙 Maharaj at 123:53 (auto-transcript): “You cannot approve it, you cannot purify it because loss is opposite to pure love of Godhead every living entity has pure love originally, naturally. So we cannot uproot pure love from the heart because it's part of the soul, like desire. It cannot uproot desire. It is the…”

Start by caring for whoever is next to you. One who cannot even greet people or see them as persons cannot be free from lust, however realised he thinks he is. Those who care for others at their own expense are not lusty.

🎙 Maharaj at 125:21 (auto-transcript): “Beginning, the beginning, to begin the process, we must treat everyone kindly, nicely. Everyone will be treated nicely. The attitude of caring will be developed in us. you cannot go to hospital to go and get some tonic to purify it for that. The tonic to do this is the person…”

Krishna says he is sex life not contrary to religious principles; love, lust and such sex are different things, and confusing them makes us miserable. Lust is the body acting; in Vedic culture one speaks of placing the seed in the womb as service.

The elderly Caitanya dasa prayed daily to Jagannatha for a son, while Mahaprabhu prayed for a devotee to continue his mission. When his wife Lakshmipriya said the Lord wanted them to have a child, it was confirmed — Srinivasa Acharya's birth was pure devotional service.

🎙 Maharaj at 131:01 (auto-transcript): “come? how did he come? the parents were already old Chetayadas and Lakshmi Priya. Yes, Lakshmi Priya. As the Sindhava Satchara's mother, Lakshmi Priya and Chaitanya Das. Chaitanya Das used to go to Lord Jagannath every day and beg Lord Jagannath to give him a song. And that…”

maps.title: Radha Sunya · Session 25 · Gadadhara Pandit Rectifies His Offence

nodeData.topic: Session 25 · Gadadhara Pandit Rectifies His Offence
nodeData.note: SB 3.2.23 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Gadadhara Pandit, a lifelong renunciant, met Pundarika Vidyanidhi — whom Mahaprabhu called 'father' — and took him for a sense gratifier because of his royal opulence, until Mukunda's recitation of the Putana verse threw Pundarika into hours of ecstatic trance. Gadadhara rectified his mental offence not only by apologising but by taking initiation from him so he could be corrected. Maharaj warns that assumptions are very dangerous, calls the episode a lila for them and a lesson for us, and answers questions on genuine versus showy devotion, hope and faith, mental offences, and devotees who mistreat us. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Mahaprabhu would cry out 'Father!' though Jagannatha Misra had long departed, and said no one would recognise this person: outwardly he looked like a gross materialist, inwardly he was fully Krishna conscious. — “That is a paradox.”

🎙 Maharaj at 20:54 (auto-transcript): “Chitama would say, Father, Father, Father. The devotee was surprised. Who is Father? Jagannamishra lived a long time ago. Chitama is feeling suppression. So what you ask, who is the father you are calling? Sri Tita Mahaprabhu would say none of you would understand him. If you…”

In this world a fool is a fool and a scholar a scholar, but Krishna is supreme and also the servant of his servants without losing his position. His pure devotees share such qualities — Pundarika Vidyanidhi was externally a materialist and internally a perfectly pure devotee.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:54 (auto-transcript): “Yes, we don't see it like that in this material world. Someone is a fool is a fool. Someone is educated is educated. We see a different situation in Krishna. Krishna is the supreme personality of God. At the same time, he becomes a servant of his servants. yet his position…”

Mukunda Datta told Gadadhara Pandit, who loved pure devotees' company, that a great Vaishnava had arrived and took him for darshan. Gadadhara, simple and renounced since childhood, found a man in a palace among servants, oiled and perfumed, wearing ornaments and eating opulently.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:24 (auto-transcript): “What his dear devotee, Gododara Pondit, the external appearance. The great devotee Mukundadat was telling Gododara Pondit about the wonderful Vaishnava. And Mukundadat suggested that they go and have his darshan. When they arrived, they saw what appeared to be a complete…”

Maharaj describes the golden bed-throne with ivory and a diamond canopy, steps of coral and pearl, a golden spittoon, young girls fanning him and mirrors on three sides in which he admired himself and smiled. For a brahmacari this was disturbing: where is the sadhu?

🎙 Maharaj at 26:05 (auto-transcript): “Buddha Nidhi was sitting on the throne, the bedstead. The bed is made of gold, the throne is made of gold, ivory, the canopy on top of the throne was sitting. It is of diamonds. The steps to climb to the bed, the steps to climb to the throne, the asana, made of corals,…”

Pundarika at once noticed how devotion showed in the young Gadadhara's body. But Gadadhara, too simple to see behind the externals, judged only the outer standard and was disturbed in his mind. — “and he was somewhat disturbed in his mind.”

🎙 Maharaj at 29:16 (auto-transcript): “But because Pundalipi was so simple, he didn't hear that. At least he would have understood. A person who is seeing this, we're a different person, but he just look at the standard appearance. and he was somewhat disturbed in his mind. So he asks, where is the sadhu? Where is…”

A true friend stands by his friend in every circumstance. Mukunda read Gadadhara's mind and sang a Bhagavatam verse about Krishna giving liberation to the witch Putana.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:18 (auto-transcript): “Bukundu Dad was able to see the mind of Gatudara Tundu. A friend who is actually a friend will always have the friend in all circumstances from the heart. So, Mukundadhar perceived Gata Dara Pondi's mentality and began to chant a verse from Simad Bhagavatam about the amazing…”
Uddhava marvels that Krishna gave even Putana, who came to poison him, the position of a mother — so whom else should one take shelter of?

Putana's body was twelve miles long; the Vrajavasis needed ladders to lift Krishna from her. Earlier, as Bali Maharaja's daughter, she wished Vamanadeva were her son, then wished to kill him when he humbled her father. Krishna fulfilled both: she became one of his seven kinds of mothers, a nurse in Goloka — not on Yasoda's level. — “krishna fulfilled both of them”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:25 (auto-transcript): “Here we don't see, but she was 12 miles long. The height, 12 miles. So people were not able to see Krishna. The Brazibarshi have to use ladder to climb Putana's body to pick up Krishna from her chest. That is height of Putana, 12 miles. Before she became Putana, she was a…”

Sung in Mukunda's voice, which could melt stone, the verse pierced Pundarika's heart and he lost external consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:06 (auto-transcript): “When Pundaripi Nidhi had these bears from Mukundi, And Mukunda's voice is a powerful singer. When he sings, the stone melts. So when he's not like what we did, when Mukunda recited this verse, it entered into the ear of Pundalipi Jainidi and penetrated his heart, his…”

He fell from his throne, his jewelled crown smashing and gems scattering; many servants could not hold him. For six or seven hours he lamented that Krishna liberates even demons yet he had not received that mercy — his consciousness had entered the spiritual world.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:21 (auto-transcript): “He was unconscious After he fell from his throne smashed the crown the valuable gemstone of crown on his head smashed it on the ground all the jewels scattered everywhere he fell to the ground and the speed he fell 300 people were unable to hold him still that is the…”

Watching this, Gadadhara saw he had thought offensively and grew apprehensive. Maharaj asks us to remember how often we assumed something and later found the opposite — he has many such memories himself. — “Assumption is very dangerous.”

🎙 Maharaj at 38:33 (auto-transcript): “Assumption is very dangerous. Assumption, very dangerous. All of you can try to remember how many times we assumed something and later discovered that it was 100% opposite. I have many. So it took some time for Pondaribhidenji to regain consciousness, external consciousness.”

Only those on that level, like Mukunda, could know him. Pundarika is Vrishabhanu Maharaja, Radharani's father, and Gadadhara Pandit is an expansion of Radharani; by Krishna's desire pure devotees appear in different forms and rasas, as Svarupa Damodara, a sakhi, appears as a teacher.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:19 (auto-transcript): “Sri Chita Mahaprabhu has already told devotees that a person who is calling father, no devotee when they see him because he dressed differently and he behaved differently but his Christian consciousness is completely inside reserved only for those who are on that level like…”

Pundarika would not go to the Ganga by day, unable to bear people washing feet, clothes and pots in her; he went at night and sipped her water before his deity worship.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:05 (auto-transcript): “Because he knows himself. He will never go to Ganga in the daytime because he doesn't like to go and see people washing their feet, washing their cloth, washing their utensils inside Ganga. He considers this a disrespect. He will only go to Ganga only in the night when nobody…”

Hearing one verse, Pundarika was absorbed and showed complete disinterest in his surroundings. Devotees reflect on the assumptions they make about devotees who don't fit their image of saintliness, and how real absorption differs from outer show.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:59 (auto-transcript): “Going internal through reflections. Recognizing hidden devotion. Ten minutes. By hearing a special first time about Krishna, Pundurik Vidya Nigi became immediately absorbed, showing his complete disinterest in his physical environment and situation. When he had something…”

We judge by age, dress, tilaka and bead bag, or by a different counsellor's style; good kirtan singers are not necessarily absorbed. Signs of real absorption: humility, service attitude, how one treats others, steady sadhana without show, and how one responds when Krishna is described. Some admit they would not have recognised Mahaprabhu himself.

🎙 Maharaj at 59:41 (auto-transcript): “so i would like to reflect on the points that we discussed in the in the group i request other group representatives to please raise their hands so there were three questions first was like what are the what assumptions do i make when i see when i see devotees who don't fit…”

Gadadhara did not only apologise; he asked Mahaprabhu and others if he could take initiation from Pundarika Vidyanidhi — receiving not just forgiveness but favour.

🎙 Maharaj at 71:57 (auto-transcript): “Perfect rectification through surrender. How do you think Godotra Pondi responded to this revelation? Godotra Pondi not only apologized, but he asked Mbaha, Prabhu and others if he could take shelter of Pundari with the identity by initiation. In this way, he not only…”

children.topic: Lila for them, lesson for us
children.note:
Gadadhara is an eternal, pure associate who cannot truly fail to recognise his own father. The offence was arranged in the lila to warn us about assumptions — and since we don't know who is who, we should treat everyone nicely. — “For us, it is a lesson.”

🎙 Maharaj at 73:40 (auto-transcript): “Godal Jirah Pandit is trying to convey to us. We should be very careful with the assumption. For Godal Jirah Pandit, Pondri Vidyanidi and Chitam Mahaprabhu, this is Lila. It's a Lila for them. For us, it is a lesson. What are they teaching us? We should not have in perfect…”

children.topic: A guru who can correct him
children.note:
Citing Gour Govinda Swami, Maharaj says Gadadhara wanted a guru who could drag him by the ear and purify him; Mahaprabhu told him to take initiation at once. Krishna uses pure devotees to show us that even they accept a spiritual master to guide and correct them, without pride.

🎙 Maharaj at 74:42 (auto-transcript): “his teaching was a lesson so his holiness god vina maharaj said put uh god on that point did after seeing this he considered let me take initiation for him let me become his disciple so he can just touch me and drag me by the ear in this way i will get purified for this…”

Some who offend Vaishnavas can be freed only by becoming devotees themselves, making restitution as well as receiving forgiveness. Commit aparadhas and a devotional life that could have been easy becomes very difficult.

🎙 Maharaj at 77:20 (auto-transcript): “The complexity created by Aparo. People who have offended Vaisnava will have to suffer so much. For some of them, the only way they can be freed from all reactions is to become devotees. In other words, a reaction can be so overwhelming that they must now take to the…”

Write about a devotee you judged by appearance and what you missed; use the Bhagavatam test — who becomes absorbed when Krishna is discussed; plan one concrete act of respect; and check whether you behave in ways that invite others to offend. Protecting each other's creepers is teamwork. Treating everyone kindly is also how lust is transformed. — “Yes, it's a teamwork.”

🎙 Maharaj at 79:17 (auto-transcript): “Realization through compilation. Continue your 30-day notebook with today's focus on recognizing and rectification. External judgment. Awareness. Write about one devotee you have judged based on external appearance. What assumptions do you make? What devotional qualities…”

Questions on recognising genuine devotees, pleasing the guru, and hope versus faith.

🎙 Maharaj at 82:01 (auto-transcript): “thank you so much Shri Lakriti for the nourishing feast we will now have few questions I see hands of Romil Mataji would you like to go first Mataji yes Hare Krishna please accept my humble business Maharaj onto your lotus feet Maharaj just now we had a discussion about to…”

How can we tell — and doesn't suspecting show contradict thinking well of others?

🎙 Maharaj at 82:34 (auto-transcript): “Maharaj just now we had a discussion about to determine who is general devotee and who is doing the external show so first of all I want answers from your end like how you would like to give a light on this and secondly if we are thinking this way, that they are doing…”

Be sincere and straightforward and Krishna in the heart will show who is who; then there is no need to assume. Some devotees who dress the deities and recite perfectly in the temple behave very differently at home. — “Everything we are doing shows.”

🎙 Maharaj at 84:02 (auto-transcript): “If a devotee is genuinely participatory, We have mentioned before, if a devotee is very sincere and a good practitioner, we don't have to assume who is who. We have mentioned before, a christian shows who is building it. It will show everything we are doing shows. One day,…”

At an annual festival Maharaj's guru honoured a godbrother as best devotee of the year for his management. Maharaj stayed silent and privately called him a rascal; within months that devotee broke principles and left. Praise from a pure devotee is dangerous if it inflates the ego — Maharaj says he simply tried to be sincere, and Krishna showed him.

🎙 Maharaj at 88:12 (auto-transcript): “But once, you know, one time, we had a festival, we used to have an annual festival, and one devotee was glorified as the best devotee of the year. I could have given him my word. I could have given him my word. he's the best devotee of the year so he got that word all the…”

children.topic: Q2 · Is my guru pleased with me?
children.note:
Maharaj answers with a little play — asking for water, then juice, then something else — to ask how she would feel. Try to understand the guru as he tries to understand you, and ask him directly, but not in the class.

🎙 Maharaj at 94:14 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna. Guru Maharaj, Danvat Pranam, my humble and respectful obeisance is on to you. My question is, how can we know our spiritual master is happy with us or not? So, like I keep on messaging you so much, telling you everything. I think in my mind, my spiritual master…”

Should a devotee dwell on hope, or only on faith?

🎙 Maharaj at 97:44 (auto-transcript): “I wanted to ask this question yesterday Maharaj as a devotee between hope and faith which one do you have to dwell more on that most of the times we have a lot of hopes and we're beginning to pray to Krishna over it and it is said that when all hope is lost it's where Krishna…”

Srila Prabhupada told a disciple that a case looked hopeless but he was always hopeful — because he had faith that Krishna would act. Hopelessness comes from lacking faith; Krishna is always there, it is we who are absent. — “But you know very well that I'm always hopeful.”

🎙 Maharaj at 99:07 (auto-transcript): “See, the Papa said that he was talking to one of his disciples. The case we have at hand is like a hopeless case. But you know very well that I'm always hopeful. I'm always hopeful. That is Prabhupada. He's always hopeful. Means what? That he has faith in Krishna. Krishna is…”

Rupa Gosvami's asa-bandha means hoping against hope. Faith gives hope: our prayers expect mercy because the acaryas and pastimes assure us, and whoever fully understands SB 10.14.8 becomes completely hopeful and faithful.

🎙 Maharaj at 100:40 (auto-transcript): “Rupa Goswami told us that. Asarbanda. What is the meaning of Asarbanda? who can tell us Asarbanda what does it mean? this is Rupa Goswami's words Pritamai Asarbanda means what? we are mooted yes we are mooted hope against hope Asar means what?”

Questions from the chat on the Putana verse, mental offences, unwanted thoughts and devotees who mistreat us.

🎙 Maharaj at 104:44 (auto-transcript): “we have two more questions from the chat box. One question is from Gaur Dayanath Prabhuji. He wants to know, he has two questions. He mentions that the words from Srimad Bhagavatam that speaks about Krishna's mercy on Puthana quoted to Pundarik Vidyanithi is the same verse…”

The verse said to Pundarika is one of those Vyasadeva's disciples recited to attract Sukadeva Gosvami. The common point is mercy: Krishna overlooked Putana's ill intention and accepted her act as service.

🎙 Maharaj at 104:48 (auto-transcript): “One question is from Gaur Dayanath Prabhuji. He wants to know, he has two questions. He mentions that the words from Srimad Bhagavatam that speaks about Krishna's mercy on Puthana quoted to Pundarik Vidyanithi is the same verse quoted by Brahmanas sent by Srila Vyas there to…”

Gadadhara's offence was only mental. Maharaj: in Kali-yuga mental offences do not manifest immediately, but they are recorded and they grow until they become verbal and gross. Thinking we are safe is self-deception. — “Everything we do is considered.”

🎙 Maharaj at 107:20 (auto-transcript): “Another question from Gaurudhaya Nath Prabhuji is, Gadadhar Pandit's offense was mental. It didn't become a verbal or physical offense. Yet, it is considered an aparadha. How should we analyze this leela regarding offenses to sadhus, especially since Srimad Bhagavatam states…”

children.topic: Q6 · Thoughts that just pop up
children.note:
We cannot stop a contaminated mind from producing such thoughts, but we need not let them stay: feel sorry, beg forgiveness and chant.

🎙 Maharaj at 109:19 (auto-transcript): “so sometimes we don't want to think something but the thought automatically pops up into our mind and we immediately realize that this thought is not good and we want to discard that thought immediately I understand that this is mainly because we are carrying a lot of garbage…”

Stop taking it negatively: they are helping you pay debts from the past. Tolerate patiently without hurting them; when the debt is paid the same people will start liking you. Reacting with anger only adds to the debt — so see them as well-wishers.

🎙 Maharaj at 110:23 (auto-transcript): “Vishnu Umurthi Sivak Prabhuji he says let's say we have some devotees who are not treating me well they are not doing good with me naturally I develop negative feelings for them how to purify this thought and how not to develop negative feelings for them if the devotees are…”

maps.title: Radha Sunya · Session 26 · Bhrigu Muni Tests the Deities

nodeData.topic: Session 26 · Bhrigu Muni Tests the Deities
nodeData.note: SB 10.89 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj tells how Bhrigu Muni tested Brahma, Shiva and Vishnu with a mental, a verbal and finally a physical offence, and how only Lord Vishnu answered with humility. The power of humility is accepting responsibility; like turning on a light that makes a thief run, increasing devotion dissolves conflict instead of fighting it. In the questions he speaks on tension with one's guru, offending people who later become devotees, and how hearing turns the goal of life into reality. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Day 26 looks at Bhrigu Muni's search for the Supreme. Sages gathered for a sacrifice could not agree whether Brahma, Shiva or Vishnu should be worshipped as supreme.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:19 (auto-transcript): “Brighamuni was deported by an assembly of sages. to make an appreciation of the three predominating deities in the universe Brahma, Shiva and Vishnu to discover which of them is supreme it is said that the great sages Narada Muni saw these great sages assembled together for a…”

A heated scriptural argument broke out, and since everyone quoted scripture no one could settle it. Narada Muni, always eager to help, proposed Bhrigu, whom he felt had some pride.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:28 (auto-transcript): “And there were a heated scriptural argument. Heated scriptural argument among the sages. And there were no conclusions because they were all quoting from Sarsus. Therefore, Narimuni, who is always interested in helping living entities. He wanted to help his brother, whom he…”

The sages declared full confidence in Bhrigu: whomever he found to be supreme, they would accept without doubt and follow exactly.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:25 (auto-transcript): “According to Chetan Bhagwat, all the sages said, we have confidence we faith in you that whomever you will come to declare as supreme we will never have any doubt about that we will follow you exactly please go we are waiting for you so now Brighamuni sorry yeah Brighamuni…”

Bhrigu first approached his own father, Brahma, without any mood of respect, and Brahma was disturbed and angered.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:06 (auto-transcript): “a mental offense He first came in contact with his father, the Brahma. In spiritual culture, respect is always offered to elders because elders pass down wisdom and serve as mentors or role models. Brugamuni approached his father, but he did not approach him in a mood of…”

In spiritual culture elders are respected because they pass on wisdom and act as role models. Maharaj asks what disrespect is: a lack of gratitude and a lack of culture. — “Disrespect is what? A lack of gratitude, a lack of culture.”

🎙 Maharaj at 21:16 (auto-transcript): “In spiritual culture, respect is always offered to elders because elders pass down wisdom and serve as mentors or role models. Brugamuni approached his father, but he did not approach him in a mood of respect. So Brahma was distinctly disturbed and angered by the disrespect,…”

Brahma is a mahajana and a teacher, so he expected his son to behave properly. Maharaj imitates the casual 'hello, daddy' many people use today and calls it real disrespect.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:08 (auto-transcript): “The woman, he said, hello, daddy. This is a real disrespect. Because many people are doing this, this. Hello, daddy. So Brahma was not expecting this. Just like even demons. Even Akashivu was not expecting from his son to be a devotee of the vision. So when he asked Prahlad…”

Every father expects his son to be the best by his own standard. Hiranyakasipu expected a demon like himself, and Prahlada's answer about taking shelter of the Lord was a death blow to him.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:24 (auto-transcript): “Just like even demons. Even Akashivu was not expecting from his son to be a devotee of the vision. So when he asked Prahlad Maharaj, his son, to tell him what is the best thing he has learned, to his surprise, Prahlad Maharaj was saying something which he never did. He never…”

Brahma wanted to kill Bhrigu but forgave him because he was his son. Bhrigu concluded that this anger showed Brahma was not the Supreme.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:42 (auto-transcript): “Brigumuni survived only because the Brahma forgave him. Well, it's my son. What should I do? It's my son. Brigumuni took notice. He didn't kill me because I'm his son. So, I don't think this is supreme. So, he has committed a mental offense to his father. Now he has come to…”

Next Bhrigu went to his brother, Lord Shiva, and spoke harshly, calling him filthy and situated in ignorance.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:19 (auto-transcript): “Now he has come to Lord Shiva, his own brother. Here he made verbal offense. Next, Brigul approached Lord Shiva and made a verbal offense. He spoke harshly, describing him as filthy, ditty, and situated in a mode of ignorance. When Brigulini came to Lord Shiva, Lord Shiva,…”

Shiva came forward to embrace his brother, but Bhrigu recoiled, mocking the ashes of dead bodies on his body. Furious, Shiva raised his trident, and only Parvati's plea that he was his brother saved Bhrigu.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:46 (auto-transcript): “When Brigulini came to Lord Shiva, Lord Shiva, seeing his brother and Amuni, the same way he's expecting his brother to be a well-behaved mune. So Lord Shiva wanted to hug him. Don't touch me, dirty smelly. Look, just look at you. Good scripture approved I want to wear. It's…”

A person can be judged by how he reacts when his ego is challenged; where there is attachment, agitation erupts. Ideal circumstances do not show how deep our commitment and understanding really are.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:01 (auto-transcript): “sometimes a judgment can be made by watching a person's reaction after his or her ego had been challenged. When there is fructive attachment, agitation would erupt. The love between spouses is not shown as much when everything is going well, but more so when the face of evil.…”

children.topic: Who stays when things go bad
children.note:
When things go well everyone gathers and looks perfect; only in difficulty do we learn who our true friend is.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:06 (auto-transcript): “good everybody will participate everybody will come when things are going good everybody will be perfect and holy so if you want to know who is who is when things bad has happened it is then you know who is your friend a true friend many people who have come because of your…”

children.topic: The husband who tested his wife
children.note:
A man told his wife he had lost his job and sent her to his parents' village. She went to her own parents and took up with another man — while in truth he had been promoted and was moving into a bigger house.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:59 (auto-transcript): “before i moved to the temple i was staying with some some people in our building so there was one Monday, one day he told his wife, my dear wife, I have been sacked from my office and it's going to take me some time to get another job and get myself a proper place to stay.”

When the woman later saw his house and car she came back crying and begging, but he refused her, saying she left him when he seemed poor. So too Bhrigu saw that Shiva spared him only as a brother, at his wife's request.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:27 (auto-transcript): “So he moved in there and after some time, the former wife, this lady couldn't function properly with the new husband and then when she came and so she came back to where the husband was saying and she saw everything and the man she wanted to come and say no i cannot take you…”

Bhrigu's tests escalated — mental, then verbal, now a gross physical offence. Finding Lord Vishnu lying down, he greeted him with a kick on the chest.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:29 (auto-transcript): “escalating tests brugamani was trying to find the greatest personality the world most firmly situated in spiritual identity and was fixed in spiritual absorption therefore he performed negative tests by making different calculations third offenses and the offenses increased…”

Lakshmi Devi, who was serving the Lord, was disturbed by the offence — and even more when her husband rose and began massaging Bhrigu's feet.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:26 (auto-transcript): “Lakshmi Devi was massaging Lord Vishnu when Begumuni entered and kicked Lord Vishnu on his chest, which is an offense. makes me there was more disturbed when she saw that her husband got up”

Citing Vrindavan dasa Thakura, Maharaj relates Vishnu's apology: had he known the sage was coming he would have gone out to receive him; and the sage's soft feet must have been hurt by his hard chest.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:20 (auto-transcript): “feet. In Chitanya Bagu what Bindavan Dashekura said Lord Vishnu told Big Muni My dear Muni I did not know that you were coming if I had known that you were coming I would have come outside to receive you but because I didn't know I did not do that Please excuse me for this…”

Lord Vishnu used the very powerful weapon of humility. Maharaj repeatedly asks: what is the power in humility?

nodeData.topic: Session 27 · Mother Sachi's Offence
nodeData.note: Caitanya Bhagavata · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. During the Mahaprakasa pastime Caitanya Mahaprabhu gave prema to everyone but refused his own mother, Sachi, because in her mind she had called Advaita Acharya 'Dvaita' for drawing her sons away. Maharaj stresses that unspoken thoughts are recorded by the Supersoul and in time become words and actions, and shows how Sachi was rectified by taking the dust of Advaita's feet. In the questions he explains why we suffer, how to help a wayward mother, and how to stop offensive thoughts at the level of the mind. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Session 28 · Perfecting the Yajna
nodeData.note: Mahabharata · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. On the last day of the series Maharaj tells how the bell at Yudhisthira's great sacrifice would not ring because Draupadi had mentally criticised a simple Vaishnava brahmana's way of eating. However perfect our arrangements, success depends on pleasing Krishna and on the quality of our relationships; offences withdraw from our spiritual bank account faster than we deposit. In a long question session he explains why mental offences still count, how faith grows, and what a real service attitude is — love, not salary. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
As Maharaj relates from the Mahabharata, at the close of Yudhisthira's great Rajasuya sacrifice a bell in the arena was to ring by itself to show that everything was perfect. The ceremony ended, but the bell stayed silent.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:22 (auto-transcript): “The bell did not ring. The Mahabharata described how Yudhisthira Maharaj was once performing a very elaborate Sahaja Shuiar sacrifice. At the close of the Yagya, something very special was expected to happen. A bell situated in the center of the arena was supposed to ring of…”

Pale with anxiety — an imperfect sacrifice can bring inauspiciousness — Yudhisthira turned to Krishna. Krishna said one party had not been honoured: a humble, pure, simple, austere Vaishnava brahmana.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:45 (auto-transcript): “Krishna's Diagnosis Yerusha was shocked and pale. And turning to Krishna, he called out, Hey Govinda, what happened? Krishna looked at him in a very grave way and said that all the parties meant to be honoured and served, and the sacrifice had not been honoured and served.”

Arjuna found such a brahmana in a hut in a nearby village. He declined to come to so much pomp, until he heard that Krishna would be there and saw a chance for darshan.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:52 (auto-transcript): “Arjuna, upon hearing this, immediately tried to find such a Brahmana Vaisnava. He ran to a nearby village and in a little hut found a very pure Brahmana, who he then invited to the Grand Raja Surya ceremony. The Vaislama Brahmana was not interested in being around so much…”

Draupadi cooked a wonderful feast for the brahmana, yet after he ate the bell still did not ring. Krishna explained that someone in the family had offended him.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:06 (auto-transcript): “Dhopadhi's mental offense. At the Jagya, they worshipped the Brahmana. Dhopadhi made a wonderful feast. And after the Brahmana had eaten, they bailed stilt in notary. Now Yudhisthva was really in anxiety. Hey, Govinda, what shall I do? What happened? Krishna explained that.”

As part of his austerity the brahmana always mixed all his food together, and he did the same with Draupadi's gorgeous, carefully arranged plate.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:05 (auto-transcript): “The Brahmana had an unusual habit that went hand in hand with his austerities. Whatever he ate, he made all the preparations together. Even though Draupadi had prepared a gorgeous plate of food, he still followed his usual practice. Although he made an opulent and aromatic…”

After so much effort Draupadi thought: this uncultured village man is mixing everything up. That mental offence blocked the perfection of the sacrifice.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:14 (auto-transcript): “Doppadi, after so much elaborate preparation and effort, became angry when he saw his habits, thinking, this uncut village boy is merging everything together, running the mill, running the mill. What a fool, uncultured person.”

children.topic: Everything in place but one heart
children.note:
Maharaj describes how Draupadi, expert in deity worship, arranged each preparation in order, and how the brahmana mixed khichri, sweet rice, halava, sabji and puris together. The place, the ingredients and the mantras were perfect — only one person had been offended, and that was enough.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:38 (auto-transcript): “Dhopadi cooked so nice preparations and arranged them systematically. He arranged them nicely, systematically, in all different places, as you can see in the picture. He was nicely assembled, perfect, in order, because he knows how to worship deity, so he followed the deity…”

Have I judged a devotee's eating, dress or manners as uncultured? What thoughts arise, and how can I turn critical thoughts into appreciative ones? Why was Draupadi's unspoken criticism powerful enough to stop the sacrifice?

🎙 Maharaj at 24:36 (auto-transcript): “Personal Reflection Have I ever judged a devotee's eating habits, devotee's dress, or mannerisms as of cultures? What thoughts arise when I see these devotees who don't exist? How can I transform critical thought into appreciative wants?”

Arjuna begged the brahmana to return. Draupadi served an even grander feast; he mixed everything again — and when he finished, the bells rang and the devotees were in ecstasy.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:02 (auto-transcript): “thing The perfect second attempt Arjuna went back to the Brahmana and begged please He must come again. This time, Draupadi made an even more fantastic feast and placed it before the Brahmana. When he sat down, he once again mixed everything together and against fire.”

We may have so many things in place, but we must always be careful about the quality of our relationships.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:20 (auto-transcript): “The purpose is rather easy to understand. We may have so many things in place but we must always be careful about the quality of our relationships. In Kali Yuga we are not held responsible for offensive thoughts. Otherwise, we will all be finished. As a matter”

In Kali-yuga, Maharaj's text says, Krishna is lenient with offensive thoughts — otherwise we would all be finished — and gives credit for healthy thoughts even when we cannot complete the service.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:41 (auto-transcript): “not held responsible for offensive thoughts. Otherwise, we will all be finished. As a matter of fact, it is quite the opposite. In Kaluga, if we think healthy thoughts, Krishna will give us credit even if we cannot finish service. That is true. Think big, not small. This is…”

Small thinking and acting bring small results. When Krishna is pleased, miracles can and must happen beyond our intellectual or financial resources. — “Think big, not small.”

🎙 Maharaj at 53:15 (auto-transcript): “credit even if we cannot finish service. That is true. Think big, not small. This is another reason why we must be careful not to think small. If we think and act small, then there will be small results. We should try to realize that when Krishna is pleased, miracles can…”

Results that match our resources are simply good management. When results go far beyond our effort, Krishna's sakti is active; when Krishna and guru are not pleased, great effort brings diminishing returns.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:13 (auto-transcript): “resources, we can call this good management, but it's not necessarily spiritual. When there's a high level of spirituality, things happen even beyond our normal capacity and resources. It means that Krishna is coming through and the Krishna Shakti is present and active. We…”

Taking darshan, offering water to tulasi, chanting our rounds — through devotion we keep depositing credits in a spiritual bank account.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:46 (auto-transcript): “Taking inventory. We are engaging in devotion and constantly depositing and receiving credits. We take darshan, take terranalit, water to sea, and churn our arms. We should not think fructively about these activities. But by this process, we are actually building up our…”

When we commit offences against others we withdraw faster than we deposit; whatever strength we had whittles away and we become different persons, drying up where once we had taste.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:17 (auto-transcript): “As we are committing upon others, even though we are depositing, we are also withdrawing even more quickly. We started to withdraw more than we deposited. And after a while, even though we may have had the world's strength and opulence, It all whittles away and we become…”

At a low ebb, immediately investigate whether offences are making us lose focus and appreciation for what our acharyas have given.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:11 (auto-transcript): “It is so important to revisit and investigate our practice when we find ourselves at a low ebb. In our devotional service, we should immediately start taking an inventory to see if our paradigms are causing us to lose focus and appreciation for what our good and greater…”

List recent mental criticisms and turn them into appreciation; weigh deposits against withdrawals; ask what may stop the bell of success in a current project, and which relationship needs healing.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:50 (auto-transcript): “Continue your 30-day notebook with today's focus on perfecting our spiritual tagger Mental Offense Inventory 4 minutes Write about recent times you mentally criticize other devotees' habits or mannerisms Hydropody Identify thoughts how uncultured or how inappropriate commit…”

Questions from devotees on the last day of the series.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:43 (auto-transcript): “is a I'm going to do this question she's asking, because some days ago, your holiness mentioned that a devotee was saying that in this Kali Yuga, if we commit some offense in the mind, but we don't act improperly, this is not going to count so much as used to be in other…”

A devotee asks Maharaj to clarify whether offences made only in the mind count in Kali-yuga.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:43 (auto-transcript): “is a I'm going to do this question she's asking, because some days ago, your holiness mentioned that a devotee was saying that in this Kali Yuga, if we commit some offense in the mind, but we don't act improperly, this is not going to count so much as used to be in other…”

Maharaj has already answered: Sachi said nothing aloud, only in her mind, yet the Lord declared she would not get prema until she begged Advaita's forgiveness. She is an eternal associate who came to teach us; she cannot really offend.

🎙 Maharaj at 64:32 (auto-transcript): “I did, I did already. We interrupted the past time of Sachimata. Anyone remember, we mentioned Sachimata. She didn't say anything outside to Adwita Chari. in her mind. Who says he's a dueter? For me, he's dueter Maya. He's not a dueter. He's duplicitous. That was in the mind.…”

Yudhisthira lost everything at dice to teach us not to gamble; Sita stepped out of Lakshmana's circle and suffered in Lanka to show what disobeying an instruction brings. And Krishna stayed with Yudhisthira in his palace, not with the austere yogis in the forest. — “For us, this is a teaching.”

🎙 Maharaj at 67:31 (auto-transcript): “For Advaita, Acharya, Sachi Mata, Chita Mahaprabhu, and all is associated, this is their pastime. For us, this is a teaching. Do you understand? For us, it is teaching. For them, it is a pastime. It is not a teaching. Because a teacher must know what is teaching. If you don't…”

A devotee asks, in Hindi, how to get rid of bad thoughts that come and go.

🎙 Maharaj at 73:06 (auto-transcript): “she's asking that mentally we have these thoughts sometimes they are good sometimes they are bad but the bad thoughts how can we get rid of them mentally if mentally you get rid of them by practice only a pure devotee will be free from this thing until you become a pure…”

Only a pure devotee is free of them; they are old impressions cultivated since time immemorial. When one comes, ask Krishna's forgiveness, don't meditate on it, let it go, and keep practising until the karmic account is empty. — “until you become a pure devotee”

🎙 Maharaj at 73:17 (auto-transcript): “mentally if mentally you get rid of them by practice only a pure devotee will be free from this thing until you become a pure devotee they will come sometimes and go now what we should do is not to keep such that thumb when they come we should say ah a demon Christian please…”

A devotee confesses that her faith in Krishna consciousness, and even in Maharaj, is not yet strong, though she is trying.

🎙 Maharaj at 75:31 (auto-transcript): “Shiloh Gurudev she's saying that she is constantly also thinking about everything you say like in one of the classes you said that our problem is that we are not Krishna consciousness and her faith is not strong yet she's also confessing that in you also her faith is still…”

Faith grows as we practise in good association. A neophyte's faith is like a candle a hand can put out; continued step by step it becomes immovable like a mountain, as the pure devotee's. — “That's how the faith comes, as we continue to practice.”

🎙 Maharaj at 76:01 (auto-transcript): “The faith continues to grow as we continue to practice. That's how the faith comes, as we continue to practice. We don't have faith for anything in this ministry. We don't have faith for anything. But when we continue to practice in good association with pure devotees, then…”

A devotee asks what a service attitude is and how to increase it. Service is what connects us to Krishna and the spiritual master — indeed it is the glue in every relationship.

🎙 Maharaj at 77:29 (auto-transcript): “please accept my humble obeisances thank you um so what does it mean by uh sincerity of purpose is it like service attitude in whatever we do maharaj and like we're knowing why we are doing what we are doing and how we are doing is it uh the same thing uh or i mean basically…”

Both lust and love seek satisfaction; the difference is for whom. A worker who serves only for salary leaves when it stops — that is lust. A disciple who serves the spiritual master without expectation, just to please him, has love. — “for love i'm doing it for you not for me”

🎙 Maharaj at 79:15 (auto-transcript): “who is explaining the difference between the lost and love so proper give example lost and lost all of them contains the same thing all again have the same thing sanctification but lost sanctification love sanctification so what's the difference the difference is that for…”

When Mahaprabhu came to Ramakeli, the ruler heard of a crying Bengali sannyasi. A servant belittled him, but the ruler said: millions follow this man without salary — only God can do that, so let no one disturb him.

🎙 Maharaj at 80:49 (auto-transcript): “sanctification for me lost love so when a lot of time harper visited ram kelly and a push and sha now a push in the shower he got the news that one sanyasi from Bengali is here. He's always crying. Maybe he has no food to eat. He's always crying. Hunger cannot allow him to be…”

Maharaj recalls nine devotees sent to open a temple in Ibadan, Nigeria. He was the pujari; returning from sankirtan he had to pick flowers, and a godbrother always excused himself — 'that is your service.' The joy at an opportunity to serve shows a good servant.

🎙 Maharaj at 84:35 (auto-transcript): “I remember I was telling some devotees some of our sweet good memories in our bhakti days sweet good memories in our bhakti days in the good day of sent us to one city here in Nigeria. We were nine devotees. We were sent to a place called Ibadan. So we went to start the…”

Krishna told Narada only the dust of a devotee's feet would cure his headache. Others refused for fear of hell, but the gopis at once offered theirs; Narada fell silent in contemplation of what pure love is.

🎙 Maharaj at 88:12 (auto-transcript): “And Krishna was very happy that he started teaching many devotees about their life. One day, Krishna told, I'm bleeding, my head is going to split any moment from now. Why? Terrible headache. My headache is going to split now. Krishna is telling to Narada Muni. Narada Muni,…”

children.topic: Without service a devotee is dead
children.note:
In the Damodara-lila the boiling milk, seeing it had no service, wanted to die. Love is action: 'can I do it tomorrow?' is lip service, and for those who don't know service, it feels like punishment. Jatayu fought Ravana knowing he would lose, and left his body in glorious service.

🎙 Maharaj at 91:34 (auto-transcript): “We're talking about Damodara Lila. We're talking about Damodara Lila. Not in this class. It's outside the class. Moraya Soda was boiling the milk on the fire. And when Krishna came and was sucking the breast milk, there was a serious competition that the milk, Moraya Soda's…”

Three more questions, from Zoom and the chat.

🎙 Maharaj at 98:17 (auto-transcript): “Gurudev, what we have done first, when we are connected to the scorn like when we have seen someone eating or wearing style which we have seen and because of what we have done so how will we be able to do that? Hare Krishna. Thank you, Mataji. Srila Gurudev, she's asking that…”

children.topic: Q5 · Offences from my early days
children.note:
How can we be free of offences made in our first days in ISKCON, judging how people ate or dressed?

🎙 Maharaj at 98:41 (auto-transcript): “Srila Gurudev, she's asking that in the initial days in ISKCON, we have made offences when it came to seeing people, the way they eat or dress. But those happened in the past. But how can we get rid of those past offences? She repents. Repentance. She repents and prays the…”

Repent and pray to the deities for forgiveness: we did not know, now by your mercy we understand; please take this away. A repentant heart is a very powerful purification.

🎙 Maharaj at 98:58 (auto-transcript): “She repents. Repentance. She repents and prays the deities for forgiveness. This we didn't ignore and we don't know Because we don't know all these things We have misbehaved Now, by your mercy, you are letting us understand all these things So we are grateful, we are thankful…”

children.topic: Q6 · Enthusiastic only when you visit?
children.note:
When Maharaj visits India devotees are eager for service, then become lax after he leaves. Is that purification or show?

🎙 Maharaj at 101:25 (auto-transcript): “Shrila Gurudev, she's asking that every time you come for a yatra to India, we are all very enthusiastic, we're all very happy, we're all always up for services. but when as soon as you leave and when we go back home we become laid back but on the other hand even mindfully…”

children.topic: Practise when the teacher is absent
children.note:
It is purification either way; only its quality differs. A good student keeps practising when the teacher is not physically present — that is why the notebook was kept every day, to stay connected rather than living a Sunday-only spirituality. — “You should remain devoted all the time.”

🎙 Maharaj at 102:16 (auto-transcript): “Purification, whether you do it, anyhow, it is purification. The only difference is the quality of the purification is to make the difference. Otherwise, it's purification. So, a good student, So, learn when the spiritual master, the teacher is there, you should learn when…”

What can we do when we feel offensive towards management whose decisions go against us?

🎙 Maharaj at 104:53 (auto-transcript): “he's asking what can we do when we have offensive mindset towards the management when the decisions are not in our favor? It is it is the nature of condition shows that anything that doesn't go with our ego, we don't we don't value we don't appreciate it, we don't look at it…”

The conditioned ego dislikes whatever goes against it. Since we cannot change their decision, do not disturb yourself or offend them; no one took the holy name from you. Advancing, we will see the same things differently. — “Let me do the right thing.”

🎙 Maharaj at 105:07 (auto-transcript): “It is it is the nature of condition shows that anything that doesn't go with our ego, we don't we don't value we don't appreciate it, we don't look at it nice Well, there's something we can do. There's something we can always do at all times. Either the judgment is favorable…”

Maharaj asks who cooked sweet rice for the rasa-lila and whether Krishna's fingers were seen in it; one who only tasted it is told that means Krishna ate it. He thanks everyone for their offering and asks them to continue forever.

🎙 Maharaj at 107:03 (auto-transcript): “and we should do it did you cook your should rise yes how many of us did i sent you a photo you know what what's up how was it tasty did you see christian's hands on it getting soft did you see no i couldn't see oh how was the test taste only okay that means yeah krishna ate…”

nodeData.topic: Session 29 · Gratitude and Transformation Offerings
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. The first of two closing sessions is a festival of gratitude: lamps and garlands for Maharaj, the Radhikastakam, and devotees' offerings describing how the series uprooted hidden offences and taught them to beg forgiveness, stay humble and value relationships. A recording of Bhakti Tirtha Swami's 'beggar' meditation is played, the service teams are thanked, and Maharaj closes by thanking everyone and praying that all will see their promotion in Krishna consciousness. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
The session opens with every devotee on screen offering a ghee lamp to Maharaj together.

🎙 Maharaj at 00:00 (auto-transcript): “Offer your Ghee Lamps and we request the devotees who came forward and all the devotees as well, please feel welcome. Let's light our Ghee Lamps and offer it. Hare Krishna.”

The devotee learned how to stay away from offences, to ask forgiveness even when in the right, and to be humble and compassionate with devotees and non-devotees — and thanks Maharaj for chastisement that purifies.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:36 (auto-transcript): “time where there was one devotee where there was one devotee known by Gullah Bhama and she was serving as she when she got to know that ramanujacharya is coming and she she was so happy she just asked to the servants can i meet once to ramanujacharya and then when she met she…”

A devotee presents a recorded song for Maharaj about a forgotten soul learning to beg and being touched by mercy; it is received as very inspiring.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:49 (auto-transcript): “like to have a presentation of a song for Pram Grudev by Matsya Prabhuji just allows one one minute to share the screen”

A second round of offerings lists lessons from the month.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:25 (auto-transcript): “Now we will have another session of gratitude by our dear universities. I would like to request you to raise your hands. Dear Vishwambharap Prabhuji, Shuddha Bhakti Mataji, and Matanmohi Nirabha Mataji, please raise your hands. Kindly inspire us with your gratitude and share…”

One devotee thanks Maharaj for opening eyes blinded by ignorance, and describes the spiritual master as the medium of the Lord's mercy for those burning in material life.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:16 (auto-transcript): “i offer my respectful obeisances unto the most my most revered and most beloved silvudev whom has opened my eyes which were blinded by the darkness of ignorance with the torch light of knowledge dear silvudev you are the given giver of divine wisdom you are the friend of…”

He learned the difference between sin and aparadha; that pride can cause a fall at any time; that offending a great Vaishnava drains spiritual potency and taste for chanting; and that disobeying the spiritual master begins the uprooting of the bhakti creeper.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:25 (auto-transcript): “i would like to follow the instruction of silburdeva i have learned that earlier i was not knowing about the difference between uh what is seen and what is abroad so i were using some places seen some places abroad i will not know miss i was not aware of that abroad how we…”

children.topic: A poem: when the bell will ring
children.note:
A devotee offers rhyming lessons: say sorry from the heart, never envy, serve selflessly, keep sadhana strong when the mind offends, treat everyone with love, and keep relationships healthy so that the bell of success rings.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:22 (auto-transcript): “Though I am very weak, but I will try to follow according to the instructions given by Sri Gurudev. So my offering goes like this. Always be ready to say sorry with feel in your heart. Never feel envy with anyone because they are also our part. Always be ready for selfless…”

nodeData.topic: Session 30 · Gratitude, and Going Forward Together
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. In the final session devotees offer lamps, garlands and heartfelt gratitude for the Radha Sunya series, and Maharaj answers each offering with a short teaching. A 'long way to go' has no meaning when Krishna is pleased; a sincere sorry brings peace; a grudge burns the one who holds it; fortune is found only among devotees, who make others fortunate; and every situation, even a problem, can be used to serve Krishna. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

The host explains that each lamp stands for the heart the devotee is offering; one garland is offered from Mayapur.

children.topic: Sorry even when not at fault
children.note:
Through Rupa Gosvami's example she learned that if another is offended, one should ask forgiveness even without having made a mistake — this changed her whole philosophy.
