maps.title: Bhakti Vaibhava Pune 2025 · Class 2 · Austerity in Bhakti Can Give Krishna

nodeData.topic: Class 2 · Austerity in Bhakti Can Give Krishna
nodeData.note: SB 6.4.44–6.5.30 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj completes the Lord's words to Daksha and shows why austerity is the first principle of spiritual life: Brahma, every acharya and the sons of Daksha gained strength through it, and today it means voluntarily giving up what is available, not starving. He contrasts Daksha's selfish blessing with Narada's purity, decodes Narada's ten riddles to the Hariasvas, and warns that only our own offences can make us leave Krishna consciousness. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The Lord tells Daksha that he too wants the whole world to be happy. Maharaj explains that the material world is set up as a chance for conditioned souls to get free, and that giving people Krishna consciousness is how a preacher becomes very dear to Krishna, which is why devotees take risks to do it.

Quoting Bhaktivinoda Thakura, Maharaj says our secondary nature has become primary. We are not material beings trying to become spiritual; the condition has become chronic, so even with scriptures, holy places, deities and devotees all around us, the cure takes time. — “We are spiritual beings who are undergoing material experience.”

🎙 Maharaj at 13:44 (auto-transcript): “As Bhakti Mnathakura said, Bhakti Mnathakura said, our secondary nature has become primary. Our primary nature has become secondary. Therefore, many living entities think that we are material beings who are trying to become spiritual. It's a big ignorance. We are not material…”

The verse describes austerity, Vedic hymns, sacrifices and the demigods as the Lord's heart, body, limbs and life, a way for someone who cannot yet see God to perceive him. Maharaj stresses that tapasya comes first because it purifies.

As austerity clears the dirt from the heart, Krishna is revealed gradually, gradually, until one can see him face to face.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:20 (auto-transcript): “The first principle is Tapashya, which means denial of material activities. That's the first principle of spiritual life, because it brings purification. he explained that yesterday brings purification to the heart when all the coverings are removed it has become clear for…”

children.topic: The taste of water, even wine
children.note:
Gita 7.8 gives an impersonal way to begin seeing Krishna. Maharaj recalls Prabhupada's drastic remark that even a drinker who remembered the taste as Krishna would progress, though that is very rare: the acharyas go to any extent so no one can say they had no chance. Every mantra that begins with Om connects us to Krishna; only misfortune keeps us away.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:32 (auto-transcript): “But we get a location, say what? Start to see him, chapter 7. Chapter 7. I am the taste of water. No professor in the purple world. Remember? something like that and impersonal drinks then he just thinks that okay yes proper says something more very very drastic statement made”

Before creation the Lord existed with his own potencies, and the word 'aham' points to a person, not a void. Krishna never goes out of existence; whether he is manifest or unmanifest depends on our vision, not on him. From him came Brahma, the self-born.

Maharaj asks the class. Answers come: bhakti is personal, natural to the soul, conquers Krishna, and other paths need some bhakti to succeed. Karma and jnana carry selfishness and rely on our own strength; Mahaprabhu told Murari Gupta they darken the heart. Only bhakti, a loving relationship, has the potency to give prema.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:55 (auto-transcript): “Why bhakti yoga? What is so important in bhakti? What makes bhakti superior to other processes? What makes bhakti processes superior to other processes? There are different processes of self-realization. Why the part of bhakti is superior to others? What makes it so special?…”

children.topic: Who listens to a voice without form?
children.note:
Daksha saw a beautifully dressed person, not light. Maharaj asks who would keep sitting if they heard a voice but saw no speaker; maybe it is a ghost. Form shapes consciousness, and with form come activities and pleasure. — “Who will sit here?”

🎙 Maharaj at 36:28 (auto-transcript): “Daxa saw him as a person. He didn't see light. He didn't see void. How many of us will sit here? How many of us will continue to sit here? If we are hearing the voice and not seeing the person, who will sit here? Don't worry. Just sit down. Just sit down. And let's talk about…”

Brahma is Svayambhu, born without a mother, and Krishna says he is father and mother of all. Maharaj asks which pastime shows him as mother. Can we eat or sleep without a form? Krishna is the supreme person, Isvara, controlling everything at all times.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:20 (auto-transcript): “Yes, and both the father and the mother, how did he show that? How did Krishna prove his mother and father? We agree, his father, but how did he show that he is the mother, for all of us? Very good, very good. Mother maintains, what else? Mother maintains in many ways by…”
Brahma felt incapable of creating until the Lord advised him to perform austerities; by them he could produce helpers like Daksha.

Brahma only speculated, and speculation brings fear: he trembled when he touched the water. After tapasya, glorification of Krishna came spontaneously. Our own austerity is simple, almost one 'for lazy people', yet it can give us Krishna. — “nothing is possible without austerity.”

🎙 Maharaj at 45:48 (auto-transcript): “Lord Brahma told himself, incapable. How did he become capable? Austerity. Kropar said, nothing is possible without austerity. Nothing, nothing is possible without austerity. Everything becomes possible by austerity. it could be whatever small or great not as a brahma's type…”

Maharaj asks whether any acharya skipped austerity. Prabhupada fainted from the sun in Delhi and Bombay while preaching and nearly left his body from seasickness. Only Vena took his position without austerity, and he failed and died.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:20 (auto-transcript): “Is there any one of our acharyas who did not do any austerity? Any of our acharyas? He didn't do any austerity? Just go to where they are? Anyone? All of them, all of them. Prabhupada fented here in India. He fented, how many times? Two times, New Delhi and Bombay. Prabhupada…”

A devotee observes that seniors built the facilities through hardship; now everything is set up, so what does austerity mean for us?

🎙 Maharaj at 53:11 (auto-transcript): “What Tapasya is important and we see that Acharya's lives and even we can see our many seniors who have initially built the facilities, they underwent a lot of austerities. When I came, it was like very peaceful for staying and for eating or for any other activities, it's all…”

Starvation is having nothing. Austerity is when everything is available and you deliberately give it up for something higher, for Krishna's pleasure. — “austerity is different from starvation”

🎙 Maharaj at 54:01 (auto-transcript): “or mean so that because it's very important here it is told thank you austerity does not mean there is nothing austerity doesn't mean there is nothing austerity is different from starvation starvation means there is nothing so what to do i have no alternative there's no food…”

When Maharaj joined, devotees ate twice a day, went out from ten till five without even water, slept on mats and never sat on chairs, yet life was sweeter than today. Time, place and circumstance change, but austerity is still needed.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:49 (auto-transcript): “So, it is true that the time we join the movement, we eat only two times in a day. There's no rice boga, there's no boga-rya, It's only in the morning, 10 o'clock, everyone outside, till 5 p.m. And outside, you cannot buy anything, you cannot take anything, not even water.…”

Austerity is for the intelligent, not an excuse on Janmashtami to skip the fast. Ekadasi reduces the body's demands and increases the soul's. If we practise nicely, appetite drops on its own, a sign of progress; complaints that fasting makes us ill are mostly the mind.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:38 (auto-transcript): “foolish people austerity is done by intelligent people who are very intelligent it knows what they are looking for and they know that to reduce the demands of the body which is the purpose of akadasy akadasy is to teach us to do what to reduce the demands of the body and…”

The Lord gives Daksha the daughter of Pancajana to beget children. Maharaj contrasts Daksha's austerity with Narada's, and notes that Krishna is only facilitating Daksha's selfish desire; it is not pure devotion.

In his previous life, the boy Narada walked past gardens of delicious fruit, sweet water and fearsome animals without taking anything, choosing a tree that supports meditation. After all that, the Lord told him he would not see him again in that life. Daksha faced no such tests.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:14 (auto-transcript): “very nice christian did not tell that the money also performed austerity heavily right more than what that said did the money did after leaving the sages yes yeah four months very severe very severe one um that side did not experience the challenges that the money had have…”

Maharaj tells of someone blessed by Lord Shiva with a young body, a beautiful wife and strength to enjoy: that is punishment, not a Gosvami's blessing. Daksha saw the Lord face to face but did not get to go home, while Narada saw him briefly and received everything; even demons like Narada. — “anything else is punishment”

🎙 Maharaj at 69:12 (auto-transcript): “when chitama people met with that day worshipped our lord shiva and he gave blessing i bless you this for this young friends beautiful body you have also a beautiful girl and you have a strong to enjoy sex with her this is not a blessing of a Goswami this is not a blessing…”

Daksha begets ten thousand gentle, obedient sons, the Hariasvas, who go to Narayana-saras to do austerities. Maharaj says gentleness and obedience let them follow their father, a quality needed to do anything wonderful. Narada, seeing their purity, comes with enigmatic words.

Maharaj asks how this is possible; students suggest the Lord's blessing or Diti's sons. He says not to judge by our age: pigs bear a dozen at once, beings then had mystic power and acted by the mind, some were even born from trees.

🎙 Maharaj at 88:19 (auto-transcript): “How is it possible to get 10,000 children from one woman? 10,000 children from one woman. How is it possible to do that? Eh? 10,000. Conceivable. 10,000. From our experience, a woman giving birth to a child is so much trouble. A lot of trouble. Now, 10,000 from one woman.…”

children.topic: Guru rewards the quality of practice
children.note:
Narada saw how high their austerity was and gave them ten subjects to ponder, as he gave an allegory to Pracinabarhi. A spiritual master watches the quality of a disciple's practice and rewards it. Maharaj notes Prabhupada opened temples in Mayapur and Vrindavan so devotees can bathe in Ganga and Yamuna.

🎙 Maharaj at 96:09 (auto-transcript): “seen the level of the austerity they are performing and he saw that the quality of the austerity is very, very high that just just a moment after this you become good devotees. It is a duty of a spiritual master to see the quality of the disciples practice and reward them…”

Whoever Narada looks upon becomes a devotee, and he passes this potency to disciples like Prahlada. Only a few, such as Daksha and Kamsa, resisted even repeated visits. — “His mercy is unlimited.”

🎙 Maharaj at 99:27 (auto-transcript): “This is Narada Muni's mercy. His mercy is unlimited. that the demonic glance is so auspicious that whomever he glances upon must certainly become a devotee. Anyone who a demonic glance upon must surely become a devotee. That is his potency. And he transferred that energy to…”

How does this relate to me, how is the Lord connected, and how does it touch other living entities? From Daksha we learn not to waste life on sense gratification; the Lord used his desire in his service. A student notes schools neglect austerity, and Maharaj replies that students already do austerity before exams: it is practical, not just philosophy.

🎙 Maharaj at 102:46 (auto-transcript): “there are three things you should look at. So, three things you should look at. One is, how does this relate to me? What connection do I have with this? That I have 10,000 children, are ascending to do austerity. How does that relate to me? Does it have any connection with…”

Narada first 'breaks the ice' by asking whether they really know their father's order, capturing their minds. The Hariasvas then decode each riddle themselves: the earth is the body, the one man is Krishna, the hole is the spiritual world, the woman is unsteady intelligence, the swan is scripture, the razor wheel is time.

children.topic: Use this body for a spiritual one
children.note:
The body is the field of activities, as in Gita chapter 13. Intelligence is not degrees, fame or wealth; one is intelligent only if this body produces a spiritual body. Otherwise life is defeat.

🎙 Maharaj at 117:15 (auto-transcript): “An intelligent person should not use this body for another material body. Intelligent person should use this body for spiritual body. Without this, the next verse is said, abode means defeat. We have been defeated by material energy. If this is our body, present body, which…”

Maharaj insists no one should give up Krishna consciousness. We may blame the GBC, guru, authorities or neighbours, but they are only instruments; the cause is our own offences. — “No one should give up Krishna Consciousness.”

🎙 Maharaj at 119:20 (auto-transcript): “Failure. No one should give up Krishna Consciousness. No one should give up Krishna Consciousness. No one should give up Krishna Consciousness. We can only give up Krishna Consciousness if we are making offenses. only offenses we may have other beautiful reasons my GPC my…”

Before Krishna consciousness Maharaj lay awake for years wondering where the dead go. The Bible gave no answer and his teacher grew angry at his questions, so he left Christianity, tried a mystic and yoga, and finally found the answer through Prabhupada, whose system is question and answer. — “I got answer to all my sleepless nights”

🎙 Maharaj at 125:51 (auto-transcript): “to wasting time in this way that was one of the the one of one of the problems i was having before coming to christian constitution i was i was daily thinking we people are going after that where are they going i don't see them coming back so where where are they going what…”

children.topic: A culture only for the soul
children.note:
On the swan of scripture, Maharaj says ISKCON has a great duty that scientists, politicians and philosophers cannot fulfil, because Krishna consciousness is the eternal culture of the soul; every other culture ends with the body.

🎙 Maharaj at 149:29 (auto-transcript): “and engage them in the best welfare activities of human society. So ISKCON has a great duty, great duty. Our scientists cannot help, we cannot do it. Our politicians cannot do it. The philosophers, they cannot do it. Only Krishna consciousness can do it because that is…”

No one can stop time, and it moves imperceptibly. Celebrating a birthday as a year added is illusion: a year is gone, so a devotee raises the quality of practice. Even a hundred thousand years is nothing. How offerable to Krishna is each of our days? — “that's illusion the reality is one year out”

🎙 Maharaj at 151:13 (auto-transcript): “Sharp razor blade and thunderbolt means what? Eternal time. Eternal time. Can anyone change the time? Stop the time? Anyone? No one can change it. It is moving at our speed? No. No. very very fast but imperceptibly how many of us know how we grow who knows how we are growing…”
The Hariasvas accept Narada as guru and leave on the path of no return. Daksha laments, begets a thousand Savalasvas, and Narada wins them over the same way.

We cry when relatives die, yet if they went to a better place, it is we who remain in misery; know where they are before lamenting. The disappearance of the spiritual master is different, and a disciple rightly cries. — “so we should know where they are”

🎙 Maharaj at 172:00 (auto-transcript): “you see people are doing the same thing somebody dies in the family what do we do when somebody dies in the family what do we do lament oh my deez oh my da so when I ask one somebody suppose your father has gone back to Godhead lament like this if he has gone back to Godhead…”

Maharaj cites a girl tied up and beaten by her family for joining Krishna consciousness, and a disciple on a school trip where boys and girls slept in one room without parental protest, while her temple visits were opposed as 'too young'. Prabhupada's words on parents are perfectly correct.

🎙 Maharaj at 175:53 (auto-transcript): “when they join the christian conscious movement to achieve the ultimate goal of life yes yesterday i was hearing this mother father brother sister we're beating one the what you hook who joined christian consciousness they tie her up like a criminal we're beating her is that…”

The Savalasvas chanted mantras beginning with Om while living on water and air. We cannot imitate that, but we should not give up austerity: with the four regulative principles, chanting becomes effective very soon.

🎙 Maharaj at 185:31 (auto-transcript): “They were chanting along with austerities. In Kali Yuga, people cannot undergo severe austerities, like those mentioned here in, drinking only water and eating only air for many months. One cannot imitate such a process. but at least one must undergo some austerity by giving…”

Narada tells the younger brothers to follow their elders if they love them. Maharaj calls him a very smart preacher who penetrates the heart simply but powerfully; success comes from respecting seniors. — “we should respect the seniors if we want to be successful”

🎙 Maharaj at 188:09 (auto-transcript): “So, what Naragun is doing? If you are intelligent and you have affection for your brothers, do what? Do what? Follow what you need, if you are intelligent, if you have affection for your brothers. we should respect the seniors if we want to be successful we should respect the…”

Two devotees ask about offences and the mood of austerity.

🎙 Maharaj at 191:33 (auto-transcript): “Any comments, questions? Yes. Hare Krishna Maharaj. Hare Krishna. In between, you said that to getting into Maya out of duties association, the main reason is offenses. So Maharaj, my question is that if we are having past conditionings and saskaras so due to that while we…”

If our past samskaras make us commit offences even in devotee association, how do we escape the cycle?

🎙 Maharaj at 191:47 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna Maharaj. Hare Krishna. In between, you said that to getting into Maya out of duties association, the main reason is offenses. So Maharaj, my question is that if we are having past conditionings and saskaras so due to that while we enter into the association we…”

children.topic: Mistakes are forgiven, not deliberate offences
children.note:
If we keep sixteen rounds and the four principles and slip because of conditioning, Krishna forgives and we learn. Deliberate acts are what block us; when we notice an offence, sincerely beg forgiveness and continue.

🎙 Maharaj at 192:20 (auto-transcript): “out so thank you if we follow this principle this principle of connecting minimum 16 rounds and the four degrees principles if we are doing it we are trying we are trying our best to do it if we make our a mistake mistake means it is not intentional because of our…”

children.topic: Q2 · Austerity without a hard heart
children.note:
The Pracetas' tapasya turned to anger; how do we do austerity so the heart softens instead of hardening?

🎙 Maharaj at 194:31 (auto-transcript): “He's emphasizing on austerities while chanting Hare Krishna along with that. And I understood that about eating, speaking and sleeping, we should be voluntarily trying to go further in Krishna consciousness by minimizing it naturally. So, my question is, Maharaj, that in…”

Be clear that you do austerity to be purified, become a better devotee and give quality service; then the heart becomes soft. If the motive is power to control others, it hardens like Hiranyakasipu's.

🎙 Maharaj at 195:32 (auto-transcript): “When we are very clear in our minds, very clear in our minds, I want to do this austerity so I can get purified, to become a better devotee. That should be the mood. want to get purified so i can become a better devotee better devotee i will serve better i will give a quality…”

nodeData.topic: Class 1 · Why So Many Religions?
nodeData.note: SB 6.4.1–43 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj opens SB 6.4 with the Pracetas, whose austerity left them angry, and Soma's plea for the trees, teaching that true knowledge and pure austerity soften the heart and that every body is a temple of the Lord. Through Daksha's Hamsa-guhya prayers he stresses that Krishna is reached by the attitude of service, not speculation, and explains why there are so many philosophies and religions: Krishna gives each person what he desires and level by level draws all toward himself. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Daksha was given the service of populating the universe, so Maharaj asks how anything auspicious should begin: with prayer and with austerity, which invokes the potency to do it well. King Vena took his post without austerity and met disaster; Daksha first went to the Vindhya hills to perform austerity, and his prayers came when the Lord appeared.

🎙 Maharaj at 09:36 (auto-transcript): “Anything that is very auspicious has a principle, which we see throughout the whole Vedic culture. What is that? What is the best way to start anything auspicious? What is the best way to start anything auspicious? Anything auspicious? anything you want to be want to get the…”

children.topic: A guru's fire passes to the ripe
children.note:
Narada's words so affected King Pracinabarhi that he could not wait to leave for the forest. Maharaj explains that a bona fide master always transforms a ripe disciple, passing on the fire of bhakti he himself received from the sages; if the disciple is not ripe, nothing happens.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:40 (auto-transcript): “someone's effect on him this is how expression masters will act a social massage will influence the life of the disciples that his potency if the disciples are ripe if the disciples are not right even if the spiritual master is bona fide and right nothing will happen but if…”

The Pracetas return from meditating in the water to find the land overgrown with trees. Maharaj asks what this means: with no government, everyone becomes a ruler, which is the sudra condition seen all over the world today; the useless trees stand for our sinful, unnecessary activities.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:40 (auto-transcript): “trees what does that mean what does it mean yes this neglect no government when there is no government no ruler in the community what will happen it is no ruler every person will become a ruler and in the community where everybody is ruling what is that sudra that is sudra…”

The verse tells how the Pracetas, angry at the trees, sent fire and wind from their mouths. Maharaj explains that austerity and knowledge produce one of two results: a softened, purified heart or pride; book knowledge alone makes people proud, while true knowledge makes one humble and gentle. — “A true knowledge makes one gentle.”

Maharaj presses the class: Prabhupada says a devotee is never angry, yet he and other masters chastised disciples strongly. The answer: it only looks like anger in our language. Real anger contaminates the angry person and the atmosphere, but a pure devotee's chastisement is love, and both the disciple and the environment are purified. Haridasa Thakura, beaten in the marketplaces, never became angry. — “when a pure devotee chastised does it look like anger it is love”

🎙 Maharaj at 25:06 (auto-transcript): “okay all right the word proper use is a devotee is never angry the word he used is never angry so my question was he is chastised many times disciples and probably i also have many chastisements so there are no devotees that was my question they are giving me an answer. I…”

children.topic: What is in the heart transfers
children.note:
Angry people cannot preach, for every pure devotee, even the Lord himself, was harassed by those he came to help. Maharaj says whatever we carry in the heart passes to listeners: doubt transfers faithlessness, purity transfers Krishna consciousness. Prabhupada called people rascals and they still became devotees because of his purity.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:00 (auto-transcript): “They cannot preach the Christian consciousness because they don't have the purity to affect the people whom they're preaching to. Because we are not going to meet with what we're expecting. glory is all over. It's not possible in this material world to meet with us. Nobody is…”

The moon-deity Soma, maintainer of all plants, sees the trees burning and pacifies the Pracetas with sympathy. Maharaj asks how the moon maintains vegetation: he places the six tastes in plants, giving us fruits, flowers, vegetables and oxygen.

The moon moves even the ocean, and on a full-moon night the senses are stirred while moonlight cools the mind. Maharaj recalls that the second prostitute came to Haridasa Thakura under a full moon, and that Krishna danced the rasa on the full moon. The trees are not at fault for overgrowth; fruit and flower trees must be kept.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:27 (auto-transcript): “people are very civilized or we can try it right you can try it on the full Monday how do you feel on the full Monday how do you feel in the full moon when the moon is full how do you feel yes it is agitating the sense of we are disturbed even though you see the ocean is…”

children.topic: Moon landings and the moon stone
children.note:
Following Prabhupada, Maharaj reasons that the maintainer of vegetation cannot have a barren planet: had the scientists really gone, they would have seen trees and met the moon-god. All they brought back was a stone, nothing like a perfectly designed Salagrama sila.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:29 (auto-transcript): “that means that they don't go there if they have gone to the moon they will have seen trees, vegetation moon go out also they would have seen him. They would have met with him. So he didn't go there. The only thing they got was Chanda Sila, the stone from the moon. We have so…”

Soma reminds the Pracetas that a king must wish his citizens prosperity and protect them. Maharaj adds Prabhupada's point that a citizen is anyone born in the land, so animals and trees are citizens too and must be protected, not killed. — “That means that animals are also citizens.”

children.topic: A cow's hairs, a cow's milk
children.note:
Who could count the hairs on one cow? Maharaj says killing a cow keeps us bound for that many years, one reason we stay so long in this world. We drink our mother's milk for some months but cow's milk for a lifetime, so the cow is more our mother and must be protected.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:16 (auto-transcript): “are they are hairs on the body of a cow can you imagine that who can count the hairs on the body of the cow just one cow who can count this is one of the reasons why we are staying too long in the material world because of one cow we are going to take bed as many times as the…”

The class began late because everyone ate a heavy feast after fasting and fell asleep. Maharaj uses it to teach sense control: break a fast lightly and gradually, and do not listen to the mind, which says you are tired when you are only full. — “because the mind is not a devotee”

🎙 Maharaj at 44:26 (auto-transcript): “what what was the reason what the reason for coming late eating heavy fists eating heavy fists you know when you fast and then you eat heavy what will happen to the body the body will be weak the body will be really weak so we cannot control the senses like that we cannot…”

Sense control begins not with the tongue but with the mind, the master of all the senses; control the mind and the rest follow. Maharaj explains that although intelligence should guide the mind, the mind is often strong enough to overpower it.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:13 (auto-transcript): “or to practice controlling the senses could begin from if you want to control our senses what does it begin from the mind not the tongue the mind if the mind is not controlled the tongue will not be controlled the mind if you control all the senses without the mind is failure…”

The verse asks us to see every body as a residence of the Lord. Maharaj says unity in diversity can never come until this is realised: if I do not see the Lord living in you, I will not value you and will naturally misuse you. — “If we want to have unity and diversity, then this should be realized.”

Real knowledge from a self-realised soul shows that all living beings belong to Krishna. Maharaj says such knowledge changes how we relate to and treat everything, and it makes one humble; that is why pure devotees respect all.

The verse praises one who subdues sudden anger. Devotees ask daily how to control lust and anger; Maharaj says tolerance depends on inner strength, which comes from purity, not from philosophy, just as only a well-prepared student passes. We should measure our progress by how much we can tolerate, as a traveller must know the distance to set his speed.

Soma offers the Pracetas Marisa as their wife to pacify them. Maharaj compares Hiranyakasipu, whose meditation was broken by anger after Narada chanted; he went home to his wife, Prahlada was conceived, and he returned to his austerities.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:29 (auto-transcript): “how did he control it the money came to him and chanted my enemy became angry with that contamination he cannot control meditation so what did he do he came back to the house and he slept with his wife that is how he anger was removed they control the anger and that is how…”

Marisa's mother Pramloca was no ordinary apsara. Maharaj tells how two demon brothers won a boon that only they could kill each other; Vishnu gathered beauty from everything to form Pramloca, and the brothers quarrelled over her until they killed each other.

🎙 Maharaj at 66:12 (auto-transcript): “From Rocha is as is mentioned in Absara is not the Absara like we get in the heavenly planet. From Rocha came from Krishna himself because after Hirakasipu was killed along with some others. There's some who fled out of fear on the second day. So, those who fled, they went to…”

Daksha means expert, a quality of a Vaishnava, but Maharaj notes this Daksha is expert for sense gratification. Having offended Lord Shiva, he once received a goat's head, and the same Daksha is now born again of the Pracetas.

🎙 Maharaj at 70:13 (auto-transcript): “one of the qualities of vajshanma is daksha so this is daksha here is that quality this is daksha here is that quality when this is quality for vajshanma daksha which one is this which one is this this one is sanctification daksha it's part for sanctification not that it has…”

Daksha's Hamsa-guhya prayers were not his own composition but already existed in Vedic literature. Maharaj asks why: Daksha, materially motivated, lacked the purity to compose such a prayer from his heart, yet the prayer was so potent that the Lord was pleased and appeared.

Understanding the Supreme Personality of Godhead is very difficult, which is why few follow this path. Maharaj says only the extremely fortunate take to Krishna consciousness, where service makes one's existence pure.

All the coverings on our consciousness are removed by the attitude of service. Maharaj recalls Prabhupada's saying that advancement depends on the attitude of the follower.

🎙 Maharaj at 86:15 (auto-transcript): “The Lord can be realized by the attitude of service. The attitude of service. All these coverings in our consciousness can be removed completely by our service attitude. And the famous quote from Prabhupada's instruction, famous quote, famous advancement”

Kamsa and Sisupala thought of Krishna day and night, the very absorption we struggle for, yet their meditation is condemned because their attitude was demonic. Krishna already has everything; what he values is our attitude. — “Even when he's sleeping, he thinks of Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 87:20 (auto-transcript): “Okay, for example, Kamsa was 24 hours Krishna conscious. What was wrong with his meditation? Kamsa, unfavorable, unfavorable attitude. Sissupal, think of Krishna 24 hours. Sissupal. Kamsa, he think of Krishna 24 hours. What is wrong with your meditation? Something which we…”

Maharaj tells the Bible story of a poor woman who gave her only coin while others gave fortunes; Jesus held up her gift as the purest he had received. She gave everything without thinking of tomorrow; a gift given condescendingly is no gift at all.

🎙 Maharaj at 91:01 (auto-transcript): “There is a story like that in a Bible. there is a story like that in the bible jesus was in the church and thousands of followers are there and they were giving him amount of money they were giving so much there was a lady one lady in her entire life she has only one rupee…”

On one sankirtana day one devotee distributed five books and Maharaj forty-five, yet the five-book devotee was glorified. Maharaj, feeling slighted, was told the other devotee had put in more effort and so received more purification. — “the energy he put into this is more than the energy”

🎙 Maharaj at 92:38 (auto-transcript): “one day we we went on Sankita one devotee distributed only five books and one other god brother he distributed more than us he did 45 books one did five when the resolve was announced grudel was glorifying the one who gave who distributed five books and the one who did 45…”

The verse places the Lord beyond everything expressed by material sound, mind or senses. Maharaj says Krishna exists before, during and after creation and is reached only by his causeless mercy when senses, mind and intelligence are engaged in service with the right attitude, beginning with the tongue.

The verse says the Lord, from within, keeps speculators agreeing and disagreeing without conclusion. Maharaj asks why Krishna does this: because they want to forget him, he gives them ample reason to forget, just as he gives devotees reason to remember. It is not his fault but his nature. — “He's doing it by our desire.”

Those who do not want Krishna get thousands of subjects to discuss. Maharaj points to endless cell-phone and car models that only change name and colour and keep us anxious; no phone can reach Krishna, but the tongue he gave us can. — “Only our tongue has to call that Krishna direct number.”

🎙 Maharaj at 109:02 (auto-transcript): “how many varieties of cell phone we have how many varieties cell phone yeah thousands because I use the word so thousands of subjects simple what is it what is it useful yourself what did you use common useful is make a call and receive a call right so then we're having…”

If God is one, why so many religions? Because people are at different levels, Krishna lovingly provides for each, like kindergarten, primary school, college and research. We also came through that speculation over many lifetimes, so being a devotee is great fortune; Prabhupada wrote to one devotee not to take the process cheaply. — “we should not take it cheaply”

🎙 Maharaj at 114:13 (auto-transcript): “this is one side that is just one side what are the other reasons if the absolute is one if god is one why soon the religion why why so the religion if god is one because everybody is not uh is not on that level to understand everybody is on a different level therefore there…”

Sankhya and bhakti both point to the same ultimate cause, but the analyst goes the long way round, counting elements, and few arrive. Maharaj says even the royal road of bhakti has accidents, and the rough road far more, so it is fortune to take to Krishna consciousness.

Krishna consciousness is the most difficult thing in the world: a degree takes five years, but how many lives to graduate as a devotee? Prabhupada and his guru wanted disciples to go back this life; Prabhupada's purports explain that most do not really want to go back. Krishna has opened the gate; it depends on us.

🎙 Maharaj at 121:41 (auto-transcript): “to take to christian consciousness in fact the most difficult thing for anyone to do in this world is is the most difficult thing one can ever do in life christian consciousness it's christian consciousness go to any college after five years we are graduate is it not how many…”
Is the Lord partial to devotees? Maharaj says no: those who worship him as a person see him as a person, and those who deny his form get no form. His names, form and pastimes are not material.

Impersonalists think any form must be defective like ours, so they treat deities as a means to be thrown away later; Maharaj says formlessness comes from frustration. A prison commissioner who visits a prison does not become a prisoner; his visit brings amnesty, just as Krishna's coming lets us see and hear him. — “formlessness is due to frustration”

🎙 Maharaj at 132:25 (auto-transcript): “they think that there is so much problem in name and form here so if lord also has form and name that means so all forms in this this world has some defect they are conditioned so if the lord has form he also become a conditioned person conditioned soul that is their…”

The Lord's name is not material: Ajamila called his son Narayana, and Narayana responded to his own name and delivered him.

🎙 Maharaj at 135:50 (auto-transcript): “And his name is not material like the proper said. Just calling Narayan, he got liberated. Even though he was not calling Narayan. But Narayan says, my name is calling. Let me do something. Let me do something. And he got what he did again. Because in the name of the Lord is…”

The verse compares the Lord's appearance through lower forms of worship to air carrying a fragrance. Maharaj says the Lord reveals himself only by his grace, not by speculation; the devotee's prayer is to see him as he actually is.

The Lord appears on Garuda with eight arms, ornaments and his associates. Maharaj insists these ornaments are no imagination; seeing Jagannatha or Radha-Krishna decorated every day, devotees have the great fortune of serving the Lord in person.

Daksha falls flat like a rod, as Dhruva did in another age; the same response in different ages shows it is real. Maharaj cites the saying that the eye that sees God shall die: one is transformed, as Dhruva no longer wanted the kingdom he came for. Losing taste for old attractions is the sign of advancement. — “you can never be the same person again”

A devotee raises a point after the reading.

🎙 Maharaj at 152:40 (auto-transcript): “Comment. You said Dhruvam Arad and Daksha, both God-Dashna of Lord, Dhruva and Daksha. So here is the Lord saying I am very pleased with your Ashrati and devotion, but we don't see the transformation of heart which Dhirva felt. He got transformed. He didn't ask for any…”

children.topic: Q1 · Why was Daksha not changed?
children.note:
Dhruva and Daksha both saw the Lord, but Dhruva was transformed and gave up his desire while Daksha took his boon and stayed materialistic. Why?

🎙 Maharaj at 152:51 (auto-transcript): “You said Dhruvam Arad and Daksha, both God-Dashna of Lord, Dhruva and Daksha. So here is the Lord saying I am very pleased with your Ashrati and devotion, but we don't see the transformation of heart which Dhirva felt. He got transformed. He didn't ask for any material…”

Daksha is expert in sense gratification, and one attached to it cannot avoid offences, for material desire means envy. Maharaj adds that parents deserve respect only if they train children in Krishna consciousness: Narada delivered Daksha's eleven thousand sons, while Daksha could not deliver one. — “it's offensive personality it's not daksha for krishna consciousness”

🎙 Maharaj at 153:31 (auto-transcript): “Yes. Daksha is very offensive. it's offensive personality it's not daksha for krishna consciousness it's daksha for sense gratification and anyone who is attached to a sense gratification was cannot be free from offenses cannot be free only if one is free from sense…”
